quote: A quarter-sized conveyor used for high-leveled miners to better channel their ore.
overview: The Tiny Conveyor is a Novice Conveyor. It is notable for being the smallest conveyor in the game, making it practical for many advanced funneling and stalling techniques that are not possible or space efficient with larger conveyors.

quote: A machine that produces coal. Coal is worth $0 when put into a furnace but is used to power many heavy machines.
overview:
The Coal Mine is a Basic utility dropper that produces coal ore worth $0, which can be used to power industrial machines (such as the Industrial Ruby Mine and the Industrial Ore Welder). It is often used in that manner, often having the coal travel on conveyor arrays heading to an industrial input. It is also useable for some items if ores are modified, such as sparkling coal ores can power up Northern Lights.
A premium-tier variant, the Triple Coal Mine,and its seasonal variant, the Spooky Coal Mine, produce triple the coal in the same time span while occupying the same hitbox space o

f.effects: When coal ores are put in an industrial input, the coal will be consumed and the industrial machine will perform its effect.

quote: This item is no longer in use and will be destroyed when you Rebirth.
overview:
The Conveyor Corner is a Novice conveyor that bends around a corner. This piece took up a ridiculous amount of room; you could accomplish making a corner with any conveyor without walls. However, ores can get stuck by doing this, so some users used this item instead. This item has another counterpart, the Reverse Corner. It was used to turn ores the other way.
Along with the Reverse Corner, it was retired in The Resurrection Update.

quote: A relic from the 2015 Holiday Event, the Neon Gift of Glowing lights up to illuminate your base at night.
overview:
The Neon Gift of Glowing is a Collectible-tier decoration that was picked up from Headless Santa for free during the Holiday Event. Players were intended to only receive one gift, but due to a glitch players were able to rejoin and receive another.
Unlike other gifts, this gift cannot be opened to receive an item, this however is a light source, albeit a weak one.

f.effects:
Light source
Decoration

quote: A conveyor that is raised much higher than other conveyors. Can be useful for creating intersections.
overview: The Raised-ier Conveyor is an Intermediate conveyor belonging to the highest and final level of conveyors. These conveyors are the highest a normal conveyor can go without the use of Hydraulics.

quote: A steaming hot furnace. Drop some ore into it to make some money!
overview:
The Basic Furnace is a Basic furnace. It is received when either joining the game for the first time, or upon rebirth.
It is used to start off in the game. The Basic Furnace is tied with Soul Blossom and Australis Fornacem as the second weakest furnace in Miner's Haven, with the weakest being THE UNDERTAKER.

f.effects: Processes ores at x1 their value.

quote: Sometimes you need to set back and admire your work. This bench allows you to do just that.
overview: The Small Bench is a Novice decoration with two seats for you and a friend to sit on. The in-game thumbnail for the photo also shows a Potted Tree and a Giant Rock, two other decorations that can be bought separately.

quote: A friend of berezaa's, Aman stands in place and is always looking around at your stuff.... watching.
overview:
Aman the Survivor is a Legendary decoration item that can be purchased from the shop.
It consists of an NPC named Aman, who wears a brown shirt, camo pants, and bears a large torch.

quote: Allows a wide conveyor to convert to a regular conveyor.
overview:
The Conveyor Converter is a Collectible conveyor that converts conveyors that are 3 units wide like Wide Conveyors to a 2 unit wide conveyor.
On 5 December, 2019; this item was removed from the shop due to OutOfOrderFoxy removing/adjusting all Wide Conveyors to normal-sized conveyors.

f.effects: Squeezes ore to a 2-unit wide conveyor.

quote: An awesome switch conveyor that accepts ore from the side and then sends it either left or right depending on the setting.
overview:
The Reversible Conveyor is a Premium utility conveyor that can have its direction customized by the setting of a button. This conveyor is useful for loops or in a setup involving a blaster or star item. It can be purchased in the uC tab of the shop.
As of the Skipped Life Update, the Reversible Conveyor's name was corrected, and a small wall behind the panel was raised, disallowing ores from falling off from that side. The addition of only the player being allowed to use this item has also been added.

f.effects: The conveyor's direction can be changed with a button

quote: A machine that infuses anyone who touches it with +25 MaxHealth. Players can only be infused once per life.
overview: The Health Infuser was an Intermediate-tier infuser and was one of the infusers that handled health, giving your character +25 maximum health. Four other infusers that handle health are the Regeneration Infuser, Executive Infuser, Righteous Will, and Haunted Infuser. Players may only be infused once per life, or twice with a Resetting Infuser.

f.effects: Adds 25 health upon touch.

quote: An advanced machine that increases your character's speed by 12. You can only be infused once.
overview: The Haste Infuser is a Premium infuser. It was moved from the RP shop on 31st March, 2016 and went through two buffs. At first, it added +5 walkspeed, then +8, and now +12. It can also be obtained from boxes. It gives your character +12 Walkspeed. Players may only be infused once per life, or twice with a Resetting Infuser.

f.effects: Increases walkspeed by 12
f.drawbacks: Player can only be infused once without a ⟦Resetting Infuser⟧.

quote: A breath-taking statue which depicts a swordsman going to war. Comes with real swords to whack your friends with.
overview: The Swordmaster Statue is a Premium-tier weapon. It was the first weapon that could be obtained (without buying game passes). When equipped, the user is granted a boost of speed. The reborn equivalent of this item is the Sword God Shrine but this is no longer obtainable since lethals were removed on March 31st, 2016. It was re-added on May 28th, 2017 because PVP was to be re-added in the 2017 Summer Update, with the focus on melee.

f.effects: Gives the player a Linked Sword gear.

quote: An old weapons cache which appears to have been left behind with live AK-47's.
overview: The Automatic Weaponry is an Intermediate weapon giver with a mini flood light on it, added in the Initial Release, then removed on 31 March, 2016 due to the removal of combat, and re-added on 23 December, 2019.

f.effects:
Gives the player an AK-47 gear.Flood Light
Emits a decent amount of light in the direction it's facing.
f.related_items_text:
Weapon Giver Items
Flood Light Items

quote: A basic turret so powerful that it must be mounted to an Iron wall to operate. Deals massive damage but requires being seated.
overview: The Iron Turret Wall is a Basic wall with a minigun on it, added in the 2015 August-September Updates, then removed on 31 March, 2016 due to the removal of combat, and re-added on 23 December, 2019. It can be obtained from Shop for $10k.

f.drawbacks: Requires a Ladder or Staircase Wall to climb and control this item.

quote: A polished rack set in stone. Holds actual iron-clad revolvers.
overview: The Revolver Rack is a Epic weapon giver, originally in Miner's Haven until weapons were removed in March 2016. The Revolver Rack was easy to acquire for newer players and was powerful when successfully hitting at the right range. In the second part of the Winter 2019 event, the Revolver Rack was brought back into the shop as a common item.

quote: A platform which you will be dropped down onto when you respawn. Placing more than one will select a beacon at random each time.
overview: The Spawn Beacon is a Novice utility that allows the player to set their location upon respawn. By placing one of these beacons, the player will spawn at that beacon every time they respawn. By placing more than one beacon, they will spawn at one of the beacons at random. This can join forces with a Forcefield Generator to provide a forcefield upon spawn. The Spawn Beacon may only be placed on the player's base.

f.effects:
Respawn players where this item placed.
Generates a forcefield when used with ⟦Forcefield Generator⟧.

quote: A heavy gate that allows the owner to open or close the door by touching colored pads.
overview:
The Controlled Gate is a Novice gate added in the Initial Release.
It is primarily used to prevent players from entering your base.
May also be used as a 1-unit thick wall for ores, though only the button part is a very reliable ore wall; the other parts are a bit thin and ores may still hit the ground

f.drawbacks: Requires physical contact to control the door.

quote: A long vertical ladder used to climb up walls and other tall structures.
overview:
The Ladder is an Advanced decoration added in the Initial Release. It can be obtained from Shop for $1.3k, but requires 1k RP to unlock.
It allows player to travel up walls or high places, making it great for bases and Iron Turret Walls. It can also be used as a thin 1 unit wall.

f.effects: Allow players to travel up walls or high places.

quote: A high-temperature furnace which processes ores at triple their value.
overview: The Ore Incinerator is a Basic furnace and is the fourth furnace that is available to be purchased in the shop; it costs 10k and processes ore at 3x (previously 2x) its original value.

f.effects: Processes ore at 3x their value

quote: A ton of crates packed with what appear to be old-fashioned shotguns and shotgun shells.
overview: The Close-Range Ordinance is a Novice weapon giver that gives shotguns. Previously this item was Collectible- tier when weapons were removed on March 31st, 2016. Before that it was an Intermediate-tier RP Shop item. In the second part of Christmas Event 2019, the Closed Ranged Ordinance, along with other removed shop weapons, were added back into Miner's Haven.

f.effects: Gives the player a shotgun

quote: The pinnacle of nature's beauty, the mysterious and all-knowing cherry blossom tree is only owned by those with great power.
overview: The Cherry Blossom is a Proficient decoration that can be bought from the shop for $6.75T.Small

quote: Darkness is no good! This bright light turns on at night time and illuminates your factory!
overview: The Flood Light is a Basic flood light added in the Initial Release.

f.effects: Emits a decent amount of light in the direction it's facing.

quote: Advanced freon technology has allowed for the creation of a deadly freeze ray weapon. A relic from the 2015 Holiday Event.
overview: The Freeze-Ray Tech is a Collectible weapon giver that was sold by Headless Santa in December 2015. This was the only weapon that had other effects than just knockback (lowering other player's walkspeed) and damage. The Freeze-Ray Tech can be found in the Festive Boxes as of December 1st, 2019.

f.effects: Slows player's walkspeed

quote: A thick wooden wall lined with metal stairs. Useful for getting up in style.
overview: The Staircase Wall is an Basic wall that can be used to allow to players to travel up walls, as an alternative to the Ladder. The Staircase Wall is also shorter than normal walls. The staircase wall is a simple but quite effective wall as you are able to get up to high places.

quote: One of the greatest mysteries of life, the Autumn Tree is extremely expensive to make and is only for the rich.
overview: The Autumn Tree is an Advanced decoration added on the initial release of Miner's Haven. This item is not to be confused with the exotic Autumn Breeze, and serves no purpose other than to be a decorative item.

quote: Pebble is a really nice material if you're looking to make your base pretty.
overview:
The Pebble Flooring is an Intermediate flooring that can be placed under all other objects as long as the middle square is on an empty space.
It can be used to make a path through your base.

quote: With all your expensive machines and money, its important to remember mother nature.
overview: The Potted Tree is a Novice decoration purchasable from the shop for $100k. It is also the cheapest out of all of the other trees.

quote: Undead Santa seeks out those who have been naughty by breaking into your base. Discovered under the Special Snowflake in the 2015 Holiday Event.
overview:
The Undead Santa is a Fabled guardian. This came out of the Super Snowflake Artifact in 2015. It appears to share the same appearance as the Undead Guardian except for the hat and the beard.
It has exactly the same effects and abilities as a regular Undead Guardian, with the exception of it having a "ho ho ho" sound effect, and about double health.

f.effects: Attacks players that are not on your permission list.

quote: Some awesome high-power fireworks stuck in some dirt. A relic from the 2015 New Years event, returned for the 2021 New Years event.
overview: The Firework Pile is a Collectible-Tier Decorational item which is in the Premium Shop. Previously it was sold by Jak'uhfdor during the 2015/16 New Years Event for about 26 uC - 100 uC. When touched, it gives the user fireworks which, when used, fly into the air and explode into many patriotically American-colored sparkles.

f.effects: Gives fireworks to players

quote: Light up your base with pretty glowing lava flooring. (Doesn't kill)
overview:
The Lava Flooring is an Intermediate flooring item that can be placed under all other objects as long as the middle square is on an empty space.
It can be used to make a luminescent path through your base.

quote: Only the richest people can afford a giant doge plush in their base.
overview:
The Giant Doge Plushie is a Premium doge added in The Combat Update.
It serves no purpose other than being a decoration for your base and powering up the Canis Processus.

quote: Sometimes you need some pretty carpet to decorate your base.
overview:
Carpet Flooring is a Basic decoration used to customise your base's floor. It costs $42k from the Shop.
Like other flooring items, the actual hitbox is only 1x1, while the carpet itself is 3x3, allowing it to be placed under items.

quote: |A teleporter that operates using diffierent [sic] technology. It can only teleport ore to a pink receiver|Pink Teleporter (Sender)|A special teleporter pad that only receives ore from pink teleporters.|Pink Teleporter (Receiver)
overview: The Pink Teleporter is an Advanced teleporter set, like other coloured teleporters, is used to teleport ore from the sender to the receiver.

quote: A heavy conveyor which grants ore a small upgrade before launching it forward into the air.
overview:
The Ore Cannon is a Novice utility cannon that propels ore into the air.
It's mainly used to launch ore into upgraders which may have their beam raised from the conveyor, such as those from the Star family, while also applying a multiplier of x1.5 each time it is used (up to 5 times), for a total of x7.59.

f.effects:
• Propels ore forwards into the air
• Multiplies ore value by x1.5

quote: A massive upgrader that unlocks an ore's true power by quintupling its value. Only affects ore that hasn't been upgraded yet.
overview:
The Ore Magnifier is an Intermediate upgrader available in the Shop.
The Ore Magnifier multiplies ore value by 5x if the ore has an upgrade counter of 0 or less. This means it should be used at the very start of a setup.
While the upgrader is technically compatible with Resetting Devices, they do not reset the upgrade count of an ore, so using this item after a resetting device is basically useless unless a Ore Negator is used or if a dropper has negative upgrade counter ores.

f.effects: Mutliplies ore value by x5
f.drawbacks: Upgrade counter must be ≤ 0

quote: A massive wall made out of bricks. Great for defending your base.
overview: The Brick Wall is a Novice wall that the player can buy from the shop and is primarily used to keep other players out of their base. It has no special features and is one of the most basic walls.

quote: A scavenger likes to keep their guns in the same place they keep their winnings: a table.
overview: The Flintlock Table is a Premium-tier weapon giver in Miner's Haven that was known for dealing good damage and knockback in close range combat. Decorations on the item includes gold blocks below the table, while the table has decorations including a pirate's hat, a crown, wood blocks, gold coins, and of course flintlocks.

quote: More advanced research furnaces that produce 50 points per 25 ore.. Requires ore to be worth at least $20.
overview:
The Proficient Research Center is a Novice research center. It's the second of the four research centers purchased in the shop.
It can produce 50 RP per 25 ores, an improvement from the Basic Research Center. However, ores need to be worth more than $20 to produce RP.

f.effects: Processes ore at x1 their value
f.drawbacks: RP Incentive doesn't apply to ores worth less than $20

quote: A flat-rate upgrader that can be used to increase the value of your ores.
overview:
The Basic Ore Purifier is a Basic upgrader. It adds $9 to all ores regardless of value, but any ores worth less than $1k have an additional 1.1x multiplier.
Despite the percentage upgrade this item has, it is still best used before other looping upgraders such as the Large Ore Upgrader.

f.effects:
• Adds $9
• Upgrades ores worth under 1k by x1.1

quote: A massive rig that allows the legendary ambrosia to be manually mined.
overview: The Remote Ambrosia Mine is a Legendary-tier remote mine and the last remote mine purchasable within the shop.

quote: One of the emperor's first mines, used to extract large diamond ore. Unfortunately, its efficiency was lackluster, so smaller mines producing smaller ore were prioritized.
overview:
The Massive Diamond Mine is a Reborn-tier massive mine.
As the name of the mine suggests, this mine produces big diamond ores, each worth $10M.
The ore can be put into a cell furnace. Since the big diamond ore is huge, it often blocks ore from getting through in certain items.

quote: Mithril is a once-mythical material used to create powerful weapons and armor. It fetches a hefty price.
overview:
The Mithril Mine is an Epic dropper, it works quite well in early life rebirth setups. The only slight drawbacks to the Mithril Mine are its mediocre drop rate and fairly large size.
While it does have a high ore value when the player is yet to rebirth for their first time, the Painite Mine can be used more frequently as its standard ore size allows it to be easily cloned by an Ore Replicator (using a Large Converter Ramp) which translates to an easy 2x multiplier. The Mithril Mine's smaller ore size prevents it from being able to do this.

quote: Oh, how delicate the mind of the dreamer is.
overview:
The Dreamer's Fright is a Reborn furnace that was released in July 2015, one month after the game's initial release.
The Dreamer's Fright has erratic stats as it can add or subtract value and may process ore value by a negative multiplier. It first adds or subtracts up to $10k, then multiplies the ore value by a number between -5 and 45. To prevent players from acquiring negative money, their cash is set to $0.1. Additionally, ores must be worth at least $10k in order to process, due to the furnace subtracting $10k from the ore value.
The Dreamer's Fright's leaves fall and act as ores, but are not destroyed when they touch the baseplat

f.effects:
• Ore value is first added by a number between -$10k to $10k
• Processes ore value at -5x to 45x
f.drawbacks:
Chance to process ore at a negative value
Takes away Research Points

quote: A machine that resembles an ore upgrader. Sends ores to another dimension to be judged. No one knows what happens to the ore and some don't come back at all.
overview:
The Schrodinger Evaluator is an Epic schrodinger that is sold in the shop. Unlike most other upgraders purchasable in its bracket, the Schrodinger Evaluator has the ability to apply random effects to ore.
Because of its unpredictable nature, the Schrodinger Evaluator can produce ore that is either significantly more valuable or significantly less valuable, or produce no ore at all. The more Schrodinger Evaluators a player uses, the less likely it is for an ore to survive, and vice versa. Using many Schrodingers in quick succession does not guarantee valuable ore, as there is always a possibility that an ore's value will be set to $1 or destroyed entirely somewhere in the middle. Therefore, it is advised to use Schrodinger Evaluators with mass-produced or batch-upgraded ores instead of trickles of high-value ores.
When a Schrodinger Evaluator upgrades an ore, the effect it applies is typically not apparent without the use of an Ore Tracker; however, its blue machinery will turn red if an explosion is created and turn yellow if sparkles are applied to an ore.
Many Schrodinger Evaluators are typically used in end-game early Rebirth setups to boost ore value from the trillions and quadrillions to the quintillions.
The Desert Monument effectively prevents the Schrodinger Evaluator from setting ore value to $1 by making the ore unable to lose value.

f.effects: (see overview)
f.drawbacks: Possibility of destruction, flinging and explosions.

x.t: Explosions have a small chance (close to 1 in 10 [estimate]) of destroying target ores, and they may eject nearby ores out of the evaluator with extreme force.

Chance

rows: x6, ore is given pink sparkles

x.t:
• The average or expected multiplier of a Schrodinger Evaluator is:
0.45(2.1)+0.25(0)+0.05(3.2+6+2.2+1+0+0.9)=1.61
assuming that:
• the ore is 100% recovered when flung and 90% recovered when exploded
• the initial ore value is much greater than $1B such that the flat +$1B is negligible
• ores set to $1 are considered worthless
• The chance of losing ore to destruction, value wiping or explosions is 30.5%, so the chance of ore surviving and retaining "usable" value is 69.5%. This means that, for instance, when 100 ores are fed into 5 Schrodinger Evaluators, you can expect around 16 "usable" ores to leave with a combined value of 1082 of the original ores (along with a few worthless ores that had their value reset to $1 at some point)
• When using Schrodinger Evaluators, it is important to find a balance between the amount of evaluators you use and the value of the upgraded ore. Using too many evaluators can result in low ore survival rates, and too few evaluators can result in weak multipliers and lost potential.
• Pairing the Schrodinger Evaluator with portable blasters such as the Big Bad Blaster is effective, as the evaluator can act as a shield to prevent ore from flying off the base due to the blaster's own explosions, removing the need for Full Shield Conveyors.
• A recommended amount of 5 - 7 Schrodinger Evaluators is perfect for a beginner so there is a decent chance you will not have too many of your ore destroyed or set to $1.

quote: A loyal undead minion that will attack any enemies that come within its radius. Does not attack those with base permissions.
overview:
The Undead Guardian is a Premium guardian whom can be purchased for 250 uC.
When placed in a user's base, the zombie will attack any players within a certain radius (estimated to be around half of a player's base), excluding the user's ROBLOX friends.

f.effects: Attacks players that are not on your permission list.

quote: Aww its an adowable undead guardian!!!! I bet it would never hurt a living thing :(
overview: The Adowable Guardian is a Vintage guardian item that spawns a special Zombie at your base (nicknamed "Zwambie") that explodes in touch with anyone not on your friends list, killing them instantly. The Zwambie also looks quite cute, tricking new players into thinking it is harmless. This cute zombie has the ability to leap walls completely and effortlessly to find new friends to 'hug'.

f.effects: Attacks players that are not on your permission list.

quote: A fancy diamond mine with an ACTUAL ninja sitting on it! Drops $1k worth of diamond ore every 2 seconds.
overview: The Ninja Diamond Mine is a Premium mine. This mine's ores have a much higher value than you can easily access in the beginning of the game, so they can be great for starting players if paired with a Cell Furnace. The ninja sitting behind the mine is purely cosmetic and may push you in edit mode, it is sometimes not advised to move this item mindlessly as the model can move you into unexpected location, especially without boost from infusers.

quote: An amazing machine that removes all status effects such as Radioactive and Flaming from an ore and removes all tags, allowing it to go through limiting machines again. Can only be used once.
overview:
The Tesla Resetter is a Reborn resetting device. It does not upgrade ore, but removes all effects and machine tags from ores. This allows ore to go through the same upgraders again, essentially squaring the multipliers of every upgrader used.
The Tesla Resetter can only be used and reset upgrade tags once, therefore it cannot be used again (or with its evolution).
It is worth noting that fire-proof ores such as ores of the Symmetrium Mine and its evolution will lose their fire-proof effect once they pass through the Tesla Resetter. The Tesla Resetter will remove all status effects with no exception.
Another important note about

f.effects: Removes all machine tags and status effects from ore.

submission.name: More Stuff
submission.description: If you're not Berezaa, DON'T TAKE THIS..... Like people did, to the last one... :c

quote: A heavy-weight mine that requires the click of a manual button to produce ore. Creates a bigger and more expensive ore.
overview: The Iron Excavator is a Basic mine. It is the cheapest excavator purchasable within the shop. It drops ores at the click of the buttons on the back worth $20.
date:
Initial Release
Added back in 23 December, 2019

quote: A portable device that sets ores on fire, adding $5000 to their value but destroying them in 5 seconds if they don't reach a furnace or get put out.
overview:
The Portable Flamethrower is a Premium-tier utility upgrader.
It is a small portable machine that adds $5k to ore and sets them on fire. If the ore is not extinguished within 4 seconds, the ore will be destroyed.

f.effects:
+ $5k to ore value
Sets ore on fire
f.drawbacks: Fire destroys ore in 4s

quote: Quintiples [sic] the value of scanned ore. Doesn't affect ore scanned by any other scanner machine. Sets ores on fire (destroyed in 4 seconds if not put out or processed).
overview:
The Flaming Ore Scanner is an Epic scanner.
The Flaming Ore Scanner multiplies ore value by 5x with the catch that fire destroys upgraded ores after 4 seconds unless they either reach a furnace or are extinguished.
The Flaming Ore Scanner does not stack with other ore scanners in the shop.

f.effects:
Multiplies ore value by 5x
Sets ore on fire
f.drawbacks: Fire destroys ore in 4 seconds

quote: A giant machine that spits out super valuable ruby every time it is fueled with a coal ore.
overview: The Industrial Ruby Mine is a Basic Industrial Dropper. It's the first and the weakest of the 5 industrial mines. Industrial mines require coal to produce ores, and whenever a coal ore is put into the mine's input, an ore is produced. This can get players some easy millions if used with a Cell Incinerator, similarly to an Industrial Diamond Mine.

quote: The power of pure superiority grants a significant jump boost; 30+ MaxHealth and +15 speed. Obliterate nearby enemies on death.
overview: The Executive Infuser is a Fabled infuser first revealed by Berezaa on his Twitter page on December 22nd, 2015. This infuser is given to only users who buys or already own the Executive Membership Gamepass for Miner's Haven, along with the Executive Pillars. It gives your character a wide variety of effects, namely +15 Walkspeed and +20 Jump Power, +50 maximum health, and it makes your character explode when you die, killing other characters nearby, much like the Explosive Infuser but with a much larger radius. Players with the Righteous Will may take less damage from the explosion,

f.effects:
• +50 Health
• Passive Death Explosion Effect
• +15 Walk Speed
• +20 Jump Height
f.drawbacks: Player can only be infused once without a ⟦Resetting Infuser⟧.

quote: A relic from the Progressive Era, Big Bertha promises a whopping x10 for any ore that get through it. Bertha doesn't like repeat customers.
overview:
The Big Bertha is a Reborn upgrader that was added in the Secret Update and is one of three (supposed to be four) secret reborn items that were added during this update.
It multiplies ore value by x10, but requires ore be inserted in such a way that in enters the purple hole at the front side. This can be achieved using a variety of setups:
• Using a mine beside it to drop ore directly into it
• Using an Ore Cannon
• Using a Hydraulic Unstable Conveyor raised by 1 to launch the ore in
• Using a Vortex Chamber, another Reborn-tier upgrader, directly before it

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by x10
f.drawbacks: Requires ore to be launched or directly dropped into upgrader part

submission.name: Cosmic Energizer
submission.description: A strange upgrader from the depths of outer space. Ore must be launched into the ring to be upgraded by 12x
submission.effects: Multiplies ore value by x12

quote: Infuses you with 2+ speed and causes you to explode when you die. Any kills by your explosion counts towards you. You can only be infused once per life.
overview:
The Explosive Infuser was an Advanced-tier infuser, which gave your character +2 Walkspeed and an explosive effect, making your character explode when you die, killing other characters nearby. Due to this ability, this was considered the most powerful infuser, before Berezaa released a new line of infusers including the Righteous Will, Executive Infuser, and Lucky Infuser.
Players may only be infused once per life, or twice with a Resetting Infuser.

f.effects: Gives player additional 2 walkspeed; causes an explosion when user dies

quote: A half-sized conveyor used for high-level miners to better channel their ore.
overview: The Half Conveyor, like its name suggests, it is a 1x2 conveyor that is half the length of a Basic Conveyor.

submission.name: Half Conveyor
submission.description: Same as the basic conveyor, but more compact for fine-tuning ore pathways.

quote: A small beacon that is hooked up to a matching satellite to fire down a beam which upgrades ores up to 3 times by 40%. Attaches to conveyors.
overview:
The Orbitable Upgrader is an Epic portable upgrader.
It multiplies ore value by 1.4x and can be used up to 3 times, for a total multiplier of ~2.74. Because it's a portable item and can be put on top of conveyors, it is very easy to incorporate into setups.

f.effects: Increases ore value by 40% (x1.4)

quote: Use this upgrader several times in a row to quickly upgrade your ores. Only effective on cheap ore.
overview: The Large Ore Upgrader is a Basic upgrader which upgrades ore depending on their value, like so:

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by x1.5 to x1.01

quote: An interestingly-shaped furnace that processes at +$100,000 and then x10 value. Does not produce Research Points. alpha tester exclusive. Accepts direct ore on two sides, conveyor ore on one side.
overview:
The Ore Encapsulator is a Fabled furnace added in the Initial Release.
It multiplies ore value by 1x, and the multiplier increases by 1 for every ore that is processed, capping at 10k multiplier. When the multiplier reaches 10k, it drops back to 2k multiplier. This is one of few furnaces that have multiple-sided acceptance, but the only furnace that can accept ores from ground level or from a raised conveyor.

f.effects:
• Base multiplier of x1.
• Each ore processed adds +1 to the multiplier.
f.drawbacks: Multiplier drops to x2k after it reaches x10k.

quote: An advanced upgrader that rapidly upgrades ore. Ore that is too large is set on fire.
overview:
The Precision Refiner is an Advanced capgrader available in the Shop.
It multiplies ore value by x1.5 up to $100M. Very useful to reach into the billions. However ores that is larger than 1.33 are ignited.

f.effects:
Multiplies ore value by x1.5
Ore larger than 1.3x1.3x1.3 are ignited
f.drawbacks: Flames destroy ore in 5s

quote: A very big osmium mine that produces massive ore manually on click.
overview: The Osmium Excavator is an Advanced Excavator Dropper and is the third most powerful excavator in the game, with the first being the Newtonium Excavator and the second being the Firecrystal Excavator.

quote: A massive machine that spits out huge diamond ore every time it is fed a coal ore.
overview: The Industrial Diamond Mine is an Intermediate Industrial Dropper. This industrial mine spits out ore worth $8k. You must put coal into the mine's furnace part in order for it to produce ore.

quote: A rapidly color-changing upgrader that upgrades ore from 5 to 100% depends on the color of the upgrader. Doesn't upgrade ore worth more than $100M.
overview:
The Rainbow Upgrader is a Premium-tier upgrader. It randomly changes the amount it upgrades ore by based on its color when the ore passes through the upgrader. Unfortunately, this upgrader only goes to a maximum of $100M.
The ore value is based off of the color of the upgrader beam at the moment of contact. The colors include Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Cyan, Blue and then Purple. Upgrade % from least to greatest:

f.effects: Increases orevalue randomly from 5%-100% (based on color)
f.drawbacks: Cannot upgrade ore worth more than $100M

quote: A raised upgrader that increases the value of ore over $1T by 80% up to $50Qn.
overview: The Molten Upgrader is a Legendary-tier upgrader that multiplies ore value by 1.8x up to $50Qn. The ore itself also has to be worth at least $1T in order to be compatible with the Molten Upgrader, as well as requiring a Large Converter Ramp or similar item to get the ores to the correct elevation.Legendary

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by 1.8x
f.drawbacks: Ore must be worth between $1T and $50Qn

quote: The big bad blaster is easily the biggest and baddest blaster in the world. It attaches to conveyors and upgrades by x2.65 the value of ore... most of the time.
overview:
The Big Bad Blaster (often abbreviated to "BBB") is a Reborn blaster added in September, 2015.
The Big Bad Blaster multiplies ore value by x2.65 and is placeable on the side of conveyors and upgraders. However, each use of the item has a chance to destroy/explode ores. Surviving ores are set on fire, destroying them after 4s, if they are not extinguished.

f.effects:
Multiplies ore value by x2.65
Sets ore on fire
f.drawbacks:
• Flames destroy ore in 4s
• 3/11 (~27.27%) chance to explode the ore
• ~10% chance to explode AND destroy the ore

quote: A compact furnace the only accepts ores directly from droppers in return for a huge bonus.
overview: The Basic Cell Furnace is a Basic cell furnace. This is one of the items you start with; it is the first cell furnace available in the game. Cell furnaces are furnaces that process ores at a large multiplier, but only accept ores that are un-upgraded.

f.effects: Processes un-upgraded ore at x20 their value.

quote: An industrial mine that spits out $100 to $10k worth of ore every time coal hits it, depending on the color of the mine.
overview:
Industrial Rainbow Mine is a Premium-tier Industrial Dropper. This is most commonly obtained from Mystery Boxes but can also be bought from the uC Shop.
The ore value is based off of the color of the mine at the moment of receiving coal. The colors include Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Cyan, Blue and then Purple. Ore value from least to greatest:
Despite ore value depending on the ore's color, Ore Painter won't change the value.

quote: Sacrifice your ore to the underworld and recieve [sic] back 10x the ores' value. Gives 5 points per 80 ore.
overview: The Sacrificial Altar is a Proficient furnace that can be bought from the shop for $1.37T. It processes ores at x10 their value.

f.effects: Processes ores at x10 their value

quote: Grants all wearers a 1/4 chance to obtain a lucky clover from boxes! Increases speed by 6. Discovered in the Gambler's Dice during the Holiday Event 2015.
overview: The Lucky Infuser is a Fabled infuser, was first revealed by Berezaa on his Twitter Page on 22nd December, 2015. This Infuser was awarded to players that bought the Gambler's Dice gamepass during Black Friday when it was introduced on Black Friday 2015. It gives your character +6 Walkspeed. Players may only be infused once per life, or twice with a Resetting Infuser.

f.effects: +6 walkspeed
f.drawbacks: Player can only be infused once without a ⟦Resetting Infuser⟧.

quote: A high-end research furnace that doubles the value of ore and produces 60 points per 25 ore.. Requires ore to be worth at least $300.
overview:
The Quantum Research Center is an Intermediate research center. It's the third of the four research centers purchased in the shop.
It can produce 60 RP per 25 ores, a slightly better version from the Proficient Research Center. Just like its predecessor, ores need to be worth more than $300 to produce RP.

f.effects: Processes ore at 2x its value.
f.drawbacks: RP Incentive doesn't apply to ores worth less than $300.

quote: An incredibly powerful upgrader that quadruples the value of ore that passes through. Can only be used once per ore.
overview: The Catalyst is a Reborn upgrader. This was one of three reborn items added in the Holiday Update on the 4th December, 2015.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by x4

submission.name: Ore Compressor
submission.description: This powerful upgrader shrinks your ore down to size, and DOUBLES its value! Does not work on ores with the size of 0.8 studs or lower...

quote: A two-sided cell furnace that grants massive upgrades to any ore dropped directly into it.
overview: The Cell Processor is an Intermediate cell furnace. It has a double sided acceptance so you could either place two mines across from each other or have one mine and an Ore Replicator. Like other cell furnaces, some mines do not work on the Cell Processor.

f.effects: Processes unupgraded ore by x1k its value

quote: A special machine that increases your character's speed by 9. You can only be infused once.
overview: The Speed Infuser is a Premium infuser that gives your character +9 Walkspeed. It is a weaker version of the Haste Infuser. Players may only be infused once per life, or twice with a Resetting Infuser.

f.effects: +9 walkspeed
f.drawbacks: Player can only be infused once without a ⟦Resetting Infuser⟧.

quote: A tiny yet extremely powerful upgrader built into a raised-ier conveyor.
overview: The Way-Up-High Upgrader is an Advanced upgrader. It is the second of 7 shop upgraders in Miner's Haven that have the Way-Up-High elevation. Using many of these upgraders can significantly help users transition into the high trillions. Its multipliers are shown in the table below:

f.effects:
Upgrades ores based on their value
(See Overview)

x.t: The Ore Cannon can be used to launch ores into this upgrader, upgrading the ores much faster. This is especially useful if you only have 1-2 Way-Up-High Upgraders.

quote: A brilliant display of technology that produces $27,000 of osmium ore every time it is fueled by coal ore.
overview: The Industrial Osmium Mine is an Advanced Industrial Dropper. Like all other Industrial Droppers, you input coal into the purple processing part, and the mine produces 1 ore.

quote: A larger version of the plutonium mine that produces large ore when the buttons on the back of the machine are clicked.
overview: The Plutonium Excavator is an Intermediate Excavator Dropper and is the third obtainable excavator from the shop. When paired with a cell furnace, this mine can quickly boost the player to early mid-game. You have to click a button for it to drop ores.

quote: A more advanced furnace that offers a huge bonus for ore dropped directly into it.
overview: The Cell Incinerator is a Novice cell furnace. It's the second cell furnace in the shop, and is quite useful for players who are starting out in the game.

f.effects: Processes unupgraded ore at x200 its value

quote: An old and bulky upgrader with a very slow conveyor. Don't be fooled though, this machine packs a punch.
overview:
The Digital Ore Cleaner is an Advanced upgrader. This upgrader is very useful for entering the billions in Miner's Haven.
It upgrades ore depending on its ore value, as listed below:

f.effects: See overview

quote: A conveyor that moves ore at incredible speeds, however it takes up a ton of space.
overview:
The Nuclear Conveyor is a Novice conveyor that has the sixth fastest conveyor speed in Miner's Haven. It was once the fastest conveyor until the Storage Conveyor was released to players who purchased artifacts, with a speed of 790%; thereafter the Heavenly Conveyor was released, with a speed of 1000%. In 2017, the Ultimate Conveyor was added with a Conveyor speed of 820%. A variety of event conveyors were later added with similar speeds, with the DECADE HAVEN CONVEYOR topping them at 1000%.
The Nuclear Conveyor has double-sided restrictions to balance for its absurdly high speed. The placement restriction only partially restricts portable upgraders such as the Big Bad Blaster and Dragon Blaster. It's good if you need a faster conveyor to stop ores from burning or being destroyed.

quote: FREEEEEEEEEDOM!
overview:
The Second Amendment is an Exotic wall with a minigun weapon on it, added in the 2015 August-September Updates, then removed on April 2016 due to the removal of combat, and re-added on 25 December, 2019. It can be obtained from Gift of Patriots.
The turret requires a player to operate it. Upon mounting themselves on the turret, they are given a tool in their inventory which allows them to aim and fire with the turret. Players that are hit are sent flying across the map, as this item's knockback is as strong as 'Murica's spirit.

f.drawbacks: Requires a Ladder or Staircase Wall to climb and control this item.

quote: A portable device that can be clipped onto the side of a conveyor. Upgrades ore by 15% with no limit. Ore can only be upgraded 10 times by a Portable upgrader.
overview:
The Portable Ore Refiner is a Novice portable upgrader added during the Initial Release.
It multiplies ore value by x1.15 (15%), up to 10 times, for a maximum total of ~x4.046. It is also a portable item and can easily be incorporated into a setups. Upgrade tags are shared between the Portable Ore Enhancer, Portable Ore Stopper, and the Portable Tractor Beam.

f.effects: Increases ore value by 15%

quote: A small machine that quadruples the value of every fourth ore that passes through.
overview:
The Plasma Iron Polisher is a Novice upgrader that was added during the initial release of the game.
Despite what is stated in its description, it quadruples (x4) the value of every 10 th ore that passes, NOT every 4 th ore. However, it is not very effective because it will not upgrade all ores that enter; only 1/10. As a result, players can use multiple Plasma Iron Polishers to increase the chance of upgrading ores, or use 10 to guarantee all ore will be upgraded.
Even if an ore has already been upgraded, it will still count towards charging up this item for another ore that has not been upgraded.

f.effects:
Charged
• Beam will be Pink
• Multiplies ore value by x4
Uncharged
• Beam will be dark
• Ore value is not multiplied
• Requires 9 ore to recharge
f.drawbacks: Every 10th ore is multiplied

quote: A massive furnace that multiplies the value of ore by six. Gives 4 Points per 100 ore.
overview: The Heavenly Forge is an Advanced furnace. This furnace is commonly used in early-game setups. It adds $1k to the ore value and the processes it at a x6 multiplier.

f.effects: Adds $1k to ore value and then processes ore at x6 its value

quote: A survival tent with toy rifles inside! Fun for scaring your friends!
overview: The Hunting Tent is a Epic Weapon giver that gives hunting rifles. It was previously Collectible-tier when combat was removed and before that it was Enlisted-tier and was able to deal massive damage and knockback, but it has been retired to a social item. In Part III of the 2019 Christmas Update, the Revolver Rack was brought back into the shop as a Common-tier item.

f.effects: Grants a toy rifle

quote: A powerful upgrader that only turns on at night time. Upgrades ores by 75% with no limit. Can only upgrade ores three times.
overview:
The Lunar Refiner is a Contraband upgrader added in the Initial Release.
Unlike almost all of the other upgraders in Miner's Haven, it only turns on at night time. When it is activated, it upgrades ores by doubling their value with no money limit, and can be used up to 3 times for a max upgrade of x8.

f.effects:
Doubles ore value
Max upgrade of x8 when used three times
f.drawbacks: Only works at night

quote: An ancient conveyor with strange markings on the side... has very tall walls and works faster than regular conveyors.
overview: The Ancient Conveyor is a Redeemed Conveyor that you can only obtain from codes. These codes usually give around 15 conveyors. This conveyor is known for having a fast conveyor with high walls. The symbol on the walls is the Twitter logo which can be difficult to view most of the time due to the lack of contrast in the background.

x.t:
The Ancient Conveyor was one of the more fan-demanded items, and thus had brought seven codes into existence which gave Ancient Conveyors.
Note: All the codes are currently expired.
Without using any dupe bug, the maximum amount of Ancient Conveyors you can obtain (assuming if you redeemed all codes) is 106.

quote: An oddly-shaped upgrader that increases the value of ore by 40% up to $1sx.
overview: The Advanced Ore Atomizer is a Mythic-tier upgrader added in The Overnight Update. It is an S-bend shaped upgrader. It increases the value of ore by 40% up to $1sx.

f.effects: Increases ore value by 40%

quote: Basic part used to move ores from droppers and other machines to furnaces. The Conveyor is a key part of every factory.
overview:
The Basic Conveyor is a Basic conveyor that is the first conveyor a player has access to.
When you start the game for the first time, and after rebirthing, you receive ten of these. They are a key item for setups, as they help move ores around, especially for changing the direction that ores travel. They are also one of the few conveyors without walls on its side.

quote: A conveyor for those who like to live dangerously. Shuttles ores across your base quickly and efficiently. Unboxed from the Shoddy Crate in the 2015 Holiday Event.
overview: The Storage Conveyor is a Fabled conveyor from the Artifact: Shoddy Crate on Black Friday. It looks like a conveyor made of wood with exactly 4 crates on the side. It is slightly faster in speed but smaller in size to the Nuclear Conveyor, therefore making it preferred over the latter.

quote: Rapidly produces osmium ore when activated by the remote radio.
overview: The Remote Osmium Mine is an Advanced remote dropper, with an ore value of $25k. Despite having a higher ore value than the Remote Opal Mine, opal is used more often by players using farming setups.

quote: A military-made conveyor belt that moves ores at twice the speed of normal conveyors.
overview: The Military Grade Conveyor is a Basic Conveyor that moves 100% (previously 50%) faster than the regular conveyor speed. The Military Grade Conveyor also has walls unlike the Basic Conveyor that prevent ore from falling off and despawning. This item is almost an upgraded version of the Walled Conveyor.

quote: A large ramp without a converter.
overview:
The Large Conveyor Ramp is an Intermediate conveyor that can load ore onto raised-ier conveyors such as the Raised-ier Conveyor, all 3 Two-Level Conveyor Pieces, Way-Up-High upgraders and the Ore Recliner.
It is a variant of the Large Converter Ramp, but this ramp does not possess a wedge to funnel ore to one direction or side.

quote: What's more uncertain than a Schrodinger? One that's on fire!!!?!?!?!?!?!!
overview:
The Flaming Schrodinger is a Reborn schrodinger, the variant of Schrodinger Evaluator.
It has fire on each of the blue tubes on the side and the sides also have a rust texture.

f.effects: (see overview)
f.drawbacks: Possibility of destruction, flinging and explosions.

x.t: Explosions have a small chance (close to 1 in 10 [estimate]) of destroying target ores, and they may eject nearby ores out of the evaluator with extreme force.

quote: Analyzes ore and uses their data to advance the base. Awards 25 points per 25 ore. Process ore at 1/4th value.
overview: The Basic Research Center is a Basic research center. It is the first Research Center you can buy and it gives 25 points for every 25 ores processed in it. (1 point per ore.)

f.effects: Processes ores at x1 their value

quote: A professional doesn't let any of their precious ore go to waste, and neither does this conveyor.
overview: The Walled Conveyor is a Basic conveyor that is simply a duplicate of the Basic Conveyor but has walls attached to it to prevent ores from tumbling out.

quote: |Super advanced technology that teleporters ore to a receiver. If more than 1 receiver is down, it will pick one at random. REQUIRES A RECEIVER TELEPORTER.|Sender|A wide conveyor that teleported ore appears at. Requires a sender teleporter to work. If there is more than one receiver, teleports will pick them at random.|Receiver
overview: The Blue Teleporter is an Intermediate teleporter set, like other coloured teleporters, is used to teleport ore from the sender to the receiver.

f.effects: Teleports ore from sender to receiver.

quote: Send your ores to a better place with the power of mother nature. The pretty leaves and grass will return 15x the ore's value using photosynthisis. [sic] Gives 6 Points per 80 ore.
overview:
The Dream-Maker is an Epic furnace available in the Shop.
It processes ore at a multiplier of 15x.

f.effects: Processes ore at x15 their value

quote: A massive furnace that harnesses the power of other dimensions to quadruple to value of processed ores. Gives 3 Points per 100 ore.
overview:
The Quantum Processor is an Intermediate furnace. The Quantum Processor has a similar theme to the Quantum Research Center and the Cell Processor.
The Quantum Processor has three purple-colored tanks attached to it, two small tanks and a large tank. Besides the tanks, it looks similar to the basic furnace.

f.effects: Processes ore at x4 value

quote: A shielded conveyor helps ensure you don't accidently [sic] drop any ore.
overview:
The Raised Shielded Conveyor is an Uncommon-tier raised conveyor with blue tilted walls. Its design attracts users due to it being a great replacement for the Conveyor Wall, and was used as a wall before the Conveyor Wall was added. However, the conveyors higher than this item are much more expensive.
Along with a handful of other items, the picture is a little incorrect. In this one, the slanted walls are much smaller than they really are.

quote: A miner's first best friend! Place this down to start making money.
overview:
The Basic Iron Mine is a Basic dropper. It is one of the starter items that new Miner's Haven players obtain upon joining, alongside the Basic Furnace and 10 Basic Conveyors.
When purchasing 99 Basic Iron Mines at once, there is a 1/500 chance to receive a Bazingium Mine.

quote: Osmium is a tiny but extremely powerful mine. It's also really rare. Like REALLY rare.
overview:
The Osmium Mine is an Advanced dropper that was released in the initial version of Miner's Haven.
With a slow ore production speed, the Osmium Mine has a fair $15k ore value to help players propel themselves into the further trillions, and possibly the quadrillions. Its slow ore production speed may seem a disadvantage at first, but can be adapted with by using several more in a setup.

quote: Give your ore as offerings to the gods and you will be rewarded. Rewarded with 25x the ores' value, that is. Gives 7 points for every 75 ore.
overview: The Shrine of Penitence is an Epic furnace that processes ore at 25x their value. It is commonly used at the end of first-life setups due to its strong early-game multiplier.

f.effects: Processes ores at 25x their value

quote: An ancient mine quite literally haunted by the ghosts of the people it's killed. No one has ever seen this mine's ore and lived to tell the tale.
overview:
The Spookmaster-5000 is an Exotic dropper added in the 2015 Halloween Event.
It produces nearly-invisible ores that are worth a constant value of $950M. It also has a very fast production rate of 1 ore every 0.3 seconds.
It has been officially stated, by OutOfOrderFoxy, this item (and a few other items) will NOT be returning.

f.other_notes: Ore has 0.99 (99%) transparency

quote: A powerful upgrader with no limits and potential for high upgrades. Requires power from clicks to operate.
overview:
The Lightningbolt Refiner is a Reborn-tier upgrader that was added on November 1st, 2015 at the end of the Spooky Update.
The Lightningbolt Refiner can only be activated by pressing your [Z] key while next to it, however it used to be activated with the green button on the side.
If the upgrader is activated, ores that touch it will have their value multiplied by an integer value from 2 to 7.
Using this device (or any member of its family) multiple times, without using a resetting device, has a chance of destroying ore.
The chance of ore getting destroyed is calculated by (x-2)/(x+2), where x is the xth upgrade, for all x>=3.

f.effects: • Multiplies ore value by an integer multiplier from x2 to x7
f.drawbacks:
• Chance to destroy ore processed the 3rd and subsequent times by this or Lightningbolt Predictor.
• Chance increases with more upgrades.
• Large ore cannot fit.

quote: A frozen wonder that processes flaming ore at incredible values.
overview: The Frozen Justice is a Reborn-tier furnace which benefits from flaming ore. This furnace can process ore in two different ways; normally, it processes ores at x10 its value. However, if the ore is on fire, it processes ore at x26 its value.

f.effects:
• Processes normal ores at x10
• Processes flaming ores at x26

quote: Radiation is rad. A glowing mine that applies a random amount of upgrades to its ore before it even comes out.
overview: The Radium Mine is a Premium mine that was released on Part II of the 2015 Winter Event. It was first revealed on Berezaa's Twitter. Every 4 seconds it drops yellow glowing ores worth $1k-$3M, all with a random amount of upgrade counters (thus it is not always compatible with cell furnaces). It is worth 185 uC and can be bought in the uC shop.

quote: The mistakes we made, the people we lost. We will use that pain to our advantage. Requires very expensive ore to unlock its true potential.
overview:
The Sunken Past is a Vintage furnace added on 11 March, 2016.
As of 14 October, 2016, The Sunken Past has taken on an inconsistent ore multiplier, usually processing at around x20 to x30. Berezaa has stated in a stream that he has not so much as touched the Sunken Past since its release. Previously, it processed ores at x50.
After the Easter Update the Sunken Past now processes all ores, but ores under $50B are processed with a multiplier between x3 to x8.

f.effects:
• Subtracts $50B from the ore value then processes at x20 to x30.
• Any ores worth under $50B will be processed with a multiplier between x3 to x8.

submission.name: Sunken Dreams
submission.effects: Processed ore based on the player's number of rebirths with a cap of 100x.

quote: A highly sophisticated device that tags ore with satellite that allows you to track an ore's value.
overview:
The Ore Tracker is an Intermediate utility as of New Heights update and was one of the first Contraband-tier items to be sold by The Masked Man before. It was added in the Outdoors Update but was first seen the day after on 6th May 2016.
This item was purchased with either money or RP but can then only be bought with Shards of Life. It is now purchasable in the Shop for $750M. When ores pass-through this conveyor, blue text will show up above the ore that displays how much the tagged ore is currently worth.

f.effects: Tracks ore value in blue text

quote: A tiny upgrader that only covers part of the conveyor. Any ore that passes through gets a big upgrade.
overview: The Fine-Point Upgrader is a Basic upgrader] that adds $10 to an ore's value. It's the first upgrader you can purchase. The upgrader only covers a small part of the conveyor (around 1/3), making it somewhat difficult to upgrade ores with this.

f.effects: Adds $10 to the ore's value
f.drawbacks: If ores miss the green upgrade beam, they won't get upgraded

quote: What a time to be in love! If you only have 1 particle giver placed, it will be your default particle.
overview:
The Lovestruck Particle is a Premium-tier particle giver.
This item can be purchased for 100 uC at the shop and can grant your character pink heart particles when touched. Users may only be granted particles once per life. It will also play a sound when it affects a user.

f.effects: Gives the player red heart particles

quote: U r dark n mysterious loominati 3l33t. If you only have 1 particle giver placed, it will be your default particle.
overview: The Loominati Particle is a Premium particle giver added in the Xbox Update on 31st March, 2016. This machine makes Illuminati particles come out of your character once you touch the pad.

f.effects: Infuses the player with Illuminati particles

quote: Uses unexplainable science (basically magic) to super-size a single atom and farm it for super powerful ore.
overview:
The Atomium Mine is a Reborn mine added on 7 th April, 2016.
The Atomium Mine is a small dropper with very valuable ore, as well as a fast drop rate. In the Reincarnation Update, this received a unique gimmick; its ores receive gradual upgrades for a short period of time when the ore receives sparkles. Each upgrade from the sparkling effect has a chance to destroy the ore, however, it is not stackable with Resetting Devices.
Splitting Atomium's ore with an Ore Sawmill or an Ore Chainsaw will result in an explosion, resulting in a destructive drawback.
(Item requires further testing)

f.effects: Sparkles give 1.05x upgrades every 0.25s for a duration between 5s and 10s
f.drawbacks:
• Each upgrade from sparkles has a chance to destroy the ore
• Incompatible with ⟦Ore Sawmill⟧, ⟦Pizza Cutter⟧ and ⟦Ore Chainsaw⟧

submission.name: Atomic Mine
submission.description: By pulling all of the atoms closer to it's core, it is able to compress them into one expsensive solid block.

quote: An advanced machine that increases your character's speed by 8 and allows you to jump higher. You can only be infused once.
overview: The Heavenly Infuser is a Premium-tier infuser that gives your character +8 Walkspeed and +15 Jump Power. Players may only be infused once per life, or twice with a Resetting Infuser.

f.source:
Shop
Mystery Boxes
----Redeeming the code: Rthro
f.effects: +8 Walkspeed, +15 Jump Power
f.drawbacks: Player can only be infused once without a ⟦Resetting Infuser⟧.

quote: A haunted machine that allows your character to jump much higher but decreases your speed. You can only be infused once.
overview: The Cursed Infuser is a Premium infuser that gives your character +32 Jump Power, but -6 Walkspeed. Players may only be infused once per life, or twice with a Resetting Infuser.

f.effects: Drastically increases jump height by 32; subtracts 6 walkspeed.
f.drawbacks: Player can only be infused once without a ⟦Resetting Infuser⟧.
f.other_notes: Replaced the ⟦Explosive Infuser⟧

quote: A special machine that lets your character jump higher. You can only be infused once.
overview: The Thrust Infuser is a Premium infuser that gives your character +15 Jump Power. Players may only be infused once per life, or twice with a Resetting Infuser.

f.effects: Increases player's jump height by 15
f.drawbacks: Player can only be infused once without a ⟦Resetting Infuser⟧.

quote: A raised upgrader that increases the value of an ore by 25% up to three times with no cash limit.
overview:
The Ore Zapper is an Advanced upgrader.
A Conveyor Ramp and Raised Converter, or even a Large Conveyor Ramp, and placing the zapper one space after, is recommended in order to reach the upgrade beam. It multiplies ore value by 1.25x, up to 3 times, resulting in a total multiplier of ~1.95x.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by 1.25x.

submission.name: Ore Zapper, Advanced Furnace, and more

quote: This item has been retired.
overview: The Advanced Furnace is a Basic furnace that has been retired. It has a similar aesthetic to the Basic Furnace, but has additional mechanical parts on its sides, limiting the areas from which ore can be accepted. It processes ore at 1.5x its value.

f.effects: Processes ore at x1.5
f.retire_reason: It was redundant because the Ore Incinerator existed.

submission.name: Ore Zapper, Advanced Furnace, and more (pack)

quote: Proper lighting is cool and all but so is making your base look like an evil lair.
overview: The Evil Flood Light is a Premium flood light added in the Xbox Update.

f.effects: Emits a decent amount of eerie red light in the direction it's facing.

quote: Spring is coming! Your little bee friends are buzzing about again, upgrading any ore they see by increasing and then tripling its value! Bees can only upgrade once. April 2016 exclusive.
overview:
The Beehive is an Exotic upgrader that was added in the April 2016 Updates.
It adds $10k to the ore value then multiplies it by x3.5. Require a Large Conveyor Ramp to reach.
It can boost the multiplier of the Deluxe Beehive and the Honeycomb Cake if used before it.

f.effects:
Adds $10k to ore value
Multiplies ore value by x3.5
f.bok_multiplier:
⟦Deluxe Beehive⟧: x2 to base multi
⟦Honeycomb Cake⟧: +1

submission.name: Honeycomb Upgrader
submission.description:
"For summer update?? Even if berezaa is still thinking of updating M.H. Shop item.
[Fixed a mistake I didn't even notice]
Thanks again for taking berezaa :^)"

quote: By far one of the best infuser machines, greatly increases your character's speed and jump without penalty. You can only be infused once per life.
overview: The Infinite Infuser is a Premium infuser in the game, which gives your character +9 Walkspeed and +27 Jump Power. Players may only be infused once per life, or twice with a Resetting Infuser.

f.effects: +9 Walkspeed & +27 Jump Power
f.drawbacks: Player can only be infused once without a ⟦Resetting Infuser⟧.

quote: This item has been retired.
overview:
The Solar Large Upgrader is a Proficient upgrader. It works exactly like the Large Ore Upgrader, increasing ore value by x1.35, it also looks like the Large Ore Upgrader, but has 2 solar panels attached to the sides. It is 150% faster than the Basic Conveyor's speed. These attributes are similar to the Solar Conveyor.
This item was reworked a bit in a Unknown Update to buff it for the people who already have it.

f.effects: Increases ore value by x1.35.

quote: R.I.P. TIX 2016. Scans ore that passes through and produces a tix for every 10 ore that pass through. Tix forever!
overview:
The Ore Tixicator is an Exotic mingrader that was available from 21 April to 5 May, 2016.
For every 6 ores put through, 3 Tix are created, each worth the average of the 6 ores. Tix ores have the same properties as a replicated ore from Ore Replicator.

f.effects:
For every 6 ores:
• 3 Tix bars are produced.
• Each tix bar is worth the average of the 6 ores.
f.drawbacks: Tix bars retain Machine tags.

submission.name: Ticket Currency Upgrader
submission.description: This abanoned[sic] currency has been hacked into an upgrader to represent the memory of the history of tickets
submission.effects: Upgrades ore by x2

quote: An upgrader made just for Executive Miners. Greatly upgrades one ore every 5 seconds.
overview: The Executive Pillars is a Fabled upgrader that is obtained by owning the Executive Membership Gamepass. It multiplies ore value by x5.5. It used to only upgrade one ore per 2 seconds, but this was removed in the Valentines Day 2020 update. This item was added on April 21st, 2016 and it was first revealed on Berezaa's Twitter. He did a developer stream on the date before working on it. Executive Pillars is the second item that is exclusive to executive miners, after the Executive Infuser.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by 5.5x

submission.name: The Devils Past
submission.description: So Powerful Even The Devil Couldn't Have Forged It Himself
submission.effects: Upgrades ore by x10

quote: The clockwork is a massive underground machine that's existed for thousands of years. Harness that power.
overview:
Clockwork is a Reborn upgrader that requires ores to hit a fine point for it to be upgraded by x5. This item was added in the April 2016 Updates and was shown off in Berezaa's devstream the same day.
Massive mines, with the exception of the notoriously humongous Tiny Iron Mine, are great with the Clockwork because the ores are larger than normal ores, making them more likely to hit the upgrader. Centering Conveyors are also recommended to be used before this upgrader.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by x5
f.drawbacks: Fine-point; requires ore to be centered

submission.name: Advanced Lightning Super
submission.effects: Multiplies ore value by x6

quote: Send your ore on the final journey and hope for its return. Only one ore can be sent at a time.
overview:
The Eternal Journey is a Reborn-tier furnace. It was added on April 21st, 2016. This item was first unveiled in Berezaa's developer stream, the same day it was added to Miner's Haven. Eternal Journey was the first Reborn-tier item to be exclusively available to those over life 100.
Although this furnace can process ores at 100x its value, it has a major disadvantage: the ore that enters the furnace turns black and sits for around 1–15 seconds, and the furnace also turns black (an indication that the ore is being processed). Any ore that enters the furnace while it's black will be destroyed instead of processed.
This furnace is recommended for processing ONE very valuable ore, so it would be smart to use a mine like the Hades' Fang on a Reversible Conveyor directly before the furnace. After all ores are condensed into one valuable one, you switch the reversible conveyor and process that ore.
Alternatively, use another furnace that is not able to accidentally destroy ores, as the choice of furnace does not have significant multipliers in the grand scheme of things.

f.effects:
Processes ore at x100 its value. Only one ore can be processed at a time
Takes 15 seconds or less to process
f.drawbacks: Needs to process for a period of time before being able to accept another ore

quote: A mysterious tear in the earth that appears to function like a cell furnace. Gives crazy returns on unupgraded ore.
overview:
The Fracture is a Reborn cell furnace that was released on 24 April , 2016 and was first revealed on Berezaa's Twitter account.
It can be difficult to get ores into the fracture due to it's unique form factor and hitbox. One of the best ways to use The Fracture in earlier lives is to use a Yunium Mine, as the random velocity from the mine can launch ores directly into the processing part of the cell furnace.

f.effects: Raises ore value to the power of 1.12, then multiplies that by x300M (orevalue1.12*300M)
f.drawbacks: Only accepts non-upgraded ores

submission.name: The Fracture
submission.effects: Eats a certain amount of ores and then decides, through random math if it spits them on a fiery explosion or 'digests' them for a value greater than the Cell Particalizer.

quote: An old and scary cell furnace, possibly once owned by some old guy with white hair.
overview:
The Thingamajig is a Vintage cell furnace. It was first unveiled on Berezaa's late night stream on April 23rd, 2016.
It replaced The Second Amendment on the same day it was revealed, and players with said vintage got this item for free, with no unboxing required. However, The Second Amendment was removed from all players' inventories and boxes. It was added back during the Christmas Update 2019 and was unwrapped in the Gift of Patriots, but removed later in the Easter Event 2021
After the buff, ores with higher values get bigger bonuses. The first mine to have bigger bonuses when used with this item instead of Nature's Grip is Plutonium Excavator, producing 7.2% more money. This cell furnace is also one of few to use exponents.

f.effects:
Raises ore value to the power of 1.1, then processes ore at x $35M
(orevalue1.1 x $35M)

submission.name: Ominus Cell Furnace
submission.description: Ominus Cell Furnace is a furnace that has just been discoverd!

quote: A new and sleek upgrader that upgrades ore at any level several times. Requires constant coal fuel supply.
overview:
The Industrial Ore Welder is an Intermediate upgrader, first unveiled the day it was added on Berezaa's Twitter. It was added in the April 2016 Updates.
The Industrial Ore Welder requires coal to function, like the Igneous Lightning. When unpowered, it does nothing and has a slow conveyor. When powered, its conveyor speed is increased and multiplies ore value by 2x the 1st time and 1.75x beyond that. The more times an ore passes through
the more risk there is of it being rejected, this caps at 5 upgrades.
The total multiplier of this when used many times is ~x18.758.
Once coal ore enters its input slot, it is powered up for 5 seco

f.effects:
1st upgrade:
multiplies ore value by x2
2nd upgrade onwards:
multiply ore value by x1.75
Total upgrade:
multiplies ore value by ~x18.758

submission.name: Industrial Ore Purifier v2
submission.description: A very powerful and large upgrader that requires coal to power it! Upgrades ore by 2 times when its powered
submission.effects: x2 to ore value

quote: An old item which has been removed from the shop.
overview:
The Conveyor Splitter was an Advanced conveyor that was designed so that ore would be split into two sections. Low life players would be lucky to receive this item in their Daily Gifts as selling would be enough to achieve Rebirth.
Before the item was removed, it could also be used as an Centering Conveyor, doing a better job than the Conveyor Converter. As of The Ultimate Update on 3 August, 2017; the item's tier and description were updated.

submission.name: Miner's Haven items for berezaa (pack)
submission.description: These are low-level items (most of the custom items I see are high-end and I decided some low-end stuff would be nice too). A small conveyor, a conveyor splitter and a lithium mine.

quote: A high-tech machine that constantly attempts to scan ore. Ore can only be scanned once.
overview:
The Ore Scanner is a Novice upgrader that multiplies ore value by x2.5.
The Ore Scanner is essentially a fine-point upgrader with a beam that moves side to side. This can prove inconvenient for users because there is a factor of luck required to get the ore scanned successfully.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by x2.5
f.drawbacks:
Ores can be only scanned once
(Except by Plasma Scanner)

quote: This item has been retired and is not longer in the game
overview: The Solar Conveyor is a Proficient conveyor. It moves ores 340% (3.4x) faster than a Basic Conveyor. This conveyor's model is combined with the Large Ore Upgrader's to create the Solar Large Upgrader.

quote: A machines that mass-produces the UZI, a modern rapid-fire weapon with high damage and short range.
overview:
The UZI Manufacturer is a Premium-tier weapon giver purchasable for 80 uC in the premium category of the shop. It gives the player UZIs that are able to deal damage and Knock-back.
It has returned to a Premium tier item from years of being unobtainable and a collectible. This weapon giver is still fully functional. Premium users get this for free.

f.effects: Grants the player an Uzi

quote: The gate of the eclipse is guarded by the Eclipse Security Administration. Who knows what they do to your ore.
overview:
The Gate of Eclipse is a Reborn upgrader added on the 28 th of April, 2016.
It multiplies ore value by x4 during the day, and x10 during the night.

f.effects:
Day: x4
Night: x10

submission.name: Gate of Eclipse
submission.description: All fall silent as the two align. Darkness dawns.

quote: A monstrous merge of mine and machine. Promises great profits to those who can harness its unpredictable ore. Increased ore value when used with cannons.
overview:
The Yunium Mine is a Reborn mine that was added on 28 th April 2016 and was first unveiled on Berezaa's Twitter.
The Yunium Mine produces cell-compatible ore with relatively high value, but with the prominent downside of ore velocity randomization upon being produced. This makes it slightly more difficult to use.
This dropper sees most use when paired with Cell Furnaces, not only for its cell-compatible ores with good value, but the walls of a cell furnace are typically quite high, and thus remedies the problem of ores not touching the furnace part.
The following are the cannon buffs received by the Yunium Mine:

f.effects: Buff from Cannon upgrades
f.drawbacks: Ore shoots in random directions when dropped
f.other_notes: Ore has 0.3 (30%) transparency
