quote: |A glowing teleporter that only sends ores to matching green receivers.|Sender|A glowing teleport pad that only accepts ores from green teleporters.|Receiver
overview:
The Green Teleporter is a Premium teleporter set, like other coloured teleporters, is used to teleport ore from the sender to the receiver.
The only noticeable difference is that they cost uC, similarly to the Orange Teleporter set. This makes it reborn-proof, which can be useful for insta-load setups.

quote: The great sage seeks ore with experience, granting higher values to ore that's been upgraded more times.
overview:
The Sage Redeemer is a Reborn-tier furnace added on April 28th, 2016, first unveiled on Berezaa's Twitter.
The Sage Redeemer functions differently compared to other furnaces; it processes ore value based on how many times it has been upgraded divided by two, thus meaning that it cannot accept ore that has not yet been upgraded.

f.effects:
Processes ore by the number of times it has been upgraded divided by 2
Capped at 50x ore value (100 upgrades)

submission.name: Frog Collector
submission.description:
it rlly cool in miner haven
it was running with upgrader

quote: An antique split-personality furnace that looks and acts differently during the night and day.
overview:
The Solar Flare is a Reborn furnace that requires the player to be life 50 or above to acquire. What sets it apart from other furnaces is that it has different effects during day and night.
It processes ore by 25x their value during the day, and by a random value between 0-50x times during the night.

f.effects:
• Daytime: Multiplies ores by x25.
• Nighttime: Multiplies ores by x0 to x50.
f.drawbacks: Has a chance to do x0 on night time.
f.item_vfx: Furnace changes theme depending on daytime or nighttime

quote: Ruby is scarce here. The ruby used to make this wall was imported from the Azure Mines.
overview: The Ruby Wall is a Premium Wall that is a ruby colored reskin of common walls. It serves no purpose other than keeping players outside of a player's base, and blocking ores from dying, by things like the Dragon Blaster that can fling ores. The walls keep the ores on the conveyor.

f.effects: Keeps players out and stops ores from flying away from fast conveyors.

quote: Applies huge upgrades, however the ore becomes radioactive and has to hit a furnace in 6 seconds or it will explode!
overview:
The Radioactive Refiner is an Intermediate upgrader available in the shop.
It multiplies ore value by x3. It also apply Radioactive, ores with this effect will explode if not sold or cleanse.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by x3
f.drawbacks: Radiation explodes ore after 6 seconds (ore is destroyed)

quote: "This item is no longer in use and will be destroyed when you Rebirth.
overview:
The Reverse Corner is a Basic conveyor, similar to the Conveyor Corner, but directs ores in the opposite direction of the Conveyor Corner. While it took up more space than a Corner made from Basic Conveyors, it was simpler to build and ores would not get stuck when moving to the part on which the ore would turn to another direction.
The Conveyor Corner and this item were removed in The Resurrection Update.

quote: A conveyor ramp allows you to raise ore from one conveyor belt and drop it onto another one. A very useful piece.
overview: The Conveyor Ramp is an Intermediate conveyor ramp. It can either be used to place ores onto a Raised Mini Conveyor or to drop onto another conveyor. This technique is usually used when hitting fine-point upgraders, but has been outdated by the more-expensive Centering Conveyor.

f.conveyor_speed: Flat part is 100%, angled part is 150%

quote: An advanced and quick conveyor that projects tall shields to prevent any ore from escaping.
overview:
The Shielded Conveyor is a Basic conveyor used when you definitely want to keep your ores inside the conveyors. It is sometimes used instead of Raised Shielded Conveyors.
Using a Conveyor Ramp to bring ores to this conveyor doesn't work; the walls are taller than that of the Conveyor Ramp. A Large Conveyor Ramp or Hydraulic Ramp is needed to drop ores from the side.

quote: A conveyor that can be used with Raised-ier conveyors to create multi-level ore flow.
overview:
The Two-Level Conveyor is an Intermediate conveyor with two conveyors at different elevations.
Because of its complexity in setups, it is very rarely used.

quote: Let any would-be-invaders know that you are a fearsome Pirate and will probably blox them very easily.
overview: The Pirate Wall is a Contraband wall. This wall formerly can be bought from the The Masked Man, or obtained by specific Mystery Boxes.

f.effects:
Keeps players out from your base.
Stops ores flying away from fast conveyors.

quote: The legendary blade Excalibur stores the value of ores that are sacrificed to it and stacks it onto all new ores for a short time.
overview:
The Excalibur is an Exotic-tier furnace that was exclusive to May 2016 and was introduced in the Outdoors Update.
Unlike the more straightforward furnaces in Miner's Haven, this does not multiply ore value by a specific value. Instead, Excalibur has a unique effect where it stacks value from ore previously processed by the furnace with other ores processed at a max of 14 seconds after it.
By processing a high-value ore and then putting $1 ores after it, all of the $1 ores are now worth the same as the aforementioned high-value ore you inserted into the furnace.
Droppers with hi

f.effects: Ores processed within 14 seconds of each other have their values stacked together
f.drawbacks: Requires large amount of ore for efficient usage

submission.name: Excalibur
submission.description: Excaliburs great power can now be harnessed by this furnace

quote: The gorgeous diamond falls processes ore at twenty-one times their normal value. It's also great to look at.
overview:
The Diamond Falls is a Contraband furnace sold by The Masked Man. It was the first of four items sold by him (May 6th to 8th, 2016) and the only one that did not cost Robux.
It processes ore at 21x their value, suitable for beginners.

f.effects: Processes ore value at 21x

submission.name: gravity falls
submission.description: I KNOW IT WAS FROM A FREE MODEL! Just i was dumb and lazy..

quote: A powerful conveyor that has double the speed of a regular conveyor without restricting either side.
overview:
The Plasma Conveyor is an Advanced conveyor that transports ore at 260% the speed of a Basic Conveyor. Its conveyor has a purple tint, the conveyor tab has extra mechanical parts, and it has a slight purple glow.
The Plasma Conveyor is commonly used in early-game Rebirth setups, especially when paired with Portable Ore Advancers.

quote: A small yet useful piece that can be placed on the side of conveyors to prevent ore from escaping.
overview:
The Conveyor Wall is an Intermediate utility wall that keeps ores from falling off a conveyor in place of a conveyor with a wall.
It can be used to make faster conveyors or corners safer, or for using in Blaster loops.

quote: This item has been retired.
overview:
The Corner Wall is a Basic wall that replaced the old corner walls. The problem was that the old corner walls took up unnecessary space, so the new corner wall was made, which doesn't take up more space than it needs.
The old corner walls took up an unnecessary 8x8 units, disallowing other items to be placed inside of it because of the hitbox.
This has since been replaced with wall segments.

quote: |A soda machine full of yummy Dr Berza soda. Not for human consumption!|Item Description|30mg of potassium in every drink!|In-game Tooltip
overview: The Dr.Berza Machine is a Mythic-tier soda dispenser that costs $13de. The price may not be worth it for users working on endgame setups and is found in the decoration section.

f.effects: Screen distortion, hallucinations and death.

quote: Super cheap but weak torches that automatically light at night-time, keeping your base bright all night!
overview:
The Giant Torch is a Basic decoration meant for lighting up small areas of base during the night. It is sold in the shop for $25.
It is the cheapest item in the decoration category. This torch is meant for low-level players and emits the least light. Three of these torches are also given to players when they join for the first time.

f.effects: Lights up an area around the torch.

quote: A heavy mine which has buttons that must be clicked in order to drop large gold ore.
overview: The Gold Excavator is a Basic excavator dropper. It is one of the seven excavator mines. It's quite large, and produces a large gold ore when you (or your friends) click it.

quote: A cursed infuser that grants +10 Speed at the cost of -25 MaxHealth. You can only be infused once.
overview: The Haunted Infuser is an Exotic infuser that was added in the first phase of the Spooky Update, on October 10th, 2015. During the second phase of the update, it was sold by the Headless Horseman NPC at the top of the mountain for between 350 and 1.2k uC. It gives your character +13 Walkspeed. Players may only be infused once per life, or twice with a Resetting Infuser.

f.effects: +13 Walkspeed
f.drawbacks: Player can only be infused once without a ⟦Resetting Infuser⟧.

quote: A massive super-sized torch plated in gold that lights up a massive amount of area in your base at night.
overview: The Magnificent Torch is a Premium Lighting item that lights an area around itself when night falls. This is similar to the Giant Torch, but the light covers a bigger area.

f.effects: Lights an area around it when night falls.

quote: The power of a black hole ripping apart an entire galaxy has been shrunken down into a small orb for you. Use it well.
overview: The Ore Quasar is a Vintage pulsar with the same purpose as the Ore Pulsar. It has a quick cooldown of 2 seconds, while having a blueish green orb instead of Ore Pulsar's reddish orange orb. It also has a stone base instead of a metal base. It was granted the ability to damage players after the 2015 Winter Event, but this feature has been removed since.

f.effects: Destroys all ore on base
f.drawbacks: 2s Cooldown
f.bok_multiplier:
⟦Interstellar Conqueror⟧ x1.8
⟦Gargantium Mine⟧: Grants Poison and Radioactive immunity

quote: An over-hanging scanner that perfectly clones any ore that passes through
overview:
The Ore Replicator is an Advanced utility which clones ores that successfully touch its green field. When the green fields comes into contact with an ore, a clone of the ore is produced from the spout located at the bottom of the replicator.
There are three ways that this scanner can be used. With a Large Conveyor Ramp in a regular setup (ores have to be 1x1x1 studs in size or more), with three Hydraulic Ramps (going up), or in front of the mine with the scanner right under the spout. The third method is good for when you have only one of a mine and want to make quick money.
This scanner can also be used when you're trying

f.effects: Duplicates ore
f.drawbacks:
Cannot clone the same ores more than once
Cannot duplicate clones
Removes all shields

quote: Uses super advanced ore thermo-crushing technology to upgrade ore from 30% up to $100Sp
overview:
The Ore Thermocrusher is a Divine-tier upgrader added in Part II of the Winter Event.
It increases ore value by 30%, up to $100Sp.

f.effects: Increases ore value by 30%

submission.name: Time Traveler
submission.description:
2x
Only resets tesla
submission.effects: Multiplies orevalue by x2

quote: An upgrader that harnesses micro-electronic technology to upgrade ores worth more than $1sp by 45% up to $1N.
overview:
The Ore Transistor is a Divine upgrader added in the Winter Update on December 13th, 2015.
The Ore Transistor multiplies ore value by x1.45 up to $1N. However, the ore must be worth at least $1Sp in order for the upgrade to be applied. It also requires a Large Converter Ramp.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by x1.45 up to $1N
f.drawbacks: Ore must be worth at least $1Sp

submission.name: Exponential Ore Upgrader
submission.description: "This Powerful Mine is Scary upgrading ores at 1.15 ^ (Exponential). Due to the Scary Nature of the Machine, it can only be used once."
submission.effects: Multiplies ors by the 1.15th power

quote: Cool party-styled boombox! Doesn't play any actual music though...
overview:
The Party Boombox is an Advanced decoration. During Alpha, the boombox played music on a local script, but it didn't work due to FilteringEnabled, so it was scrapped. The Berezaa Games Radio is its successor, though not having a physical form, and costs uC to use.
Despite its description of not playing any music, Berezaa has proposed to give the Party Boombox the function of allowing the player to access the Berezaa Games Radio when they have it down on their base.

quote: An advanced machine that heals its user by 1 hp every second until they die. You can only be infused once per life..
overview: The Regeneration Infuser was the only infuser that handled health regeneration, giving your character 1 HP/s natural regeneration. Players may only be infused once per life, or twice with a Resetting Infuser.

f.effects: User renegerates 1 HP per second

quote: An underworldly cell furnace that grants unspeakable bonuses to any ore that gets dropped in.
overview:
The Sacrificial Cell is a Proficient cell furnace, which was added to the game with the initial release.
This, along with the Sacrificial Altar and the Cursed Infuser, has an underworld theme.

f.effects: Processes un-upgraded ore at x50,000 their value

quote: A secure gate that allows you and any of your ROBLOX friends to enter. Completely and utterly incapacitates any intruders that try to enter but does not kill them.
overview: The Security Gate is a Novice gate added in the Initial Release. Laser lowers stranger health and speed upon touch.

f.effects: Laser lowers stranger health and speed upon touch.

quote: A triple coal mine haunted by the spirits of murdered pumpkins. A relic of the 2015 Halloween Event.
overview:
The Spooky Coal Mine is a Halloween reskin of the Triple Coal Mine that was available during the 2015 Spooky Update. The Spooky Coal Mine has a different appearance as seen in the image. The Spooky Coal Mine makes a light that is neither very bright nor very dim. When first released, it was only useful with industrial droppers and therefore wasn't widely used.
In the Halloween 2019 event, the drop rate was buffed from 3 ores every 4 seconds to 3 ores every 3 seconds.

f.source:
Pumpkin Box
Mystery Boxes
Premium Shop
f.effects: Produces 3 coal ores every 3 seconds.

quote: A spooky center that processes ore at x3 value, granting 50 points every 30 ore. Requires ore worth at least $1M.
overview: The Spooky Research Center is a Collectible Research Center that was added in the 2015 Halloween Event. It triples ore value and gives you 50 RP every 30 ores, but only if they are worth $1M or more.

f.effects: Processes ore at x3 value
f.drawbacks: Only accepts ores worth at least $1M.

quote: A modern mine that draws power from your base's unobtainium crystals. Ore comes out pre-upgraded.
overview:
The Unobtainium Mine is a Premium mine.
It doesn't work on Cell Furnaces and the ore is valued relative to the amount of Unobtanium Crystals you have.
The values are listed below:

f.ore_worth: Based on amount of uC you have.

quote: A conveyor without walls that moves ores very fast. This definitely breaks safety code.
overview:
The Unstable Conveyor is a Contraband conveyor that has exactly the same properties and design as the Basic Conveyor except that it is four times faster than a regular conveyor and that it's colored purple.
As of 27th March, 2016, this item has been retired from the shop and made Contraband-tier. The Masked Man originally sold it for Research Points RP, but now sells it for a 1 Shards of Life Shards of Life.

quote: A 3x2 conveyor as opposed to a 2x2 that can hold much bigger loads.
overview: The Wide Conveyor was a Collectible conveyor formerly bought from the shop for $6k and has the same speed as a Basic Conveyor. As the description suggests, the Wide Conveyor (due to its larger width) can hold a larger quantity of ores. A Conveyor Converter was able to transition ore back to a standard 2x2 conveyor. On 2 December, 2019, this item was removed from the shop due to OutOfOrderFoxy removing/adjusting all Wide Conveyors to normal-sized Conveyors.

quote: A slab of wood is easier on the feet than cold hard stone.
overview:
The Wood Flooring is a Basic flooring that can be placed under all other objects as long as the middle square is on an empty space.
It can be used to make a path through your base.

quote: A mysterious material that emits the most powerful earthly light known to man. Illuminates a massive amount of your base at nighttime.
overview:
The Worldly Illuminator is a Legendary decoration, or a lighting item, which cost $35.3Qn in the shop, added in the 2015 Summer Update.
Due to its massive lighting radius, you should need no other light source if you have some Worldly Illuminators. Although, the Octo Flood Light and the Icosahedron Flood Light are more effective light sources.

f.effects: Grants a massive amount of light during nighttime.

quote: A small raised conveyor that allows loads to be dumped onto lower conveyors.
overview:
The Raised Mini Conveyor is a Basic conveyor that you can use to drop ores down onto conveyors on the ground. It can be useful to save space with rows and columns of ore droppers. Despite the short walls on the conveyor, however, the ore has a much larger chance of bouncing off. It can catch ores from an Ore Replicator.
Players can use a Conveyor Ramp to get ores onto this conveyor, but they also have the option of dropping the ores on directly from the mine.

quote: An explosive machine that allows you to manually destroy all ore that you own. Useful for getting rid of clogged or escaped ore.
overview:
The Ore Pulsar is an Intermediate utility that clears all ores that weren't already processed by furnaces and were produced by your own droppers. It has a cooldown time of 32 seconds which can be bypassed by replacing it.
The Ore Pulsar is red/orange in color. It is activated by pressing the "Pulse" button, which should appear under your settings button on the left of the screen. Its Vintage counterpart is the Ore Quasar.

f.effects: Destroys all dropped ore.

quote: A scary-looking mine that produces ore worth an incalculable amount of money. Doesn't work with cell furnaces, for some reason. Immune to all types of radiation.
overview:
The Newtonium Mine is a Reborn dropper added in The Overnight Update.
Its ore value can vary from $100M to $5B.
The Newtonium Mine has a special feature shared with its evolved and fusion counterparts, that provides a buff to upgrades received from radioactive upgraders. The buffs are as follows;
The ores from this mine are also denser, making them less likely to be flung by cannons/colliders and explosions, the former of which makes it the ideal mine for early-mid game speed setups by pairing it with colliders and hydraulics on top to prevent flinging of the ores upwards.

quote: An ancient mine that's been lost of hundreds of years. Drops ore that doubles in size after 20 seconds, quadrupling the ore's value, no matter what it is at.
overview:
The Ol Faithful is a Vintage-tier mine. It is the first Vintage item available publicly and can only be obtained from Mystery Boxes.
After 20 seconds, ores from the 'Ol Faithful will grow to 1.5 times its size, and quadruple their ore value. This effect occurs every 20 seconds, up to 5 or 6 times.
The now larger ores are heavier, making them safer to use with Ore Cannons and Ore Colliders, and more resistant to being launched by explosions such as from blasters, but are more prone to being stuck in small gaps.
Ores will not grow if they are copied by an Ore Replicator

The Nature's Grip is a Reborn Cell Furnace with a natural forest-like appearance.
It processes ore worth less than $1k at x200B, and ore equal to or greater than $1k at x200M.
This item is extremely useful for players in their first few lives especially when paired with the Industrial Firecrystal Mine.

overview:
The Righteous Will is a Reborn infuser which gives your character a wide variety of effects, namely +12 Walkspeed and +15 Jump Power, +50 maximum health and immunity to explosions caused by Zwambies. It may also reduce explosion damage from players with the Executive Infuser. Players may only be infused once per life, or twice with a Resetting Infuser.
When berezaa released the Executive Infuser and Lucky Infuser in December 2015, it seemed like the Righteous Will was inferior but still had higher walkspeed than both infusers.
In the 2017 Easter Update, Righteous Will was buffed to have a jump heig

quote: A fresh upgrader that uses the power of pineapples to increase the value of ore by 100%. Comes with the purchase of a private island
overview:
The Pineapple Refiner is a pineapple-themed Collectible upgrader. It was inactive from October 10th, 2015 when Private Islands were discontinued until May 5th, 2016. This was when Private Islands were brought back as VIP servers.
Before it became inactive for 7 months, Pineapple Refiners were given out to players who rented a Private Island for 1 week. After it was brought back, players now have to pay R$100 for a VIP server to receive a Pineapple Refiner.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by x2

quote: A spooky upgrader that educates ores. It takes 5 seconds for ores to learn to become better, gaining a x5 boost. If their education is interrupted they are destroyed. Ores can normally only be educated once.
overview:
The Ore Illuminator is a Reborn-tier upgrader. It was added on 16 August 2015 in The Combat Update. The Ore Illuminator is a very common reborn item and can only be used once without a resetting device.
Ores cannot have their upgrade counter changed for 5 seconds or they will be destroyed. The Ore Illuminator will not destroy the ore if the upgrader increases the ore's upgrade counter by 0, which means you can use 0 Upgrade Counter Upgraders. The 7x upgrade will apply to the ore 6 seconds after it has been upgraded.
There are a number of setups players can have after an Ore Illuminator to move ore for five seconds without using up much space on their bases:
• 1 Conveyor Ramp and 7 Basic Conveyors.
• 1 Large Conveyor Ramp with 6 Basic Conveyors.
• You could also use a Reversible Conveyor to stop the ore. Make sure that there is a conveyor slowing the ore down before the Reversible Conveyor, or else there's a chance that ores would pass through the Reversible Conveyor.
• A conveyor ramp then a long but compact path of Tiny Conveyors.
• Putting an Ore Gate after the Ore Illuminator, block the ore for 5 seconds before opening the gate. This is by far the most space-saving and simplest method. (This is only recommended if you loop ore in the setup. If a dropper is continuously pumping ore, the Ore Gate will overflow)
• You can use the Proximated Ore Gate, save that none of your ores are going very fast and that they are not absolutely tiny.
This can +1000x to Book of Knowledge and give +5000x to Dark Illuminator.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by x7
f.drawbacks: Gives ores an "education" effect that lasts 5 seconds. If ores are upgraded during their education, they will be destroyed.

overview:
The Pirate's Loot Collector is a Premium cell furnace, processing ore at x1,500 their value.
Unlike most other cell furnaces, this cell furnace allows ore to have an upgrader counter of 0.2 instead of 0.

quote: Santa deemed that 2015 was a swell year for people around you. Santa rewarded your good behavior by gifting you his Sleigh, which doubles the value of ores once with no restrictions.
overview:
The Santa's Sleigh is an Exotic-tier upgrader that was added during Winter 2015. It was originally found in Mystery Boxes from December 25th to December 30th, 2015.
It multiplies ore value by x4 with no additional effects.
It can boost Santa's Deluxe Sleigh and Santa's Castle if used before it.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by x4

quote: An evil ore purifier from the depths of the underworld, this ancient relic uses the energy of a thousand cursed souls to add $40,000 to the value of any ore that passes through, period.
overview:
The Cursed Ore Purifier is a Proficient upgrader. It was made with the release of Miner's Haven.
It adds $40k to the ores' value with no additional effects and can be used infinitely. To make the most out of the Cursed Ore Purifier, it should be used at the beginning of setups in order to boost ore value before they enter upgraders with multiplicative upgrades.

f.effects: Adds $40k to ore value

quote: A scary furnace powered by crystals that seem to respond to certain radio waves. Claims ore at x45 when activated. Awards points based on state
overview:
The Dark Magic is a Reborn remote furnace added in the 2015 November Updates.
It is a remotely activated furnace, in fact, it is the first button-activated furnace. It processes ores at x10 normally, but when activated with the remote it processes ore at 45x its value, and the crystals light up. This is a great furnace to use if you get it early, having a potentially higher multiplier than that of the Dreamer's Might.

• Activated: x45
f.other_notes: Requires remote-click for better multiplier.

quote: An example of luxrious [sic] tech at its finest, this tiny upgrader hits hard. It also extinguishes any ore set on fire, preventing it from being destroyed.
overview:
The Freon-Blast Upgrader is a Proficient capgrader Available in the shop.
It multiplies ore value by x1.5 up to $125B. It also can extinguish fire, even when above the upgrade limit.

f.effects:
• Multiply ore value by x1.5

quote: Submits ores into a black hole to be turned into pure energy. Gives 50x the value of the ore but costs 1 Research Point for every 30 seconds the black hole is open.
overview: The Black Hole is a Legendary furnace that was added in the Summer Update 2015. It processes ore at 50x its value. For every 30 seconds one is placed down on the base, 15 research points are subtracted from the player's total research points, despite the description only stating that 1 is subtracted. It is currently the only furnace that damages a player's health within contact.

overview:
The Advanced Ore Scanner is an Advanced scanner that multiplies ore value by x3. It is an upgraded version of the Ore Scanner.
Because there is no drawback specifically for using multiple, doing so will increase the chances of an ore being hit by the upgrade beam.

quote: Those who worship the Sword God find themselves surviving many battles.

The Sword God Shrine is an Advanced Reborn-tier sword stand that gives you a Darkheart. Like all melee weapons, it gives a burst of speed to the user. The only sword that gives more speed than the Darkheart is the Illumina. When players have this equipped, they gain 9 speed and +30 max HP.
The Summer Update Patch 1.5 on May 30th 2017 changed the Darkheart to become usable again in Miners Haven, although the Sword God Shrine itself was still unobtainable. On April 28, 2018, Berezaa returned the Sword God Shrine for the first time but fr

overview: The Frostarium Mine was a Super Rare-tier mine. It was exclusive for players rank two or higher in the RAT (ROBLOX Assault Team). As of The Resurrection Update, it is no longer in the shop, and the item will vanish if you rebirth.

quote: Increases the value of ore by 70% up to 100sx. Removes fire from ores.
overview:
The Freon Supressor is a Mythic upgrader. It is commonly used in end-game setups with Suspended Refiners and Molten Upgraders.
The Freon Supressor has a complex design where you have to place a Large Converter Ramp before it for every Freon Suppressor you want to use. It can also put out fires, making it handy in setups with fire.

quote: Has technology gone too far? Yes, yes it has. This hacked cleaner easily quadruples the value of ore that enters. Due to the scary nature of this machine, ore can only be upgraded once by it.
overview:
The Quantum Ore Cleaner is a Reborn upgrader added in the Initial Release.
It multiplies ore value by x4 with no additional effects, making this a very simple but effective reborn item.
Only the middle beam applies the upgrade; the other four are purely aesthetic.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by 4x

quote: An upgrader suspended in mid-air that upgrades ores by 70% up to $1Qn. Did we mention it floats?!
overview: The Suspended Refiner is a Legendary upgrader. It's the first cash limit upgrader that costs more than $25Qn. It can also upgrade ores by a decent amount, but it also uses a little more space and has regular conveyor speed. Despite the description stating the Suspended Refiner upgrades ores up to 1Qn it actually upgrades ores up to 1.67Qn.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by 1.7x.

quote: A professional doesn't play games and neither does this upgrader. Upgrade ores by 30% up to 4 times.
overview:
The Professional Upgrader is a Premium-tier upgrader released during the 2015 Halloween Event.
This item multiplies ore value by a low 1.3x but can be used up to 4 times. This means the total multiplier for 4 of these comes out to 1.3^4, or just under 3x. This makes it a decent upgrader for early setups.
If the player owns the Ore Memer, then its multiplier can be increased by 2x if the Professional Upgrader is used before it.

The Twitch-Powered Upgrader is a Collectible upgrader that was designed to represent Berezaa's Twitch. This item was only available in Twitch Boxes.
It multiplies ores by x1.6 with no additional effects.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by x1.6

quote: Click to turn on light. Useful at nighttime.
overview:
The Flashlight is a classic Miner's Haven in-game Utility gear that is accessible to all users. Coming from its name, the flashlight emits light toward the direction the player is facing. The flashlight is most useful at night when the setting of the scene grows dark.
Unlike the other in-game Miner's Haven gear, the flashlight will always remain in a player's inventory when they reset or die. In addition, the flashlight is a portable light source. The flashlight is one of the most basic items because of the small range and lower brightness.

The Grapple Hook was an in-game Miner's Haven gear that used to be found across the map. As the title suggests, this gear allows users to grapple and hook onto areas of the map.
The Grapple Hook has been removed. When a player holding the Grapple Hook clicks, the hook would then be shot toward the desired target. If the hook lands, the user would be dragged toward the destination.

The Tiny Iron Mine is a Fabled dropper, the Iron Mine variant. It is currently the largest item in the game, was awarded to players who owned the Giant Crate Artifact.
The Tiny Iron Mine produces very large iron ores that are too large to fit inside normal cell furnaces, despite its compatibility with them.

overview: The Martian Friend is Fabled utility, that comes with a gravity coil giver. The Gravity Coil from the giver increases resistance to gravity when equipped. It also appears to give a minor speed boost.

quote: A yummy gingerbread house that turns ore into even yummier gum drops! 2016 Holiday Exotic.
overview:
The Gingerbread House is an Exotic upgrader released in Part III of the Winter 2016 Event.
It currently increases ore value by 5x. It requires a Large Converter Ramp in order to get ores in the upgrader. The Gingerbread House transforms ores into gumdrops, as it states in the description. When the ores become gumdrops, their block collision is retained, and does not have sphere physics.
The Gingerbread Mansion can be used in conjunction with this item to conclude with a higher overall multiplier of 9x instead of 6x.

overview:
Santa's Chimney is an Exotic cell furnace released in Part III of the Winter 2016 event.
If the ore has less than $10k value or 1-6 upgrades, the ore is multiplied by x50k. Afterwards, a 10 second debounce is applied in which ores cannot be input until the 10 second debounce is up. If the ore has no upgrades, it's value is simply multiplied by x5B and the debounce is instead 5 seconds instead of 10.

The Ghost of Christmas Past is an Exotic portable upgrader added in the Winter Event 2016. It was unboxed from the Haunted Floating Purple Gift.
It multiplies ore value by x3 with no additional effects, increasing to x6 if the target ore has been previously upgraded by one of the other Christmas ghosts, the Phantom of Christmas Future or the Spector of Christmas Present. The multiplier further increases to x12 if the ore upgraded has been upgraded by both previously.
Using all three ghost upgraders in conjunction of each other regardless of order results in a total multiplier of x360.

The Festive Conveyor is a Collectible conveyor added in the 2016 Winter Event, and may still be obtained from opening Festive Boxes.
It holds the stat of having a very slightly lower speed than the Nuclear Conveyor, but has a hitbox of a regular conveyor.

The Haunted Floating Purple Gift is an Exotic gift that was introduced in Part II of the Winter Event 2016. This gift was re-released in Part II of The Christmas Event 2019.
This gift was first added in December 18th, 2016, as one of the holiday gift exotics received through Mystery Boxes. The gift was automatically opened on December 25th, 2016.
This gift returned at December 23rd, 2019 due to high demand for the return of Ghost of Christmas Past. The Haunted Floating Purple Gift was also made a standalone item, meaning players can choose to open the gift as of December 25th 2019, or keep it for decoration purposes. It could be obtained as one of the many gifts obtained from Jak'uhfdor.

overview: The Snow-Covered Tree is a Collectible-tier decoration item exclusively obtainable during the 2016 Holiday Event.

quote: A mighty frozen upgrader that treats ores at every level with love. 2016 Holiday Exotic.
overview:
The Winterheart is an Exotic Way-Up-High upgrader released in New Year's 2017.
The Winterheart has a variety of possible effects which are dependent on the value of an ore:
• Ores with negative ore value are automatically bumped up to $1B.
• Ore worth more than $0 but less than $500 has their ore value squared (multiplied by itself).
• Ore worth anywhere between $500 and $10M has their ore value multiplied by x5 (which can be looped until it reaches $10M).
• Ores worth more than $10M have their value multiplied by x3.

overview:
The Festive Spirit is an Exotic upgrader released in New Year's 2017. It was obtainable by these three sources, the Chilley Frozen Gift, unlocking Mystery Boxes, and purchasing it through Headless Santa.
It multiplies ore value by x5 without changing its upgrade count.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by x5

quote: The sweetest furnace in Miner's Haven! 2016 Holiday Collectible.
overview:
The Sweet Tooth is a Collectible-tier furnace that can be purchased from Headless Santa.
It processes ore at 25x value with no other effects. It was aimed towards newer players as a replacement for the Diamond Falls until December was over. Unless you were collecting this item, it was not worth the price if you are at a high life.

f.effects: Processes ore at 25x their value

quote: Whatever is in this gift is very cold. Opens on New Years Day.
overview: The Chilley Frozen Gift is an Exotic gift added in Part III of the Winter 2016 event. It unwraps into the Festive Spirit.

quote: A very shiny and nicely-wrapped gift. Opens on New Years Day.
overview: The Shiny Nicely-Wrapped Gift is an Exotic gift added in Part III of the Winter 2016 Event. It unwrapped into the Winterheart.

quote: A fancy and more consistent way of getting ore to hard-to-reach places.
overview:
The Ore Elevator is a Proficient utility added in the 2017 Summer Update. The Ore Elevator and some of its stats were announced on berezaa's Twitter in January. The Ore Elevator did not receive any more light until April 21st 2017, where a conceptual build of the Ore Elevator was showcased. Five days later, on April 26th, 2017, several builds were brought to light, and the final model was chosen.
The Ore Elevator is a simplified substitute to the Large Converter Ramp, featuring a teleporter sender on the bottom and a receiver just above, allowing for less space consumption, if compared. It also has a significantly less chance of ores clogging. The metal support beams surrounding the teleporter sender are non-collidable, meaning Centering Conveyors are actually not needed. Note that unlike most teleporters, it will not center ore.

f.effects: Teleports ore up to a way-up-high conveyor above it.

quote: This big bad wall will ensure absolutely no one breaks into your base. Featuring top-of-the-line KillBrick(TM) technology to stop intruders
overview: The Reinforced Security Wall is a Luxury wall that was added in Part II of the 2017 Winter Event.

quote: An evil creation, the Dragonglass Blaster draws power from a remote source.
overview:
The Dragonglass Blaster is an Advanced Fusion blaster, a fusion between the Dragon Blaster and the Dragonglass Mine, added in The Ultimate Update.
It was first unveiled on Berezaa's Twitter as one of the images.
It upgrades ore with a constant multiplier of 9x, with a 10% chance to both explode and destroy ore that passes through it while turned on. The more clicks the remote receives, the longer the item is turned on, similarly to the Dragonglass Mine. One click is enough to leave this item turned on for 3 seconds before shutting off, unlike the Dragonglass Mine's delay.

The Hyper Mine is a Collectible dropper that produces ore worth $500 at a rate of 1 ore every 2 seconds.
During the Innovation Tycoon event, It could be purchased from the Innovator, along with the Assembly Unit and the Steel Refinery.
This is one of few droppers to drop neon ore, allowing you to use it with certain items, such as The Cosmic Tower and the Optic Origin.

f.effects: Capable of powering up Assembly Unit when upgraded.

quote: A powerful machine used to collect Steel from Iron Ore. Click the button on the side to release Steel.
overview:
The Steel Refinery is a Collectible upgrader that was sold by The Innovator. It collects iron ore and turns it into steel. If the button on the side is pressed while the number displayed next to it is 0, no steel will be returned. If the value displayed is above 0, it will return steel to the user.
While the item description implies that it only accepts iron ores, the only criteria for an ore to be valid, is to have the same color as iron ores. This also means that any iron ore that doesn't have it's original color is not accepted. The Ore Painter can paint ores in the valid color, with the right most color of the 2nd row on its color selection panel.

quote: Fill the Assembly Unit with Hyper Ore to create a Hyper Ignition Fuse. Hyper Ore must go through an upgrader before being dumped.
overview:
The Assembly Unit is a Collectible furnace that only accepts upgraded ore from the Hyper Mine; anything else and the ore is simply destroyed. The user can receive money by clicking the orb once it becomes neon; this shows that the Assembly Unit is full.
It takes 200 upgraded Hyper ore until it becomes full and creates a Hyper Ignition fuse, at which point the player can click the orb. Rewarding them a badge for creating the fuse, the money that the orb contained, and a new collectible to keep. When upgraded Hyper Ore goes into it, a white "liquid" can be seen slowly rising for each ore.

f.effects: A Hyper Ignition Fuse is created once filled up.

quote: A split fusion of two of the most powerful mines in existance [sic]. The Diamond Breech Loader towers above.
overview:
The Diamond Breech Loader is a Reborn Fusion dropper, first revealed on Berezaa's Twitter in a Tweet that was deleted the very next day, added in the Ultimate Update.
The Diamond Breech Loader is a cross between the notoriously ineffective Massive Diamond Mine and the Breech Loader. It holds the status of having an incredibly high raw ore value and a fast drop rate, mining ludicrously expensive ores valued at $1qd.
Likewise with the Breech Loader, part of the item is at an angle, but not diagonally. Instead, only the dropper segment is slanted forward. This

quote: The super-powered Catalyzed Star can upgrade ores many times over before finally giving in.
overview:
The Catalyzed Star is a Reborn Fusion upgrader added on March 8th, 2017 and was first revealed on Berezaa's Twitter.
The Catalyzed Star serves as a hybrid of both a limitless and a money-capped upgrader. Its first upgrade multiplies ore value by 5x with no additional effects and can be amplified up to 20x with the previous use of a Nova Star, as well as its fusion, the Ore Nova, a pulsar-type item.
Subsequent upgrades to ores will have drastically lower multipliers, but will continue up to a cap of $1NvD (1e⁶⁰), with the multipliers getting even smaller as the ore gets more valuable. The multipliers are shown below:
It takes 88 upgrades to go from 10DD to 100QnD, 66 upgrades to go from 100QnD to 1SpD, and 237 upgrades to go from 1SpD to 1NvD, for a total of 391 upgrades to go from 10DD to 1NvD. Therefore, for a Catalyzed Star loop that takes about 4 seconds per loop, it will take about 26 minutes to bring your ore value from 10DD to 1NvD.
Any upgrade applied to the ore past the 1st makes the ore incompatible with the Black Dwarf and its evolved variant, the Void Star.

f.source: Fusing 10 The Catalysts and 5 Morning Stars at The Craftsman

1st upgrade:
• Multiplies ore value by 5x
• Does not set ore on fire
• Compatible with ⟦Black Dwarf⟧/⟦Void Star⟧

Ignites ore
Multiplies ore value by x1.6 to x1.06 depending on ore value:
• $10DD: 1.6x
• $10DD to $100QnD: 1.3x
• $100QnD to $1SpD: 1.15x
• $1SpD to $1NvD: 1.06x
f.drawbacks:
• Flames destroy ore in 3 seconds
• Second upgrade incompatible with ⟦Black Dwarf⟧/⟦Void Star⟧
f.other_notes: When ore is upgraded by the Nova Star, the first upgrade is amplified by x4 (to x20). However, the second upgrade will be amplified to x4.8, x2.9, x1.95, and x1.38 (from x1.6, x1.3, x1.15, and 1.06 respectively).

quote: A conveyor which separates small and large ore into two seperate [sic] lanes.
overview:
The Separation Conveyor is a Novice utility conveyor designed to separate ore based on their size. It was added in The Ultimate Sacrifice.
The way that the Separation Conveyor works is that two railings are attached on top of the conveyor where only ores as small as 1.5x1.5x1.5 units can pass through them.
If large ores try to pass the railings, they will instead lean against them as they go through the conveyor. This conveyor does not have any special programming and it's walled. This would not be a widely used item as it's only actually useful to players who have small and large ores in one setup which is extremely rare.

quote: An advanced conveyor that moves ore to its center. Useful for fine-point upgraders.
overview:
The Centering Conveyor is an Advanced utility conveyor with a unique ability to move ore into the center of it, thus allowing easy usage with fine-point upgraders, such as the Freon-Blast Upgrader or the Clockwork. The conveyor moves ore that are centered at a regular speed of 100%, but moves ore at the sides at a much faster speed towards the center.
Another unseen, but useful way to use this item is as ore regulation. Placing several pieces of this item just before tight conveyors, like the Large Conveyor Ramp, can help space out the incoming ore.
Make sure to remember there are no longer any more walls along the sides of the conveyor. It would be best if Berezaa updated the thumbnail of it.

overview:
The Ore Gate is an Intermediate utility added in The Ultimate Update. It has a simple ability to hold ore in place using the Z Button. This can prove useful for loop setups to stop ore more easily and reliably than a Reversible Conveyor.
The Proximated Ore Gate serves as an automated version of this, although it may be less effective.

quote: The fusion of precision and randomness, offers amazing possibilities but only for one ore at a time.
overview:
The Aether Schrodinger is a Reborn Fusion schrodinger, a fusion between the Aether Refinery and the Flaming Schrodinger, added in The Ultimate Update.
It has similar stats to the gambler upgraders as it has a randomized effect to each ore, but there's a twist from the Aether Refinery's side: it puts up a barrier at the back end to temporarily block incoming ore for 1 second. Since the barrier is activated at the back end of the item, grouping up ore together can allow multiple ores to be upgraded at once, contrary to what the description states.
In the 100 Million Visits Event, a new effect was added to it involving the Aether Refinery. If an ore upgraded by the Aether Schrodinger is processed in it, then it's processed by x300 instead of by x90. A similar effect is given for the Aethereal Synthesizer, adding 500x for every Aether Schrodinger used, and capping at 5000x.

The Eternal Fracture is a Reborn Fusion cell furnace, a fusion between the Eternal Journey and The Fracture, added in The Ultimate Update.
It raises the value of the ore to the power of 1.14, then processes at x2B. However, it has a drawback: the ore is held in stasis while it is processed for 1 to 8 seconds. Its hitbox allows most of the mines to be able to be directly dropped into the furnace part of the item, allowing for easy use without the requirement of an Ore Cannon.

quote: Nothing heralds the coming of Spring quite like fireflies and home-made ore soup. Cook the best soup for potentially huge amounts of money. 2017 March Exotic
overview:
Equinox is an Exotic furnace that was released during the Ultimate Sacrifice update, alongside with the comeback of The Beehive.
The Equinox multiplies every ore that enters by 70x until there are 7 ores. The 5th, 6th, and 7th ores are processed. When the 7th ore is processed, all the ores that have been turned dark disappear, ready for the next batch. According to the stats, the max multiplier of the Equinox is x4900, assuming your 7th ore is the ore you intend to process.
Ores that have previously been upgraded, no matter how many times, can also be processed, making this item a potentially powerful cell furnace to use in end-game setups.

quote: A curved upgrader that can only upgrade ores once. The faster ore pass through it, the more it upgrades them.
overview:
The Rush Upgrader is an Intermediate upgrader added in The Ultimate Update.
Updated numerous times, it now multiplies ore value by up to x5 and adds up to $20k to the ore's value. These upgrades depend on the amount of ores that pass through within a window of a single second, up to a maximum of 40 ores. In other words, it evaluates the flow rate of the ore instead of the actual velocity of the ore. It is be recommended to use an Ore Gate before it to easily get the max upgrade.
For example, if 20 ores pass through this upgrader in a second, the 20th ore will receive a x3 upgrade and have $10k added to its value.

The first beam does x2 while the second beam does x3 and "breaks" the ore, causing it to start smoking. The only way to fix an ore is to send it through the Maintenance Supporter, but otherwise the smoking effect does not do anything.

It drops ore worth $0, every time an ore drops from this mine, a leaf from the top disappears, and it stops working once all leaves are gone, and must be replaced. only one ore can be dropped until it get absorbed or destroyed.
The ores act as upgraders, doing x1.5 to an ore it touches and consuming it, allowing for another ore to be dropped. It can upgrade an ore 8 times, which leads to around a ~x25.6 total.

Dreamer's Anguish is a Reborn cell furnace in Miner's Haven, having a similar effect to the Noobite Mine, in which the furnace processes ore at a variable multiplier depending how much cash you have, the furnace can multiply an ore's value anywhere from x10 to x80qd.
Berezaa thought that the Dreamer's Anguish was overpowered, so he nerfed it in the Skipped Life Update. The max possible multiplier was nerfed from x1Qn to x80qd. In a later update it was nerfed again, but the max multiplier was not touched - instead the amount of money you need for the max was increased.

overview:
The Premium Tracker is a Contraband utility item that is equivalent to the standard Ore Tracker. It has a gold design unlike the original Ore Tracker. Some argued the original Ore Tracker old price costed more as it is harder for lower life players to obtain Shards of Life Shards of Life than only 30 to 70 uC.
The Premium Tracker functions like the Ore Tracker, by displaying the ore value above of ores that pass through, but uses a gold text instead of blue. It also blinks with a marble texture instead of neon. It is also rebirth and sacrifice proof, which is useful for shopless setups.

quote: Doomed to sail the seas forever, The Flying Dutchman is said to be packed with treasures. Produces a mystery box or clover every 30 minutes if enough well-upgraded ore is sacrificed. 2016 Halloween Item.
overview:
The Flying Dutchman is an Exotic utility furnace released in the 2016 Halloween Event. Every 30 minutes, if you submit 1000 well-upgraded ores, it will award you a free Regular Box or a Lucky Clover Lucky Clover.
A well-upgraded ore is considered an ore with strictly more than 1 reflectance (i.e. more than 20 upgrader counter). For reference, the Overlord Device and the True Overlord Device both have 20 upgrader counter.
The probability of getting a Regular Box after 30 minutes and 1000 ores is 6/7 (~85.7%) and for a Lucky Clover, 1/7 (~14.3%).
The player is able to stack the ability of the Flying Dutchman with a max stack of 5; however, this used to not be the case until a little after the end of the 2019 Halloween Event.

This can be solved by affecting ores with a visual effects like fire, sparkles, Ore/Premium Tracker's effect, or with items that decrease transparency like the Ghastly Graveyard. It is therefore recommended to place this item near the end of a setup f

When this number reaches 99, the next ore is processed at 300x and a copy of the ore is produced from the Mage's Staff. This ore can be caught with conveyors and processed, also with a 300x multiplier. (Formerly made 5 copies.)
The model of Lucifer present at the back does a dab animation when the 100th ore is processed, as well as producing a bass audio.

quote: A dangerous makeshift mine whose ores react violently when they come into contact with coal.
overview:
The Boomite Mine is a Vintage dropper based off the Azure Mines ore of the same name. It was announced on Berezaa's stream on 11/10/2016. This dropper's ores will explode when they touch coal ore, which has a 7 in 8 chance of applying a x5 multiplier up to a limit of $10T, and a 1 in 8 chance of being destroyed. There can only be 4 Boomite ores per mine on your base at a time.
Boomite ore has a special red flame on it that prevents it from being destroyed by fire similarly to the Symmetrium Mine. Extinguishing this flame with a Freon-Blast Upgrader for instance will both allow the ore to be burned and remove its coal upgrade effect. The special flame effect emitted from the ore can not be removed by the Wild Spore, Deadly Spore, or the Azure Spore (as it is not a considered a negative effect). The Azure Refiner can destroy this ore.
If the mine is withdrawn, the ores it has left behind will be stripped of their unique effects; this means they will not explode when coming in contact with coal ore. This bug also appears with several other items, such as Hades' Fang.
The Ore Replicator allows you to have more than 4 Boomite ores on your base. However, the mine stops working until all of the Boomite ores are gone. Duplicated ore does not have the special red flame.

quote: The culmination of pure dedication. A machine unmatched by any other.
overview:
The Ultimate Sacrifice is a long-anticipated game mechanic and Ultimate resetting deviceobtained upon performing the titular game feature. The Ultimate Sacrifice was added on the 8 th of March, 2017 and it was first announced officially on the Berezaa Games Forums.
The Ultimate Sacrifice, much like its Second Sacrifice counterpart, has three different upgrades: (listed in order of priority)
# Gimmick Upgrade: if the ore has an upgrade counter that is less than or equal to zero, then a large upgrade of either x25 (ore value less than $1B) or x50 (ore value greater than or equal to $1B) is applied. Both of these upgrades set Upgrade Counter: 10 for the former, 20 for the latter — regardless of what the Upgrade Counter was before the upgrade, it will be this amount afterwards. Both of these are also infinitely loopable, provided you are able to reduce the Upgrade Counter to zero or less after the previous upgrade. If ores have a negative upgrade counter, this upgrade is prioritized over the other two and does not trigger the resetting upgrade — allowing The Ultimate Sacrifice to be used again as a resetting device later.
# Resetting Upgrade: The Ultimate Sacrifice acts as a Resetting Device, which is a type of upgrader that resets all machine tags and negates all status effects. This can be used alongside other Resetting Devices, such as the Tesla Resetter. This resetting upgrade also includes a multiplier of x2.5 and an addition of $5k to the ore's value.
# Loopable Upgrade: If the ore value is less than $1qd, the Upgrade Counter above zero, and the Resetting Upgrade is already used, then the ore will get a x1.05 upgrade. This is loopable until the ore value is $1qd or higher.
The Ultimate Sacrifice upgrader is destroyed in The Second Sacrifice. What it is left of it will be yours to keep in the form of the Statue of Sacrifice.
This item is the spirit of the now-dead god of knowledge, Magnar.

submission.name: The Ultimate Sacrifice
submission.description: "'What?! Why?! All that you have done, the long goal you have made it to and you decide to destroy it for your increasing greed and power? Fine, fine, but this will not go down without consequences. You have decided to make the ultimate sacrifice. And now... you will start a-new.""

x.t:
The Ultimate Sacrifice requires the player to be life 1000 or higher and requires three buttons to be clicked for verification. Upon performing The Ultimate Sacrifice you are reverted to life 1 again but with the 's-' prefix before your life. You start out the same way you originally started Miner's Haven, with a Basic Furnace, Basic Iron Mine, and 10 Basic Conveyors. You are also given 10 Ultimate Conveyors, The Ultimate Sacrifice upgrader, and any Soulbound items or mystery boxes you may have. (It is suggested that you save some boxes for after you sacrifice to give you a bit of a head start)
The Ultimate Sacrifice can only be performed once. After performing The Ultimate Sacrifice, you will gain the ability to craft Reborn Fusions at the Craftsman, such as Diamond Breech Loader and Eternal Fracture. The crafting of these items requires the use of Research Points to unlock the item as well as multiple copies of the fused items.
Like with Rebirthing, The Ultimate Sacrifice cannot be undone.

Berezaa released an FAQ page on the Berezaa Games forums (that are now down forever) that further answers this question. Here are the following assets you keep after performing the Ultimate Sacrifice:
• Research Points RP and UC uC (Unobtanium Crystals).
• Mystery Boxes, Lucky Clover Lucky Clovers.
• Fabled-tier Items.
• Soulbound items, such as Swag Conveyors, Statue of Knowledge, etc.
• The recipes to craft both the Void Drive and Coliseum Catharsis (you will not need to complete either challenge again.)
• Gamepasses.
• Evolved Reborn recipes.

For your limited-time seasonal items, those items are held in escrow and will be returned to you when you reach Life s-100 (you obtain the "s-" life prefix when you Sacrifice). The items that are held in escrow are listed below:
• Exotic and Collectible items
• Reborn-proof Contraband items, including THE UNDERTAKER.
• Limited and Evolved shiny reborn items.
• Sacrifice-proof items.
• Code-exclusive items, such as the Ancient Conveyor.
• Paid items, like the Pineapple Refiner.
• Twitch items, including the Twitch Scanner and Twitch-Powered Upgrader.
• Luxury items.
• Shiny Evolution items.
For the mystery box exclusive vintage, reborn, ultimate, and UC Shop items, they are gone forever. Good luck getting them back.

⚠️THIS FEATURE HAS BEEN DISCONTINUED AND IS NO LONGER AVAILABLE.⚠️
Berezaa has acknowledged the users who have rebirthed far more than 1,000 times for the sake of it. Here are the special rewards along with the Ultimate Sacrifice for users who have reached these milestones:
Keep in mind that it's not worth the energy to rebirth several times just to hit a life 2000, 5000, or 10000+ milestone or above just to receive the perks as it will take more times to do the rebirths to hit the milestones rather than compensate for not receiving the perks that come along with the milestones.

rows: This is 10x less than the amount of money you got when you started Miner's Haven ($500), and the amount of money when you rebirth into a new life.
Enough money to rebirth into your 2nd life.
Enough money to rebirth into your 2nd (or 9th, if life skipping was enabled) life. You will also obtain the Overlord Device upon rebirth.
Enough money to rebirth into your 2nd (or 22nd, if life skipping was enabled) life. You will also obtain the True Overlord Device upon rebirth.

x.t:
By the time you reach your 1,001st life, you should have more than enough experience on Miner's Haven to be able to start all over again and regain all the progress you have lost much more efficiently than you did when you first started Miner's Haven, especially with The Ultimate Sacrifice in your inventory, adding a large sum of money and massively multiplying ore value. You can always regain Reborn items again. You will also have access to Reborn Fusion items which have unique designs and powerful effects, which were inherited from both of the fused items. You also receive a baseplate size increase of 6 units in both directions.
Times where you should not Sacrifice immediately is if a limited-time item you own has not yet been made Sacrifice proof, such as seasonal rebirth items, or if an event requires you to have a life requirement to finish fully (Like the Easter Eggs' life requirements needed to redeem them into items in Easter 2020 and 2021).

It also has a fast enough conveyor speed which can be used to launch ore into upgraders with floating upgrade beams with consistency, such as the Big Bertha.

Multiplies ore value by x4
Decreases ore upgrade counter by 3

submission.name: Wormhole Defluxicator
submission.description: Wormholes have been a mysterious wonder in the world of science and astronomy. Recently, NASA has found a wormhole has been able to control the power and turn it into a powerful upgrader.
submission.effects: Increases orevalue by 6x, 9x if the ore has sparkles

quote: Keep those baddies out with higher walls and cover for you to shoot at your enemies!
overview:
The Advanced Wall is a Redeemed wall only obtainable by redeeming the code "Twen1yK4y" (now invalid).
The Advanced Wall is like any other wall, except it has team-colored parts on it and glows in the dark, lighting up a small area around it. This makes it a good choice for making bases.
The Advanced Wall has tiny prongs coming out from the back of it, making it unreliable to use as a very large conveyor wall.

quote: A pretty bonfire that lights itself at nighttime to illuminate your base. Shines brighter than a Torch.
overview:
The Bonfire is a Basic decoration item that lights the surrounding area around it when night falls. It illuminates slightly more area than the Giant Torch.
While it is daytime, no fire particles or light will be emitted from the bonfire, like all other light sources in the game.

quote: A celebratory upgrader given out on Miner's haven's 1st birthday! Increases ore value by x3 with no cash limit!
overview:
The Birthday Upgrader is a Collectible upgrader added on 12th June, 2016, Miner's Haven's one year anniversary.
The Birthday Upgrader was awarded to players upon claiming their daily gifts from 12th - 14th June, 2016. It is also obtainable from Birthday Boxes.
It multiplies ore value by 3x with no additional effects.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by x3

quote: A gorgous [sic] cake to celebrate Haven's first birthday. Builds up power as it is fed more ore.
overview:
The Birthday Cake is an Exotic furnace added in the Miner's Haven Birthday Event to celebrate Miner's Haven's First Anniversary.
It initially processes ore value by x1, and gradually increases for each ore fed into it, capping at x100 after 100 ores processed. After this limit has been reached, the multiplier is resetted back to x1, restarting the process.

f.effects: Initially processes ore at x1 value. Gradually enters ore to its multiplier and caps at x100. When it reaches x100, it starts over at x1.

submission.name: Memory Cake
submission.description: For MH's first B-Day :3

quote: The single most expensive crystal item in the game. Anyone who steps on it gets the badge. Only works on public servers.
overview:
The Blinged Badge Giver is a Premium-tier badge giver that, like its name suggests, awards the Blinged Badge on contact. Anyone can get the badge once it is placed.
Its description is actually slightly incorrect; it is the most expensive crystal item in the shop. Exotics sold by the in-game merchants, like The Masked Man, are usually more expensive. You most likely won't have to pay the absurd price of this item because the Blinged Badge Giver is common in Mystery Boxes.

f.effects: Awards the Blinged Badge on touch.

quote: The amazing glowing neon tree is neither understood nor accepted by any conventional science. It looks amazing though.
overview: The Neon Tree is a Legendary decoration and is currently available in the shop, costing $6.75sx. It produces a relatively small amount of light. Due to its somewhat small size of 3x3, it can fit into many spots.

f.effects: Decoration; Glows intensely and emits light at night

quote: A conveyor piece used for separating different levels of conveyor.
overview:
The Two-Level Corner is an Intermediate conveyor that is basically a Conveyor Corner attached to a Raised-ier Conveyor. It is used to separate the flow of ore at different levels and can be used in conjunction with the Two-Level Conveyor.
It can also be used with the Ore Replicator so that ore that passes along the higher section will be copied and the new ore will travel along the lower level. This set-up is useful for using multiple furnaces.

quote: An interesting piece that allows two-layer conveyor systems to overlap.
overview: The Two-Layer Intersection is an Intermediate conveyor that is useful for raised-ier conveyors that cross with standard conveyor systems. Many users neglect the use of this conveyor because it restricts large ore from passing through. This item was also rendered mostly useless with the addition of Hydraulic Conveyors.

quote: For those who really want to put their money where their defense is: a giant wall made of diamond!
overview:
The Diamond Wall is a Premium wall. It serves no other purpose other than keeping out players, and preventing ores from escaping, but with a diamond flavor to it.
It is part of a set of four walls made out of crystals, which also includes the Ruby Wall, Gold Wall, and Unobtainium Wall.

quote: Shining walls made out of pure gold. Amazing!
overview: The Gold Wall is a Premium wall that is a gold colored reskin of common walls. It serves no purpose other than keeping players outside of a player's base or blocking potential explosions.

f.effects: Keeps players out and stops ores from flying away from fast conveyors.

quote: Lets you fly or something
overview:
The Jetpack is a ROBLOX gear that can be found hidden in a tree on the map, although it can also be obtained through Executive Crates.
Its main purpose is to propel the player in any way they desire. The gear is especially useful when reaching hard-to-reach places, like some of the The Masked Man's hiding places, and because of this it is one of the most sought-after gears in the game.
The gear made its debut in the Outdoors Update. As the maps were constantly changing, so did the location of the Jetpack, from a tree, to an obby u

f.source:
Laying on a palm tree near the docks
Executive Crate
f.effects: Transportation; Propels players in the direction their camera is facing while clicking

quote: Our new research allows us to create plasma energy weapons that shoot with an un-matched range and accuracy!
overview: The Plasma Sharpshooting is a Legendary weapon giver that gives the player a plasma rifle when walked over. The plasma rifle has strong knockback and high damage, making it a useful weapon to deter attackers.

quote: Our new research allows us to create plasma energy weapons with un-matched range and accuracy!
overview: The High Velocity Energy is a Legendary weapon giver that gives the player a plasma machine gun. With its high RP requirement and price in the septillions, only endgame players could get their hands on the High Velocity Energy. It is extremely difficult to receive five million research points with or without combat.

quote: Modern machinery used to produce rapid-fire automatic SMG weapons.
overview: The SMG Production is an Advanced weapon giver in Miner's Haven. It gives SMGs to inflict damage upon other players.

f.effects: Grants the player a Sten Gun

quote: The Persistent Scorpium Mine produces greater value ores the longer it is placed down.
overview:
The Scorpium Mine is a Reborn mine released in the 2016 Fourth of July Update. It is a life 20+ reborn item and the value of its ores gradually increases based on the number of ores it has previously dropped, which may be interrupted by hitting the ore limit. It is not directly based on the amount of time since the mine was placed as its description may suggest.
Like other droppers on its level, Scorpium Mine ores do not work in cell furnaces. Assuming it is continuously dropping ore, the ore's value is equal to SecondsOnBase^1.2 *$1M. The value of the ores begins at $0, immediately after the placement of the mine. The maximum ore value was recently buffed and ores are now capable of reaching $69.2B (However, this takes a while.). In the Easter Update on April 15th, 2017, the Scorpium Mine's stats were tweaked:
• The max ore value cap is reached after being placed for 3 hours and 30 minutes. (Previously 3 hours).
• When the max cap is reached, it will dispense ores 40% faster. (1 ore/0.6 sec)
Moving or withdrawing the mine will reset its value to $0.

f.effects: Ores are immune to poison.
f.drop_rate:
• 1 ore/1 second
• 1 ore/0.6 second (At Maximum ore value)
f.other_notes:
Ore initially has 0.7 (70%) transparency and calculated with the following formula:
0.7 - (SecondsOnBase/21600)
SecondsOnBase will cap at 12600 (3 hours and 30 minutes), therefore the lowest transparency is at maximum value, at 0.1166 (11.66%).

submission.name: Scorpionite Mine
submission.description: Seeing OutOfOrderFoxy's Megalodinium Mine gave me the idea for this submission!

x.t:
Starts at $0 when placed and grows as it keeps dropping: SecondsOnBase^1.2 × $1M.
Caps at $69.2B after 3 hours 30 minutes on your base, then drops ore 40% faster. Moving or withdrawing the mine resets it to $0.

quote: Let's get the party started! Wubium's beats periodically activate remote items. July 2016 item.
overview:
The Wubium Mine is an Exotic dropper released on July 4th of 2016 alongside the Volcango.
It has a fairly low ore value along with a randomized upgrade counter between 0 and 19. What really makes this dropper unique, however, is its incredibly fast drop rate, spewing out 30 ores in a single second. This can be incredibly useful for some situations.
With its high drop rate, it also has another effect where it can activate other manual droppers present on the user's base. This function was previously broken but has been fixed since, and will work in new servers.

f.effects:
• Periodically plays music.
• Activates all remote-powered devices on your base while "Wubbing".
f.cell_compatibility: Yes, if ore upgrade counter is 0

quote: The great volcango burns any ores that manage to enter it at x150. July 2016 item.
overview:
The Volcango is an Exotic furnace that was added on July 4th, 2016.
It process ores by x500. Despite its shape being akin to a cell furnace, it will accept both upgraded and non-upgraded ores.
Requires to be put directly in, using Ore Cannon or Hydraulic Ramp to get processed.

f.effects: Processes ores at x500 value.
f.drawbacks: Ores must be directly dropped or launched in.

submission.name: Volcano Cell
submission.description: yeah man

quote: New research has enabled the creation of flood lights with a much larger range.
overview: The Triple Flood Light is a Premium flood light that emits a strong amount of light in the direction it is facing. It appears to be the same as a Flood Light but with two smaller lights on the side that give it more range than all the other flood lights.

f.effects: Provides light at nighttime

quote: Powered by stone from the legendary Azure Mines, this relic upgrades pure ore by x4.
overview:
The Azure Refiner is a Reborn upgrader that multiplies 'pure' ores by x4.
This means that if the ore is on fire, sparkling or with any effects, it will be destroyed. It is recommended to place this item before gambler items (such as the Flaming Schrodinger) or after Resetting Devices.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by x4
f.drawbacks: Destroys ore with any status effects.

submission.name: Let's Do That Upgrader
submission.description: Takes ore BACK IN TIME TO A EARLIER UPDATE, Much like a Tesla Converter, it converts the ores to a state where it can be upgraded again, but with the added bonus of it being able to multiply ores by 7X too!
submission.effects:
• Acts as a resetting device
• Multiplies ores by x7

quote: The Symmetrium mine tracks its single ore and continuously upgrades it over time. It's azure flame protects the ore from being burnt. Ore is replaced instantly when destroyed.
overview:
The Symmetrium Mine is a Reborn-tier dropper. It was first unveiled on Berezaa's Twitter and his old website. The Symmetrium Mine's ores can pass through upgraders that inflicts fire onto ores without being put on fire. However, this blue flame can be removed by resetting devices, Cooling Chamber, Wild Spore, and Freon upgraders.
It will only produce 1 ore per minute only if the ore from the original dropper is still on the base. If the ore is not on the base anymore (by pulsar, furnace, or landing on the floor of the base) the mine will pr

f.effects: Ore is naturally fireproof.

submission.name: Cryotonium Mine
submission.description: "(It's based off of dragonglass mine) The ore is worth 20b and.. It's fireproof. (BBB setups ftw)"
submission.effects: Drops ores worth $20B. Ores are fireproof (approved)

quote: Send your ore through the mighty Morning Star for nearly endless growth. Ignited ore must be put out or it'll be destroyed. This will cap ore off at 1N.
overview:
The Morning Star is a Reborn-tier upgrader that was added in August 2016, along with the introduction of the True Overlord Device.
It is a loopable upgrader that increases ore value by 70% or 7% (x1.7 or x1.07 multiplier) until it reaches a value of $1N. This cash-based cap allows players to have a chance to obtain the powerful Overlord Device.
It also has an unusual insertion method of requiring ores to be raised slightly.
This can be achieved by using an Ore Cannon, Ore Collider, or a couple of Nuclear Conveyors followed by a single Conveyor Ramp. Mines with large ores such as the Osmium Excavator can clip the bottom of the upgrader without the use of ramps or cannons.

f.effects:
• Increases ore value by 70% or 7% (x1.7 or x1.07 multiplier).
• Upgrade caps at $1N.
f.drawbacks:
• Ore is set on fire and destroyed after 3 seconds.
• Ore value over $10Sp is multiplied by 1.07x instead.
• Cannot upgrade ores that were upgraded by ⟦Black Dwarf⟧ or ⟦Void Star⟧ previously

quote: A simple machine, removes fire from ores without tagging and sends them on their way.
overview: The Freon Sprayer is a Contraband utility item that removes the burning effect from ore. It is sold by The Masked Man for 17 to 46 uC.

f.effects: Extinguishes fire.

quote: A statue carved out of an unknown material which radiates incredible power. There's big, there's bad, and then there's this.
overview:
The Dragon Blaster, often abbreviated as DB, is an Advanced Reborn-tier blaster. It was first unveiled on Berezaa's Twitter and his website.
It multiplies ore value by x4 and is slightly bigger than the Big Bad Blaster, but also has a slightly lower chance of 1/11 of destroying ores as it is more rare.

• Sets ore on fire
f.drawbacks:

• 18% chance to explode the ore
• 9% chance to explode and destroy the ore

submission.name: Red Dragon
submission.description: A mighty red dragon that shoots searing fire out of its mouth. Multiplies ores just as good as the last upgrader did.

quote: Donates 99% of your ore's value to John Cena. Probably the worst item in the game.
overview:
THE UNDERTAKER is a Contraband cell furnace that is occasionally sold by The Masked Man, for about 222 uC to 390 uC.
It processes ore by 0.666% (0.00666x multiplier), or, in other words, divides ore value by 150.15, and only accepts ore from one side, which is the side facing the Buffed Iron Mine.
Despite being categorized as a Cell Furnace, it accepts all ores regardless of their upgrade count. It was first unveiled on Berezaa's twitter and on his website.

f.effects: Processes ore at 0.666% (÷150.15) its value

quote: Sends a signal into time to upgrade ore some time in the future. Can only be used once.
overview:
The Astral Predictor is a Reborn upgrader that was added on August 7th, 2016. It was first unveiled on Berezaa's Twitter and his website.
Astral Predictor upgrades ores by 1.08x every 0.2 seconds for a random amount of times between 11 or 26 times.
It gives gradual upgrades over a short period of time. The amount of times the ore value is multiplied by 1.08x is dependent on a random number generator with the formula x+10, where x is an integer between 1 and 16. For instance:
The mean multiplier of this upgrader is _n=11²6 (1.08^n / 16)4.419.
To get ideal value out of this upgrader, it is best placed so that the ore is guaranteed to take more than 5.2 seconds before entering the furnace. The upgrading will still persist through any resetting device but replicator copies will not inherit the upgrading effect.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by 1.08x every 0.2s for a total duration between 2.2s (11 times) and 5.2s (26 times)

ranges from 2.2 to 5.2

submission.description: These mysteryious islands above the clouds upgrader ore by 5x!

quote: Although the spirit of the once mighty Sword Master, their spirit lives on.
overview:
The Sword Master's Spirit is a Fabled furnace that was released in the August 2016 Update. It was first unveiled on Berezaa's Twitter and on his website. This furnace is a compensation for users that purchased the Sword Master Gamepass, since lethals were removed from Miner's Haven. It processes ores by 75x their value with no restrictions or extra effects.
The Sword Master Gamepass is not currently available to be bought. During Black Friday 2016, for one minute, the Sword Master was made available for R$1000. Since some people still bou

f.effects: Processes ore for 75x its value

quote: A secret device that designates the unmistakable god of this world. Doesn't stack with original Overlord Device.
overview:
The True Overlord Device is an Ultimate upgrader, the successor to the Overlord Device, first unveiled on Berezaa's Twitter and on his website.
The True Overlord Device features a fine-point upgrade beam that multiplies ore value by a flat 100x upon touch. To obtain it, the user must complete the True Overlord challenge, requiring the user to obtain $1tsTG or more. It can only be obtained once daily.
It shares the same machine tag with the Overlord Device, thus cannot be used together.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by 100x
f.drawbacks:
Fine-point upgrade beam.
Only obtainable once a day.Can't be used with ⟦Overlord Device⟧.

quote: A crude device which violently tears ores from other dimensions into our own. Ores have a slight chance to randomly duplicate.
overview:
The Breech Loader is a Reborn mine that was first unveiled on Berezaa's Twitter and was explained on Berezaa's website.
The Breech Loader is a fairly rare dropper with high ore value and drop rate, as well as having a unique gimmick where its ores have a small random chance to replicate themselves. A small drawback is its rotation of 45 degrees, requiring some thought during placement since most droppers are usually facing in a straight direction.

f.effects: Ores have a small chance to replicate themselves
f.other_notes: Ore has 0.2 (20%) transparency.

submission.name: Particle Accelerator
submission.description: "We ran out of practical applications for death lasers so we made one into a mine. #YOLO"
submission.effects: Drops bursts of 3-5 ore every 2 seconds. 1st and 5th ores are $1B, 2nd and 4th ores are $1.5B and 3rd ore is $2B. Works with cells.

quote: An incredibly powerful reactor that gets decent value out of ore while generating research points for them. Requires heavily-upgraded ore, but produces 90 points for every 45 ore.
overview:
The Fusion Reactor is a Mythic-tier furnace that was first unveiled on Berezaa's Twitter.
It processes ore at a multiplier of 5x, but can also be used as an efficient research furnace as it has a high RP yield of 90 RP for every 45 ore. However, the furnace requires ore to have an upgrade count of >20 in order to count for the RP yield.

f.effects: Processes ore at x5
f.drawbacks: RP Yield only applies to ore with upgrade counter of 21 or more

quote: A sturdy upgrader with a fast conveyor that doubles the value of ore up to a decillion dollars.
overview: The Ore Transponder is an Almighty upgrader that doubles ore value up to $1de. Because of the item's large size, it is a good idea to loop upgrade ore with this item as opposed to having a large amount of them in several lines.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by x2
f.drawbacks: Will not upgrade ores worth over $1de

quote: Ore that comes in contact with this furnace is wisped away into the wind. If it is returned to the furnace it'll be processed at x200.
overview: The Heavenly Wisp is an Exotic furnace. It has the unique ability in that whenever an ore is processed in it, it is given a glow and teleported a small distance away randomly from the furnace. ONLY if the ore is then returned to the Heavenly Wisp, it will be processed by x300. If an ore instead is processed in another furnace, it will be destroyed and give no money.

f.effects: Processes ore at x300 if it can return to the furnace
f.drawbacks: It "wisps" the ore into the air and will have to hit the furnace to accept the value.
