90 RP/50 ores
(Ores will have to return to the furnace after the "wisp" effect is applied to reward RP)

quote: A mighty powerful furnace which processes ores at a huge rate. Puts up a barrier between ores to recharge.
overview:
The Aether Refinery is a Reborn furnace added in the 2016 September Update.
It processes ores at x90 their value, however once an ore is processed the barrier changes from blue to red, blocking off any incoming ore for the duration of 5 seconds. After 5 seconds, the barrier will turn back to blue indicating that it can process ores again.
If an ore has been upgraded by an Aether Schrodinger, at least once, the x90 process multiplier is bumped up to x300.

Processes ores at a x90 multiplier.
Ores upgraded at least once by an ⟦Aether Schrodinger⟧ are processed at x300.
f.drawbacks: 5-second barrier is erected after an ore is processed.

quote: An advanced scanner for twitch viewers that adds $1k to the value of an ore and then quintuples it. Doesn't work with other scanners.
overview:
The Twitch Scanner is a Collectible scanner added on 26 September, 2016.
The Twitch Scanner adds $1k to an ore's value, and then quintuples (x5) it.

f.effects:
• Adds $1k to ore value
• Multiplies ore value by x5
f.drawbacks: Doesn't stack with other scanners.

overview:
The Ore Negator is a Contraband Fine-Point upgrader that, on top of its x2 upgrade, has unique interactions with ore upgrade counters: Ore with an upgrade counter of 1 are applied -6 upgrade counter; ore with any upgrade counter otherwise are applied -5 upgrade counter. This can seem useless at first, but synergizes incredibly well with other items that depend on an ore's upgrade counter, such as the Pizza Oven or in conjunction with Cell Furnaces.
The Ore Negator, along with the Alien Relic, can be used to reduce an ores upgrade counter low enough to allow upgrades from other items while still enabling it to be us

quote: An unstable furnace that can only be reached with a raised conveyor. Processes ore at six times their value.
overview: The Raised Furnace is an Intermediate furnace that was added in The Ultimate Update and requires a Raised Mini Conveyor or higher to reach. The furnace itself processes ore by 6x (previously x1.75 and then it was buffed to x2) compared to the Basic Furnace's 1x multiplier. For every 70 ores processed in the furnace you will be rewarded 2 research points.

f.effects: Processes ore at 6x its value
f.drawbacks: Requires a Conveyor Ramp to use

quote: A strong upgrader which accepts raised conveyors from the sides. Prefers already well-upgraded ore.
overview:
The Endpoint Refiner is an Advanced upgrader added in The Ultimate Update.
It has a range of multipliers depending on both the ore's value and its upgrade counter. If the value of the ore is $2.5M or less, then the table below shows the according multipliers. This effect can also be looped indefinitely until the low threshold of $2.5M.
If ore value is more than $2.5M and has an upgrade counter of at least 30, then the ores receive a single x1.8 upgrade. Otherwise, the Endpoint Refiner will not upgrade.

quote: A heavy furnace that quintiples [sic] the value of ore and awards decent research points. Difficult to get ore into.
overview: The Reinforced Furnace is an Intermediate furnace that was released in The Ultimate Update. It processes ores at a rate of 5x, but its elevated position makes it hard for ores to reach, compared to other furnaces. Consider using an Elevated Furnace instead, as it is more convenient to use.

f.effects: Processes ores at x5 their value
f.drawbacks: Requires ores to be launched or lifted into it

x.t:
• Using a Large Conveyor Ramp just before this item, as the long fall will allow the ore to drop into it.

• A simple, but a rather risky method, is to launch ores using the Ore Cannon. However, ores are not guaranteed to pop in as it has an unstable trajectory.
• Using an Ore Elevator and a fast Way-Up-High upgrader, you can also almost guarantee it to hit the Reinforced Furnace.

quote: A fast limited-edition conveyor.
overview: The Swag Conveyor is a Collectible conveyor that goes at 250% speed and has slanted walls. It can only be obtained from the first use of your Discord code, via the Discord Integration.

quote: Attaches to the side of raised conveyors and upgrades passing ore by 80% up to six times. Doesn't upgrade ore worth more than $1Qn.
overview: The Portable Macrowave is an Epic-tier portable upgrader that attaches only to Raised-ier Conveyors or items at a similar height. It is the only portable upgrader that does this. It upgrades ore value by 80% (x1.8 multiplier) up to $1Qn and is capped at 6 upgrades per ore. After the 6 upgrades, the multiplier ends at x34.01222.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by x1.8 (80% increase)

• 6 upgrades at most for ores under $1Qn
• Ores $1Qn or greater in value get only one upgrade, but only works provided it hasn't been upgraded by this 7 times already

quote: The Ore Supernova grants a massive upgrade to all dropped ores when activated. Ores can only be upgraded by it once.

The Ore Supernova is a Slipstream-tier Pulsar upgrader added on The Slipstream Mini Patch in The Ultimate Update.
When the "Pulse" button is pressed, this item will multiply every single ore that has been dropped on your base by a whopping x500. But despite its great multiplier, it has a very long cooldown, taking just over a full minute to become active once again. However, this can be easily bypassed by replacing/moving the item.
In relation to the Gargantium Mine, its ores are given immunity to fire.
This powers Interstellar Conqueror by giving it x5.975 more multiplier.

This caps at a x55,000 multiplier at life 110,000. However, by this point, Nature's Enchantment will be phased out for better furnaces and its only use would be to craft a Dreamer's Life.

The Burst Refiner is a Slipstream-tier upgrader hinted and implemented on the same day on the 11 th of March, 2017.
It normally upgrades ore by 15x, but every 9 th ore is upgraded by 500x. Ores that receive the 2nd upgrade will turn bright red and neon material. The average multiplier is 68.89x.

The Clover Shrine was an Exotic upgrader added in the 2017 St. Patrick's Day Event.
It multiplied ore value by a simple 3x with no drawbacks. It also has an upgrade counter of 0, so ore that go through this upgrader are still cell-compatible.

The Easter Shrine will drop an egg every 20 ores processed. The value of the egg is equal to the sum of the values of the ores processed since the last egg drop, multiplied by 125. quote: The power of the illuminati took a fearsome furnace and made it even more powerful. Remote click to activate.
overview:
The Dark Illuminator is a Reborn Fusion remote furnace, a fusion between the Ore Illuminator and the Dark Magic, added on Part 2 of the 2017 Summer Update.
It functions as a buffed version of the Dark Magic. Instead of the usual 12x and 45x while activated, it has a normal 500x multiplier and a 5,000x multiplier while activated. It also processes ores at an additional 5,000 multiplier (5,500x for deactivated and 10,000x for activated) if the ore processed has been upgraded by any illuminator item.
Ores processed while the furnace is not activated have their processed value shown in grey colour; a sharp green shade is used for ores processed while the furnace is activated.
The first remote click is delayed for 1 second until the Dark Illuminator activates. Every click adds 0.7 seconds to its activation timer. The furnace's size is also slightly smaller than its lesser counterpart, the Dark Magic, by 1 unit lengthwise.

The SpookDemon-66,666 is an Exotic dropper. It was part of the Halloween 2018 event, released on October 29th, 2018.
The SpookDemon-66,666 has a similar effect to its older relative, the SpookLord-95,000, in which it has its own upgraders. The upgraders come in the form of ghosts, which are created upon the combination of a coal ore and the ore from this dropper, destroying both ore in the process. They multiply ore value by 2x, and up to 11 ghosts can be present at any given time. Replacing the dropper also destroys the ghosts, requiring the user to recreate them.

f.effects: Ghosts double ore value

x.t:
The base ore value is $100M. This value is then multiplied by the user's Inferno Boxes and Pumpkin Boxes added together, and then by your life. To compensate for this, it cannot be processed by most cell furnaces, with few exceptions, such as the Blind Justice.
It is also multiplied by the MOTD value (Pizza Party Event was -88, which caused it to break).

Compared to the Sakura Garden's x300 multiplier, this item has a x9,500 base multiplier. The effect of ores, namely decreasing the multiplier by 5 or by 10 with flaming ore or ore from the Toxic Waste Disposal, meaning this furnace can also result in a negative multiplier just like the Sakura Garden. The negative multiplier will reset (0x) if processed with a flaming ore.
As of the Reincarnation Update, this item was nerfed to a base multiplier of x9,500, however the decreasing multiplier was buffed to 5 or 10 (Ores or Flaming Ores). Its RP yield had been buffed to 90 RP/20 ores, however it has been confirmed that this is accidental. The supposed RP rate is 90 RP/200 ores.

f.drawbacks:
• Multiplier decreases by x5 for every processed ore
• Multiplier decreases by x10 for every flaming ore, ore is not processed

quote: Justice is swift... but it is forgiving. Processes more upgraded ore at a higher value.
overview:
The Swift Justice is an Evolved Reborn cell furnace, the successor to the Blind Justice, first revealed on Berezaa's YouTube on 23 August, 2017.
It multiplies ore value based on its upgrade counter, starting at a base multiplier of x5B. For every positive upgrade counter of +1, its multiplier is reduced by 500M, and vice versa. Since it caps at 3.2 upgrades, it has a minimum multiplier of x3.4B.

f.source: Evolve with 7 Blind Justices at The Craftsman
f.effects:
• Base multiplier of x5B.
• Multiplier changes depending on ore's upgrade counter. (see overview)
f.drawbacks: Doesn't work on ores with more than 3.2 upgrade counter.

quote: A more powerful spore that not only removes negative status effects but draws power from them.
overview: The Deadly Spore is an Evolved Reborn upgrader. The Deadly Spore multiplies ore value by 7x and well as removing all negative status effects from the upgraded ores. Its multiplier is increased to x10 if Dreamer's Blight is placed down, or x11 if a Dreamer's Devastation is placed instead.

f.source: Evolve with 12 Wild Spores at The Craftsman.
f.effects:
• Removes negative status effects
• Multiplies ore value by 7x, x10 if ⟦Dreamer's Blight⟧ is on the base, x11 if ⟦Dreamer's Devastation⟧ is on the base
f.upgrade_limit:
1
(Negative effect removal can be used infinitely) · resettable

quote: An incredibly dense version of the Red Giant that upgrades much faster and has potential to upgrade twice if aimed correctly.
overview:
The Neutron Star is an Evolved Reborn Upgrader. It is the evolution of the Red Giant, and was released in The Resurrection Update on September 19th, 2017.
Ores that hit the main upgrade beam are set on fire for 3 seconds; if not doused they will be destroyed. The Neutron Star also features a drawback where if the same ore is upgraded by the same Neutron Star too frequently in a short amount of time, the ore will be destroyed.
The fire that this upgrader applies to upgraded ore is a bright white instead of the Red Giant's deep reddish-orange.

f.source: Evolve with 10 Red Giants at The Craftsman.
f.effects:
• Main upgrade panel upgrades ores by x1.65 to x1.065
• Secondary upgrade beam upgrades ores by x2 to x1.1
• (See "Upgrade Reduction" section for more information)
f.drawbacks:
Ore is set on fire and is destroyed after 3 seconds.
Incompatible with the ⟦Black Dwarf⟧ and ⟦Void Star⟧.

x.t: As an ore's value begins to near the Neutron Star's cash limit of $1TVg, the upgrade itself begins to decrease in potency. This attribute is also shared with other stars, like the Catalyzed Star.

quote: A horrifying version of the dragon blaster that hits ores three times at once.
overview:
The Hydra Blaster is an Advanced Evolution blaster, successor to the Dragon Blaster, It was initially revealed during Berezaa's YouTube Stream on 23 rd August, 2017 and added in the Resurrection Update on 19 th September, 2017.
It upgrades ore value by a random multiplier between x3 to x4.5 (geometric mean ~x3.7078) three times in very quick succession, for a overall multiplier of x27 to x91.1. Each upgrade has a chance to destroy and/or explode ores. It also applies fire to ores.
Each upgrade has a 10% chance to destroy and explode ores, an overall 27.1% chance of at least 1 destruction with each use. Alternatively, the ore may instead only explode without being destroyed, with an equal chance of occuring. As it upgrades multiple times, the chance it destroys and explodes ores is very likely, when compared to other Blasters.
The upgrader can try to destroy an ore multiple times with one use of the item, so it has a (low) chance to even destroy shielded ores after just one use.

f.source: Evolve with 10 Dragon Blasters at The Craftsman.
f.effects:
• Multiplies ore value by x3 to x4.5 (3 times)
• Total multiplier of 27x to 91.1x
• Sets ores on fire
f.drawbacks:
• 27.1% chance to explode ore without destroying
• 27.1% chance to destroy ore with a simultaneous explosion
• Fire destroys ore in 4 seconds

submission.name: Hydra Blaster
submission.description: Unofficial name

x.t: This table shows the probability of an ore surviving after a certain amount of Hydra Blasters. The multiplier is an average between x3 and x4.5 (x3.75) per upgrade, meaning that it does not represent the maximum possible upgrade. It does not include chances of exploding ore, which Void Drive is excellent for.

quote: A supercharged version of the Quantum Ore Cleaner.
overview:
The Quantum Ore Polisher is an Evolved Reborn upgrader, successor of the Quantum Ore Cleaner, was first revealed during Berezaa's YouTube stream on 23rd August, 2017, later added in the Resurrection Update.
It gives a solid x8 to all ores that passes through.

f.source: Evolve with 7 Quantum Ore Cleaners at The Craftsman.
f.effects: Multiplies ores by x8.

submission.name: Dark Quantum Digitalizer
submission.description:
A BinaryCrimson/Frenzzyy Production
Binarzzyy

quote: An absurdly powerful furnace with a greater appetite than the Northern Lights.
overview:
The Aurora Borealis is an Advanced Evolution furnace, successor to the Northern Lights, added in the Resurrection Update. It was first revealed during Berezaa's YouTube Stream on 23 rd August, 2017.
It has a base multiplier of x0. In order to increase the multiplier, the furnace requires a source of sparkling coal ore, for which every piece that is processed, the multiplier is increased by +625.
The multiplier caps at x24,000; or 39 pieces of sparkling coal ore. Its charge decay also takes a lot of ore to kick in, needing 5750 ores to be processed for -1 charge.

f.source: Evolve with 5 Northern Lights at The Craftsman.
f.effects:
• Base multiplier of x0.
• Multiplier increased by +625 for every processed sparkling coal ore.
f.drawbacks:
• Furnace requires input of sparkling coal ore.
• Capped at x24,000.
• -1 charge for every 5,750 ores processed.

x.t:
• Using a Flaming Schrodinger or Vampire Spore can make the coal sparkle to power this furnace.
• The Angel's Blessing also works and much easier to use.
• Santa's Nice List adds sparkle effect on ores often, which is also an option for this furnace.

quote: A superior version of The Catalyst. Upgrades ore by x6 like it's nothing.
overview:
The Saturated Catalyst is an Evolved Reborn upgrader, successor to The Catalyst, added in the Resurrection Update. It was first revealed during Berezaa's YouTube Stream on 23 rd August, 2017.
Just like The Catalyst, this upgrader could be considered a fine-point upgrader because its upgrade beam does not cover the entire conveyor. Also any ores that pass through multiple Ore Sawmills have a chance of not hitting the beam, missing the upgrade.
Another thing to note is that the Catalyzed Star does not share the same Machine tag with this item, so using both is an available option.

f.source: Evolve with 10 The Catalysts at The Craftsman.
f.effects: Multiplies ore value by x8.

submission.name: The Daedalus
submission.description:
Super-saiyan
a TheFrenzzac production

quote: Takes significantly longer to kick in but is much more powerful than the Astral Predictor when it does.
overview:
The Astral Setter is an Evolved Reborn-tier upgrader, successor of the Astral Predictor. It was added on 19 September, 2017 in the Resurrection Update. It was first revealed during Berezaa's YouTube Stream on 23 August, 2017.
The Astral Setter upgraders like its predecessor, multiplying ore value over time, dependent on a random number generator, but with a buffed multiplier of 1.2x.
The probability for each outcome listed below is the same.
It is recommended to put this item near the beginning of your setup, as well as long before or after any Education-giving upgraders so that ores have all the time they need in order to receive the full upgrade.
Like its predecessor, the upgrading will still persist through any resetting device, but replicator copies will not inherit the upgrading effect.

f.source: Evolve with 12 Astral Predictors at The Craftsman.
f.effects: Multiplies ore value by 1.2x every 0.2s for a total duration between 2.2s to 5.2s
f.drawbacks: Does not upgrade immediately, can cause issues in 1-line rebirth setups
f.multiplier_length:
Minimum - x1.65
Maximum - x3.27
Average - x2.32

quote: Unlocked version of Symmetrium that can produce many ores at once. Will break if more than one is placed down. Ores stop being upgraded if they lose their fire.
overview:
The Symmetryte Mine is an Evolved Reborn mine, successor to the Symmetrium Mine, first revealed during Berezaa's YouTube Stream on August 23, 2017. It was later added on the 19 September, 2017, in the Resurrection Update.
Unlike its predecessor, only one Symmetryte Mine can be placed that will drop ore. The Symmetryte Mine has one disadvantage over the Symmetrium Mine, which is not being able to reach cells from the far side.

f.source: Evolve with 8 Symmetrium Mines at The Craftsman.
f.effects: Ore is naturally fireproof.
f.drawbacks: Placing more than one Symmetryte Mine on the base will cause one of them to stop working.

quote: A wonderful machine that permanently changes the color of your baseplate
overview: The Base Colorizer is a Luxury utility customization tool that can be placed on your base. It was developed live during Berezaa's YouTube stream on August 27th, 2017. It is equipped with 24 colored buttons. Upon clicking a button, the color of your baseplate will change to the corresponding color.

f.effects: Changes the color of your baseplate.

quote: Changes the material of your entire tycoon's baseplate!
overview:
The Base Materializer is a Luxury utility customization tool that can be placed on your base. It was developed live on Berezaa's YouTube on August 27th 2017. The item was released in the Resurrection Update. The Base Materializer is equipped with a set of buttons with different materials on them and clicking them will change the texture of the player's base to the corresponding material. Base textures include:
• Slate
• Grass
• Concrete
• Granite
• Marble
• Sand
• Wood Planks
• Smooth Plastic
• Pebble
• Corroded Metal

f.effects: Changes the material of your baseplate.

quote: A mine made by an ancient civilization. There has to be more to it than meets the eye.
overview:
The Precursor Mine is an Advanced Reborn mine, counterpart of the Precursor Furnace. It was added in the The Resurrection Update and was revealed by Berezaa on his Twitter page, soon proving that it was a Reborn item. It was later changed to Advanced Reborn-tier in the Reincarnation Update.
It drops one ore worth $1B to $5B every 2 seconds, and the ores work in cell furnaces. Its main gimmick, however, is its exclusive ability to activate the Precursor Furnace, bumping its multiplier up from

f.effects: Activates ⟦Precursor Furnace⟧

quote: A furnace made from technology older than humanity itself. Once incredibly powerful, its secret has been forgotten.
overview:
The Precursor Furnace is an Advanced Reborn furnace, counterpart to the Precursor Mine. It was added in the The Resurrection Update and was revealed by Berezaa on his Twitter page, soon proving that it was a Reborn item.
The Precursor Furnace normally processes ores at x70. However, it becomes activated when it processes an ore from the Precursor Mine, to which it then processes every ore at x500. This means as long as you process one precursor ore in this furnace, every ore until you rebirth or replace the furnace will process at x500.

f.effects:
Base multiplier of x70
⟦Precursor Mine⟧ ore activates furnace, increasing multiplier to x500

quote: A device that blasts ores with so much freon that it becomes immune to fire for a minute.
overview:
The Freon Bombarder is a Luxury utility fine-point upgrader and one of the first Luxury-tier items in the game. It makes ores fireproof, not allowing the ore to be set on fire no matter how many igniting items the ore goes through.
The Freon Bombarder also makes ores frozen. Some upgraders require the ores to be frozen in order to have an effect, such as the Frigid Dystopia, Turbine Chamber, and Cooling Chamber.
Even though there are sprays on the upgrader, the ore must hit the center beam to become fireproof and frozen.

f.effects:
Makes ores fireproof and frozen.
Gives ores an icy texture.
f.drawbacks:
Fine-Point upgrader beam.
Makes ores slippery.

quote: A trophy given to the decorated developers on the Roblox Dev Forums. Develop on!
overview: The RBXDev Statue is a Fabled-tier statue only awarded to members of the ROBLOX Developer Forums. It is a rotating statue that holds the old logo of the RBXDev Forums.

f.requirements: Be a member of the Developers Forums on ROBLOX.

submission.name: RBXDev Statue
submission.description: A statue fit for developers.

quote: A trophy awarded to Addicted Miners for winning the Research Points contest in 2017.
overview:
The Research Points Trophy is a decorative social item, that was added in the Resurrection Update. This is the reward for the ROBLOX Group Addicted Miners for winning the Miner's Haven Clan Contest, which occurred in late April of 2017.
You can still obtain this item by joining Addicted Miners Roblox Group.

quote: An infuser that ignites your character with a bright glow and increases your speed.
overview: The Glow Infuser is a Luxury infuser added in The Resurrection Update. It gives your character +7 Walkspeed and a glow radius to the player, which useful for tracking yourself at night due to the return of pitch black night time. Players may only be infused once per life, or twice with a Resetting Infuser.

f.effects:
Grants a Glowing Effect
Increases walkspeed by 7
f.drawbacks: Player can only be infused once without a ⟦Resetting Infuser⟧.

submission.name: Glow Infuser ORIGINAL
submission.description: "SHINE BRIGHT LIKE A DIAMOND"

quote: A handy machine that paints any ore which pass through.
overview: The Ore Painter is a Luxury utility item that was added in The Resurrection Update. It allows the player to colour their ore from a choice of 33 colours. This has no usage limit, meaning it can be used as many times as desired. It has no effect on the value of ores. (Unless paired with upgraders that give multi based on the color of an ore.)

f.effects: Changes the color of ores that pass through depending on the color selected.

submission.name: Chromatic Accelerator
submission.description: "A joint ore upgrader and colouriser."

quote: Pirate mercenaries continuously upgrade the value of the last ore that enters their cove.
overview:
The Pirate Cove is an Exotic upgrader released in the Resurrection Update on 19 September, 2017.
Once an ore crosses the upgrader, the ore is then latched onto by a RopeConstraint. For every time the rope flashes yellow, the ore is multiplied by 1.13x until it times out (at 25 flashes, or about 15 seconds) and lets go, or when another ore crosses the upgrader. This gives an ore that remains in the upgrader for the full time the max multiplier of 21.2x.
Like some other exotics, this can be bought from The Masked Man. It is currently sold at 740 to 1.51k uC.

f.effects: For every "flash", ore value is multiplied by x1.13 up to 25 times. Total multiplier of 21.2x.

submission.name: Sand Meme
submission.description: "collab with tongrats"

quote: Warm cleansing spring water processes your ore at eight times their value... if you can reach it.
overview: The Natural Spring is an Advanced furnace that was released in The Resurrection Update. It multiplies ore value by 8x but requires a Large Conveyor Ramp to reach it.

f.effects: Processes ores at x8 ore value.
f.drawbacks: Requires elevation.

submission.name: Idyllic Future
submission.description: "This was originally the opposite of a furnace I did. But it's now added as a shop item for anyone to buy for $50B."

quote: A mystical spire that processes ores based on how few machine tags they have.
overview:
The Timeless Enhancement is a Reborn furnace added in The Resurrection Update.
It processes ores based on their lifespan, starting at x80 for up to 1 minute, x70 for up to 5 minutes, x50 for up to 9 minutes, and x30 for a lifespan longer than 10 minutes.

f.effects:
Processes ore at greater multipliers the shorter the ore's lifespan:
0-1 minute = x80
2-5 minutes = x70
5-9 minutes = x50
10 minutes+ = x30
f.drawbacks: Multiplier deteriorates as ore lives longer.

quote: A raised upgrader that can be used once to increase the value of ore based on the amount of upgrade tags it has.
overview:
The Spectral Upgrader is an unusually thin Novice upgrader added in The Resurrection Update.
The Spectral Upgrader multiplies ore value based on the amount of machine tags the ore has. It starts at a base multiplier of x4.2, and decreases by 0.1 for every machine tag. This effect should not be confused with the Upgrade Counter, as that is dependent on the upgrader's effect itself, while this item is dependent on the number of unique machines/upgraders an ore passes through.
Each unique upgrader only decreases the multiplier of this upgrader by 0.1 regardless of how many times that upgrader is used. Therefore, this is best used at

f.effects:
Base multiplier of x4.2
Multiplier is reduced by -0.1 for each machine tag
f.drawbacks:
≤ 40 machine tags:
-0.1 for each machine tag until x0.5 is reached
> 40 machine tags:
no upgrade
f.multiplier_length:
0 machine tags - x4.200
(multiplier per length = normal multiplier)

quote: A parched shamble of bones that upgrades ore depending on how cold it is.
overview:
The Scorching Heat is a Reborn-tier upgrader added in the Resurrection Update.
The Scorching Heat multiplies flaming or fireproof ore by 5x, destroying any other ores.
(Does not work with ores that have the Eternal Flames effect.)

f.effects: Multiplies flaming or fireproof ore value by 5x
f.drawbacks: Non-flaming ore are destroyed

quote: A fiery hot upgrader which can only upgrade ores that are on fire. Can be used several times with no cash limit.
overview:
The Ore Roaster is an Intermediate upgrader added in The Resurrection Update. It's multiplier begins with x2, and then is reduced by x0.2 for every further upgrade up to 6 times for a total of ~9.7. However, an ore must be on fire to receive any upgrade.
Using a Portable Flamethrower, you can safely upgrade an ore with 4 Ore Roasters before needing to place something that removes fire, like a Wild Spore or its variants. This is the best way to use this item for the size it takes up.

f.effects:
• Initial multiplier starts at x2
• Multiplier reduced by x0.2 for every upgrade
f.drawbacks:
• Limited to 5 upgrades per ore
• Ore must be on fire

submission.name: Lava Support Upgrader
submission.description: lel

quote: An over-complicated upgrader that can triple the value of ore up to three times.
overview: The Ore Winder is an Epic upgrader added in The Resurrection Update. Due to its compact design, it only transports ores smaller than 1x1x1 studs. It transports ores from the Way-Up-High elevation to ground level, all the while tripling its value in the process. This upgrader can be used for a total of 3 times for a total multiplier of x27.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by 3x
f.drawbacks: Ores larger than 1x1x1 get stuck in the second level

x.t:
• As its ground conveyor is not blocked off from behind, ores can be put in from there. Since the upgrade beam is on the second level, ores will however, not be upgraded.
• This can be used as a cheaper, but thinner alternative to the Full Shield Conveyor for blaster loops.
• Because of its conveyor design, you can make portable upgraders upgrade 2 times when placed through the middle.
• If your ores are slippery, the ores may slip out the back from the momentum of the 2nd layer conveyor.

quote: The guardian is weary of humans and will only reveal his true power when you are far far away.
overview:
The Guardian of the Gate is a Reborn furnace added in The Resurrection Update.
If you're at your base, the gate processes ores at x20 their value. If you're away from your base, the gate processes ores at x200 their value. This becomes obvious as a notification on your screen will appear, saying you have left your base. This furnace works well at early stages in the game after life 250.

f.effects:
Base owner is at base: x20
Base owner is away from base: x200

quote: An old and magical tree fuels this mysterious furnace. Processes ore and then teleports a copy to another furnace.
overview:
The Ancient Magic is an Exotic Furnace added in The Resurrection Update.
It processes ores at a multiplier of x35, then produces a copy of that ore for any other furnace the player has placed down on their base. The duplicated ore does not receive the processing multiplier of 35x from it.

f.effects:
• Processes ore at a multiplier of x35.
• Copies ore and teleports it to a random furnace.
f.drawbacks:
• Destination furnace teleport is random.
• Duplicated ore does not receive 35x.
Incompatible with:
• ⟦Dark Illuminator⟧
• ⟦Dark Magic⟧
• ⟦Devourer of Nightmares⟧
• ⟦Forbidden Magic⟧
• ⟦Volcango⟧
• ⟦Void Drive⟧
• ⟦THE UNDERTAKER⟧

quote: Awarded for helping a player Rebirth for their first time.
overview:
The Statue of Knowledge is a Fabled upgrader, awarded to a player once they obtain the Passer of Knowledge badge (be on the whitelist of a player when they rebirth for their first time, across all save slots). This also applies to people who are lives s-1 or S+1.
The Statue of Knowledge's beam multiplies ore value by x2.5, which certainly proves useful for its small size and portability.

f.source: Help other users rebirth on the 1st life.
f.effects: Multiplies ore value by 2.5x
f.drawbacks: Hard for ore to hit the beam

submission.name: Early Light
submission.description: I need a description

quote: Send your ore through the spooky pumpkin patch for a treat! 2017 Halloween Item.
overview:
The Pumpkin Patch is a Collectible upgrader added to the game in the 2017 Halloween Event.
Like many other upgraders, it doubles ore value with no additional effects and also can only be used once without a resetting device. Additionally, it increases the multiplier of the Great Pumpkin by x2.

f.effects: Upgrades ore by x2

submission.name: Pumpkin Road
submission.description: Wow this is a cool model. I think it should be added :3

quote: Decorate your base with this special spooky bat wall!
overview: The Vampire Wall is a Collectible wall added in Part I of the 2017 Halloween Event.

submission.name: Bat Wall
submission.description: "wont be added"

quote: A powerful but very scary mine. Don't look into its eyes. Halloween 2017 Item.
overview: The Arachnid Mine is a Collectible-tier Multi-Spout Dropper added during the Halloween 2017 Event and was obtained though Pumpkin Boxes. It is named after the arachnid, a group of arthropods which include spiders and scorpions. The ores this mine drops do not line up with the dropper parts.

quote: An ancient dual upgrader that uses strange magic to upgrade ores. As such, it doesn't count as a upgrade. Does spooky things to ores. 2017 Halloween exotic.
overview: The Transylvanian Refiner is an Exotic Way-Up-High upgrader released in Part I of the 2017 Halloween Update. It's a Way-Up-High upgrader with two upgrade panels, both upgrade ore by x2.5 each. Like the Quantum Clockwork, the ore can be upgraded from both of the upgrade panels. The red panel reduces ore transparency by 0.15, and the yellow panel sets ores on fire for a short 3 seconds.

f.effects:
• Each panel multiplies ore value by x2.5
• Combined x6.25 if both panels are hit
• Red panel reduces ore transparency
• Yellow panel sets ore on fire for 3 seconds
f.drawbacks: • Fire destroys ore after 3 seconds

submission.name: oh yeah that's hotter
submission.description: remake of "oh yeah thats hot"

quote: A terrifying creation that shouldn't exist. Ore from this mine start out heavily negated. 2017 Halloween Exotic.
overview:
The Nightmare is an Exotic dropper added in the 2017 Halloween Event.
It features 5 spouts and outputs ore at a fairly fast rate worth $5B each. Its most unique feature, however, is its initial upgrade count of -10.2. This attribute allows its ore to pass through several upgraders and still be cell furnace-compatible as long as the ore's upgrade counter remains at or below zero. (Some cell furnaces have a slight tolerance for upgrades.)

quote: Give your character fancy particles with this unique limited-edition giver. 2017 Halloween Item
overview: The Spooky Particle is a Collectible particle giver added on Part I of the Halloween 2017 event. It grants the user skull particles upon contact.

submission.name: Spooky Particle
submission.description: aaa

quote: The hungry spirit haunts this shrine. It prefers ghostly and interesting ore, but it feasts on all. 2017 Halloween Exotic
overview:
The Hungry Spirit is an Exotic furnace that was added in Part II of the Halloween Event 2017.
It multiplies ore value based on its upgrader counter, fire presence, and transparency.
The conditions to be met are listed below. Note that upgrades based on the conditions are stacked multiplicatively, not additively. x50 and x2 become x100, not x52.
The maximum multiplier of the Hungry Spirit would be for an ore that has less than or equal to -10 upgrader counter, has fire, and is completely invisible. This would yield a multiplier of x500T.
However, it is also worth noting that, even if ores have been upgraded a lot (>=40 upgrader counter), by putting your ores on fire and upgrading it with the Hopeless Bog, the Hungry Spirit is still able to process ores at an unusually high rate of x1000, which is better than a lot of Reborn-tier furnaces.

f.effects: (see overview)

submission.name: Hallowers Harvest
submission.effects: Base multiplier of x200, increases by x10 for every ore with a negative value processed (values of such ores are not added to the player's money)

rows: Greater than -10, but less than or equal to -5
Greater than -5, but less than or equal to -2
Greater than -2, but less than or equal to 0
Greater than or equal to 20, but less than 40
Greater than or equal to 0.8 but less than 1
Greater than or equal to 0.5 but less than 0.8
Greater than or equal to 0.3 but less than 0.5

quote: Haunt your character with cute little ghost particles. 2017 Halloween Item.
overview:
The Ghost Particle is a Collectible particle giver added in Part II of the 2017 Halloween Event.
It grants the user ghost particles upon contact. It can be attained very rarely from Pumpkin Boxes.

quote: A decorative altar awarded to those who obtained the berezaa Roblox toy in the mystical realm of life.
overview:
The Toy Altar is a Fabled-tier decoration item obtained by owning the Azure Mines Pickaxe, a Roblox gear you get for redeeming the code given by the Berezaa figurine from the official ROBLOX toy series.
ROBLOX toys are usually sold in large supermarkets around the world.

quote: A decorative supercomputer that'll impress all the other miners.
overview: The Super Computer is a Luxury decoration added in The Life Saving Update. In basics, it features a large metal table with a computer chair with the addition of a large computer with 6 monitors, each featuring a unique image which is explained further in the trivia.

quote: Sometimes you just gotta 😩
overview: The Weary Wall is a Luxury wall added in the Life Saving Update.

quote: The final gate draws on the power of the eclipse to do mysterious things to ores. Strange magic keeps ore contained within the gate.
overview:
The Final Eclipse Gate is an Evolved Reborn-tier upgrader, sucessor of the Gate of Eclipse, added in The Life Saving Update.
The Final Eclipse Gate is a buffed form of its predecessor, having a 10x multiplier during the day, and a 25x multiplier during the night.

f.source: Evolve with 10 Gate of Eclipses at The Craftsman.
f.effects:
Day: x10
Night: x25
f.drawbacks: Needs to be night to get the best multiplier.

quote: An altar built upon the great sage king. Judges ores based on how many times it has been upgraded.
overview:
The Sage King is an Evolved Reborn-Tier Furnace added in the Life Saving Update.
Just like its unevolved version, for each full upgrade count an ore has the furnace's multiplier increases by x1.75. It has a maximum cap at 314 upgrades counters, which means its maximum multiplier is x550.

f.source: Evolve with 12 Sage Redeemers at The Craftsman.
f.effects: For each full upgrade counter on an ore, the multiplier incrementally increases by 1.75x.
f.drawbacks: ~314 upgrades max (x550)

submission.name: Sage Evo
submission.description: Evo of Sage

quote: |Converts a regular raised path to a miniature one.|Mini|A regular converter for all your raised regular converting needs!|Regular
overview:
The Raised Mini Converter and the Raised Regular Converter are Novice conveyors released in the Second Sacrifice Update and the 2019 Halloween Update, respectively.
The Raised Mini Converter allows ores coming from raised conveyors that are two units wide to be transported on raised upgraders that are one unit wide.
The Raised Regular Converter allows ores coming in from 1-unit wide Raised upgraders to transition into a 2-unit wide Raised Conveyor. The Regular converter also features part of a Centering Conveyor.

quote: A large upgrader which offers huge upgrades to any ore large enough to reach the upgrade beam.
overview: The Overhang Upgrader is a Novice upgrader that was added in Part 2 of the Summer Update 2017. This upgrader multiplies the ore's value by 4 and then adds 10k to it. What makes this upgrader unique is that only ores with a volume of 1.5 cubic studs can reach the upgrader beam if they just go through the upgrader regularly. You can bypass the size requirement for the ores with the methods below.

f.effects:
• Multiplies ore value by x4
• Adds $10k
f.drawbacks: Upgrade beam is above conveyor

quote: A raised upgrader which upgrades ores based on what tax bracket they are in.
overview:
The Raised Wide Upgrader is an Intermediate upgrader with a raised elevation. It was added in the conclusion of the Summer Update 2017. It adds a sum of value to ores that pass through it depending on their value, as shown below:
Seeing as any ore with value above $100k receives a +$50k upgrade, this upgrader only sees use if the player has ores worth less than billions. After billions, this upgrader is essentially useless.

f.effects: Adds value to ore based on current value

x.h: +$ to ore value by ore value

quote: Harnesses the power of subatomic megacollisions to process unupgraded ore at incredible rates.
overview:
The Cell Collider is a Mythic cell furnace that was released on June 10th 2017 in the Second Sacrifice Update. The Cell Collider has been the first shop cell furnace to be released since 2015 (with the release of the Cell Particalizer) and takes its place as the second most powerful shop cell furnace.
The Cell Collider is one of the only cell furnaces with all four sides of the furnace closed, meaning many droppers are unable to drop ores directly into the furnace. Players in many cases would have to launch the ore with an Ore Cannon or Ore Collider and a wall behind the furnace.

f.effects: Processes compatible unupgraded ore by x120T.

submission.name: Ore Condenser
submission.description: 11 days in the making

quote: A testament to the power of the person who wields it. This upgrader trumps all.
overview:
The Final Upgrader is an Ultimate upgrader and resetting device added in Part 2 of the 2017 Summer Update.
To obtain the Final Upgrader, you must perform The Second Sacrifice (available at life s-1000+) and reach life S+10, where it will be awarded like a normal Reborn item would. Once you perform The Second Sacrifice, you will no longer be able to use The Ultimate Sacrifice. A future update will eventually bring about The Third Sacrifice.
The Final Upgrader is the successor of The Ultimate Sacrifice, possessing mostly buffed multipliers. While the Ultimate Sacrifice has the ability to boost ore value with a larger multiplier if they have an upgrade count of 0 or less, the Final Upgrader instead has the ability to further upgrade ore based on a timer between the first and second upgrade, up to 1000x.
This item is the spirit of the now-dead god of Earth, Atalia.

Multiplies ore value by 50x
Resets Machine tags
Resets status effects
2nd usage:
Multiplies ore value by based on time since last upgrade
Ranges from 5x to 1000x
3rd usage:
Multiplies ore value by 1.35x
f.drawbacks:

Multiplier capped at x1000

Upgrade loop caps at $100Qn

The Mini Upgrader is an Mythic-tier upgrader that was added in Part II of the Christmas Update 2019
The multiplier changes as ore get upgraded. The upgrades are as follows:

quote: A terrifying sword that poisons anyone who gets cut by it.
overview:
The Venomshank is a Reborn Weapon giver added in the Summer Update 2017.
The weapon itself is capable of poisoning enemies, causing their inflicted body parts to flicker between normal and light-green. It deals 8% of the opponent's maximum health every second for five seconds (e.g. if their max health is 1000 then DoT is calculated to 80 damage per tick/second), which essentially nullifies any max health buffs that the target spawned with originally. As of the Summer Update Patch, it also gives player a small speed boost when equipped.

• Poison: 8 damage over 5 seconds, last for 25 seconds

quote: A massive hammer that will make your enemies rethink their life.
overview: The Banhammer is a Vintage weapon giver added in the Summer Update 2017. It was first revealed on Berezaa's Twitch on May 25th, 2017 where he mentions Banhammers would have knockback. In one of berezaa's blog posts, it was revealed that it would be a Vintage item obtainable in Mystery Boxes.

quote: Santa's workshop doesn't produce ore, it produces gifts! Some gifts freeze and turn into temporary upgraders! 2015 Holiday Event item.
overview:
Santa's Workshop is an Exotic mingrader added in Part I of the Winter Event 2015.
It was originally found in mystery boxes, but on 25 th December, Headless Santa began selling Santa's Workshop, and on 31 st December, Jak'uhfdor began selling them.
It drops ores worth $550M, occasionally drops a "gray" ore that will turn into a temporary upgrader after 2 to 20 seconds. This temporary upgrader will upgrade ores by x1.07 up to 5 times for a total of x1.4.
Like several droppers on its level, the Santa's Workshop does not work on cell furnaces.

quote: Dubious Noobius is a very strange and even rarer creature. They have the ability to create Noobite Mines, which make more money the richer their owners are.
overview:
The Noobite Mine is a Vintage dropper added in Part II of the 2015 Winter Event.
It drops very special ores in that their value scales up as you get more money, and has the unique appearance of a noob's head. Ore value ranges from $10k to $500M, reaching the cap once the player has $1O or more; this is shown when the ores have a head shape. After a player has reached $100qd, the Noobite Mine will stop working on cell furnaces that only accept ores which have an Upgrade Counter equal to or below 0
Processing the ore of this dropper in a Crystal Altar before it is unsealed will curse it. It is not advisable to use this mine to unseal the furnace for use in setups, as a cursed Crystal Altar will only give x1 multiplier.
The Noobite Mine is considered a meme dropper, thus gaining a x20 multiplier boost from the Ore Memer. It is not advisable to take advantage of this as there are many better options than this mine.

quote: Pumps out large opal ore when remotely activated by the radio.
overview: The Remote Opal Mine is an Advanced remote dropper that can be useful for a player in the early billions. It goes great with mid-game setups. The Remote Opal Mine is commonly used in farms with cell furnaces, eg. Cell Processor.

quote: Shiny opals apparently come from meteorites. They certainly fetch a fortune.
overview: The Opal Mine is an Advanced dropper. While it has good ore value, it is only used for a brief period, if at all, due to the mine's size and poor drop rate. This is usually quickly outclassed by the Osmium Mine or the Osmium Excavator or overshadowed by the cheaper Industrial Diamond Mine.

quote: Lots of rich people like using B ismuth [sic] in jewlery [sic] or something. Doesn't matter, you'll get rich off of it!
overview: The Bismuth Mine is an Advanced dropper. It produces ore more valuable than the Osmium Mine. It isn't seen often in cell mining, but can be useful in conveyor setups as the Bismuth ores are relatively small.

quote: People have been killed for painite. It is simply one of the most valuable materials on the planet.
overview:
The Painite Mine is a Proficient mine that is used mainly in early-life setups in order to Rebirth.
The Painite Mine has the gimmick of having a unique shape. It is shaped like an L, and can be placed on the corners of conveyors or teleporters in order for the ore land safely. The ores it drops are worth $56k.

quote: An advanced coal mine that instantly drops 3 coal ores every 4 seconds while still being the same size as a regular coal mine.
overview: The Triple Coal Mine is a Premium utility mine. As the name suggests, this mine is supposed to drop 3 coal pieces at a time. While it drops ores at a slightly larger interval than its regular counterpart, the Coal Mine, it is better overall due to its triple spout.

quote: Now you've made it to the big league. Diamonds are small but very expensive.
overview: The Diamond Mine is a Novice dropper that most players acquire within their first session in Miner's Haven.

quote: A special mine that produces a diamond ore every time it is activated by a remote radio.
overview: The Remote Diamond Mine is a Novice remote dropper. It drops ores as fast as the player can click. It is the second remote mine you can get in the game.

quote: Words cannot describe the pure horror that this plushie inspires. A relic from the 2015 Halloween Event.
overview: The Undead Doge Plushie is a Collectible doge added in Part III of the 2015 Halloween Event.

Industrial Firecrystal Mine is a Reborn Industrial Dropper added in Part I of the 2015 Spooky Update.
The Industrial Firecrystal Mine is a dropper that produces valuable ores for players in their first few lives but requires coal input. Its ores are also sometimes cell compatible and depends on the upgrade count of the ore dropped.

quote: Lava suspended in the air seems to have special properties on ore. Upgrades ore by 40% up to $1O
overview:
The Suspended Lava Refiner is a Divine upgrader added in Part II of the 2015 Winter Event.
The Suspended Lava Refiner multiplies ore value by x1.40 up to $1O.

The Ambrosia Mine is a Legendary mine that is the third most powerful automatic dropper in the shop, right behind the Rainbonite Mine and Onyx Mine. Its remote variation is the most powerful remote mine bought at the shop.
Ores may not able to replicate itself if used with a Large Conveyor Ramp and an Ore Replicator to the side of the ramp due to small ores size.

submission.description: "This mine extracts amber from the ground and liquify's it then compacts it to make your ore."

quote: An Iron Mine that produces not one, but TWO iron ore!
overview: The Crucible Iron Mine is a Basic dropper. It has two spouts instead of one but cost 5x as much as a Basic Iron Mine. Examples of other mines with more than one spout are the Spitfire Iron Mine, the Boomite Mine and the Triple Coal Mine.

quote: The once mythical firecrystal takes up so much energy to mine that this machine needs to shoot out exhaust flames.
overview: The Firecrystal Mine is a Legendary-tier dropper which is the first one that costs more than the first rebirth ($25Qn). Its ore functions are similar to the Basic Iron Mine, so the ore becomes shinier when they have been upgraded multiple times.

quote: An awesome glowing pink floor made out of pure unobtainium.
overview:
The Unobtainium Flooring is a Premium decoration flooring item.
It has a faint pink glow to it upon placement, and costs 1 uC per piece. It is mainly used for decoration. Like the Wood Flooring, its size is 3x3, but its hitbox actually takes up only a 1x1 square in the center. This means that the edges can be placed under other objects.

f.effects: Emits some light

quote: They say some things are worth their weight in gold. especially gold!
overview:
The Gold Mine is a Intermediate mine with a similar shape to a Basic Iron Mine.
The Gold Mine makes less money than its excavator variant, but it automatically drops ore, is cheaper, and does not require manual operation.

quote: This mine produces a burst of valuable copper every now and then.
overview: The Copper Mine is a Basic dropper that has the slowest drop rate in the game, next to the massive mines. This item is rarely used as it is quickly outclassed by the Crystal Mine or the Gold Mine and Gold Excavator, which all cost about the same price and have much better drop rates and values.

quote: A towering mine that drops massive ore which are worth tons of money.
overview: The Massive Iron Mine is an Intermediate Massive Dropper. It is the cheapest, and first, massive mine in the game. It can be useful for new players, but its ores can get stuck inside of some upgraders (e.g. Rainbow Upgrader).

quote: When in doubt, placing a giant rock in your base is usually the right way to go.
overview: The Giant Rock is an Intermediate decoration that is primarily used for terraforming bases. It's suited to a natural environment and can also serve as a way to hide and shoot, This item also helps in boosting the Book Of Knowledge's multiplier.

quote: Blasts ore at an obscene speed. Ore is multiplied five times if it is somehow recovered.
overview:
Ore Collider is a Proficient utility upgrader cannon. It uses the same mechanic as the Ore Cannon and launches ore that touches the tip of the conveyor. It multiplies ore value by 5x, up to 5 times. This results in the max multiplier of 3125x. However, the collider is extremely powerful, much more so than the Ore Cannon. This makes it hard to use as it flings ores far into the sky, never to be seen again.
The distance the ore is flung is dependent on its weight and size. The heavier and larger the ore, the shorter the distance it flings. For example, Basic Iron Mine ores fly much further than Dragonglass Mine ores of the same size, but 2x2x2 basic iron ores flies a shorter distance.

f.effects:
• Multiplies ore value by x5
• Propels ore forwards into the air

x.t:
• One way to use the Ore Collider is to use Molten Forge with it. The Molten Forge makes the ores so dense that the ores velocity is comparable to that of an Ore Cannon.
• Using Hydraulic items above a closed small space is also an easy way to utilize this item's good multiplier safely in early-game setups
• Using a Centering Conveyor, then an Ore Collider then an Ore Steamer with standard-sized ores will allow the player to easily catch the ores and get an upgrade from the collider.
• Using a Centering Conveyor before, the Ore Collider, and 5 Hydraulic Conveyors in a line slightly above the Collider the player can make a proto-"Railgun Cannon." (Use 3 hydraulic conveyors, starting from the upgrade beam of the collider, if using newtonium/yuntonium ores/ores with similar density). This method of launching ores isn't as stable as using a regular setup, but it makes setups about 2-3x faster, making it totally worth using if you are fine with the inconsistency.
• Ore density is not the main factor in deciding how far the ore is flung. Ores from Massive Droppers, even ones that aren't very dense, don't fling far, while small, dense ores from mines like the Draconicglass Mine are flung into space.
• Another way to use this effectively is with a Gravitational Gearwork (or its evolution). By raising it just above and placing it directly in front it is possible to get the upgrade from the Ore Collider, the Gravitational Gearwork, and having a super fast line of upgraders.

quote: Pure research-grade plutonium. Don't tell the government about this.
overview: The Plutonium Mine is an Intermediate dropper that is the only automatic mine with a cost ranging in the hundreds of millions. It is similar to the Plutonium Excavator, although that is more frequently used due to similar price and better ore value/drop rate.

quote: Buying a remote mine gives you access to a radio gui that allows you to remotely active [sic] this mine.
overview: The Remote Iron Mine is a Basic remote dropper. It was the first remote mine that players could obtain in Miner's Haven, until the Resurrection Update, when it was removed from the shop. It was placed back into the shop in the 2019 Christmas Update.
date:
Initial Release
Added back on 23 December, 2019

quote: I don't want to know how those orcs made this fire. It's inhuman.
overview:
The Magifyre is a Premium-tier decoration that can be bought from the shop for 12 uC.
It gives off a dark glow at night and is similar to the Bonfire. The Magifyre was part of the 2015 Halloween event but remained in the shop.

f.effects:
Light source
Charges the ⟦Book of Knowledge⟧

overview: Orbital Antimatter Uplink is a Proficient dropper] that has a unique way of dropping ore. Rather than dropping the ore from the translucent white block of the mine, the ore falls from the sky and lands in an area somewhere in front of the uplink. The chances of an ore hitting a target area is low, so surrounding the uplink with conveyors or teleporters will be useful.

quote: Shaped like a cobra poised to attack, the Darkmatter mine is a scary machine that shows just how far we've come.
overview: The Darkmatter Mine is a Legendary mine obtainable in the shop for $97sx.

quote: They say money doesn't buy happiness. Ask them if they've ever purchased a massive gold mine?
overview: The Massive Gold Mine is an Advanced Massive Dropper. This is useful for players that are in the early billions; players at this level could place it with a Cell Processor.

quote: Uranium may be highly radioactive and generally unsafe, but boy does it make good money on the open market.
overview: The Uranium Mine is a Novice mine that new players will find quite useful for their early-game setups with its ore value of $3k.

x.t:
• A cheap way to make a great amount of cash for new players is to use a lot of Uranium Mines and Cell Incinerators.
• The ores this mine drops are larger than average for standard mines.

quote: Named after the scientist that discovered it, berezium mine is worth a ton of money. However, the mine is MASSIVE.
overview:
The Berezium Mine is a Collectible dropper. It was named after Berezaa, the creator of Miner's Haven, added in the Initial Release.
It was removed in The Resurrection Update, and was replaced by the Emerald Mine. Later, the item was re-added in the Halloween 2019 Event as one of the items sold by the Headless Baron. It also made a return in the Halloween 2020 Event, being sold by The Masked Man.

quote: Communicates with Spawn Beacons to allow you to spawn in with a temporary forcefield. Requires at least 1 Spawn Beacon placed.
overview: The Forcefield Generator is a Premium utility item added in the Halloween Event 2015. It allows the player to spawn with a short force field, assuming they have also placed a Spawn Beacon; otherwise, it will not work. This was used during classic PvP to disallow players from being spawn-killed.

f.effects: Allows player to spawn with a forcefield.
f.drawbacks: Requires a Spawn Beacon for it to work

quote: Summer is all about fresh starts. Processes ore at an incredible rate for players who haven't Rebirthed or are in their first five lives.
overview:
The Oasis is an Exotic furnace released in the 2017 Summer Update.
The Oasis features a wooden boat which can be sat in and driven around by the player. The furnace's multiplier increases depending on how far away the boat is from the furnace, from a minimum of x50 to a maximum of x2000. The multiplier increases by x1 for every 2 studs (2/3 of an in-game unit) of distance between the furnace and the boat.
A good way to move the boat is with the Witch's Broomstick.

f.effects:
• Base multiplier of x50.
• Multiplier increases by +1 per 2 studs (2/3 of a unit) distance between boat and furnace.
f.drawbacks: Capped at x2000

quote: Silver ore is worth more than Iron and is mined much quicker.
overview: The Silver Mine is a Basic mine. It has a very high drop rate for low level mines.

quote: Platinum is like gold, except shinier and the mine glows for some reason.
overview: The Platinum Mine is a Certain-. It produces platinum ore worth $200 which makes it useful for early game setups.

quote: A futuristic pad that sends people flying much higher into the air than regular jump pads.
overview: The Thrust Pad is a Premium utility. It is the premium variant of the Jump Pad, and has a larger thrust hence its name.

f.effects: Thrusts player into the air

quote: An Iron Mine from a parallel universe where people are addicted to strange spinny things.
overview:
The Spinnerite Mine is a Premium mine added on 7 June, 2017 on the so-called Fidget Spinner Patch, which only included the Spinnerite Mine and a fidget spinner item, available upon joining the game.
The Spinnerite Mine can currently be obtained from mystery boxes and the shop for 45 uC. Initially, it was obtained from a Daily Gift.

quote: Turns you into an adorable mini-you! Also makes you super fast. Does not stack with other infusers.
overview: The Mini Infuser is a Vintage infuser that was released on June 10th, 2017 along with Part I of the Summer PVP Update. It gives your character +10 Walkspeed and shrinks your character's size by ~3/4. Players may only be infused once per life, or twice with a Resetting Infuser.

The Computer is a Proficient decoration added during the Second Sacrifice Update.
This decoration features a wooden chair (which you can sit on) and a desk. The desk features a blueprint which appears to be for a building with a wooden stick which resembles a pencil. Next to that is a mug which contains 2 more pencils. A photo frame is also found on the desk with a picture of Jabenyezza, a mix between Berezaa and habanero (the reason for the y in Jabenyezaa is unknown, maybe to make it sound nice).
The Computer appears to resemble on from the 1980s seeing its box design, the absence of a mouse, and a keyboard (despite that ther

quote: Blow your enemies to bits with this terrifying rocket launcher!
overview:
The Rocket Launcher is an Fabled weapon giver that gives rocket launchers. It can be obtain from The Masked Man. It was first seen on 06/12/2017, during Miner's Haven's second anniversary.
The Rocket Launcher shoots rockets with a small radius that deals 100 damage, with a medium amount of knockback. It can also damage the player, should they shoot the rocket too close to their position.
If the player misses their rocket and flies into the distance, the player can click the fire button again to detonate that rocket.
Berezaa said he would tweak the rocket launcher on 06/13/2017 to add rocket jumping and buffing it as well. The b

f.effects: Gives the player a Rocket Launcher gear.

quote: Happy Birthday! An awesome conveyor to celebrate Miner's Haven's 2nd Birthday!
overview:
The Birthday Conveyor is a Collectible conveyor added on Miner's Haven's second anniversary on 12 June, 2017.
It moves ores at 350% conveyor speed and has a confetti effect above it.

submission.name: Birthday Conveyor
submission.description: I'd like to thank elementninja645 for his helpful ideas in making this conveyor. :)

quote: This machine is powered by pure uranium. While its nuclear effects are simple, by feeding ore with different status conditions, it will boost in power!
overview:
The Nuclear Chamber is a Legendary-tier upgrader added in Part II of the 2019 Christmas Update.
The Nuclear Chamber has a base multiplier of 2x, but this can be increased if an ore has at least 1 status effect. The table below shows the multiplier increase that each status effect gives.
The Nuclear Chamber also has an additional effect in which the more ores enter it, the higher its multiplier becomes. This effect is minimal at first, but does not decay, nor does it require any status effects. Each ore increases the multiplier by +0.01. This caps at a multiplier of x4. The maximum multiplier, when the ore has all 3 effects, is x10.75. (2+4+4.75=10.75)
It is easy to achieve the max multiplier of this item by using a mine with quick drop rate, like the Newtonium Mine or Breech Loader.

f.effects:
• Primary multiplier of x2; increases with status effects
• Secondary multiplier of x1; increases by +0.01 for every ore that enters
• Both multipliers are added together for final multiplier

• Secondary multiplier capped at x4
• 1 use

It is a version of the Full Shield Conveyor with a raised shield to accommodate larger ores from mines such as Gargantium Mine and Newtonium Excavator.

It was added in the Christmas Event 2019. It multiplies ore value by x12 and requires the use of an Ore Cannon or other cannon, but can also be utilized with Hydraulic Conveyors.

The Lord of Tenebrous is an Advanced Evolution weapon giver, successor to the Sword God Shrine, added in Part II of the St. Patrick's Day 2020 event.
This item dispenses Dual Darkhearts when placed. This item behaves like any sword, apart from its special ability, which can be triggered by pressing Z and left-click in quick succession. quote: Dark was their heart, and violent was their soul.' This Infuser grants the user the power to dash by double tapping in a direction, damaging foes unlucky enough to be caught in their path.

The Darkest Infusion was a Fabled infuser added in Part II of the Christmas 2019 event. It was obtained through purchasing the Dark Knight gamepass, but it was replaced by The Darkest Aura.
The Darkest Infusion allowed the user to dash by double-tapping in a certain direction, dealing damage to any player in the way. The distance traveled is dependent on the player's current walkspeed. The Darkest Upgrader is a Fabled upgrader that is only available through buying the Dark Knight Gamepass.
The sword of the statue multiplies ore value by x5 with no additional effects.

quote: The best in town! This upgrader turns silicon ore into entire working game consoles! This upgrader increases present value by 25.
overview:
The Video Game Digitalizer is a Quest-tier upgrader added in the Part II of the 2019 Christmas Event.
Ores dropped from the Silicon Excavator are turned into a retro-style gaming console. It multiplies any other ore by 1x. This item is mainly used for making presents.
True to its description, this item gives the best value to silicon ores adding 25 present value, even better than the MONSTER TRUCKER! by a little bit of value.

f.effects: Turns silicon ore into Video Game Consoles that can be wrapped in the ⟦Ore Wrapper⟧ and turned into presents in the ⟦Present Center⟧.

quote: Upgrade your ore with the light of frosted lights! This item can increase the value of presents.
overview:
The Frosted Refiner is a Collectible upgrader added in Part II of the Christmas 2019 Event.
The Frosted Refiner was used to increase the value of presents. It now multiplies ore value by 1.75x once. It also proves useful as a filler item because of how small it is.

Multiplies the ore value by x1.75

submission.description: Ace Detective

quote: Firecrystal was never expected to be mined in such large quantities. But this mine is capable of finding large clusters of it.
overview:
The Firecrystal Excavator is a Legendary-tier excavator mine added in Part II of the 2019 Christmas Update.
When activated, it drops a large ore worth $1M.

quote: A mine used not for its terrible ore value, but for its ability to be molded into toys!
overview:
The Silicon Excavator is a Quest-tier excavator used to create silicon, an ore that can then can be made into presents for the gift exchange with Jak'uhfdor.
This is the only mine that produces ores that can be made into presents. The Ore Tracker and its variant will cause the ore's current "present value" to be displayed above the ore instead of its monetary value.

f.special_ability:
• [Q] Summons five pillars around the player. After a while, they will violently attack in a wide radius, dealing heavy damage.
• [Double-Click] Dashes forward, doing heavy damage to victims if the move connects.

x.t:
Unleash the power of chaos!
When equipped, the user is able to set other entities on fire simply by being near them (range of roughly 10 units). This fire is only active as long as they are within range; unequipping the sword will remove the fires.
Single clicking will do a simple slash. Slashing is not required as simply touching the sword will deal damage to an opponent.
By double-clicking, the user lunges in whichever direction they double-clicked in, leaving fire in their wake. The fire itself has the potential to instantly kill an entity and the lunge itself applies a constant velocity to the player, meaning that by lunging into a wall, they can fling themselves. The fire left behind lasts about 4 seconds, and the lunge has a 1-second cooldown after finishing.
If you double-click while standing and facing on a steep area, you will be flung high up into the sky. The steeper the area that you are standing on, the higher you will be flung into the sky
Upon pressing Q, 5 red pillars spawn upon the player's location. The pillars spin around inwards and outwards 2 times, dealing damage to whatever touches it. This attack has a cooldown of 20 seconds. This attack is also the same result of Pressing Q with the Crimson Periastron Mu.
Previously, before the 2020 Valentine's Event, pressing Q made the user jump upward, slamming back down onto the ground with their blade, which would spark a large explosion. This explosion had the ability to instantly kill any entity within close range (10 units) and dealt severe damage to those slightly further away (10 to 20 units); those that were too far away to be severely damaged were instead forced back as if hit by an explosion. This is also the natural Special Attack of the original weapon on Roblox.

Using the Stardust Pulsar with the Gargantium Mine and Core will turn them a magenta color, giving affected ores gradual upgrades for a short time.
The Stardust Pulsar takes roughly 37 seconds to recharge, which can be bypassed by replacing it.
