quote: A fix-all solution for putting doges on your base without having them get in the way of ores.
overview: The Hydraulic Doge was a Refined hydraulicdecoration that was added in the Black Friday 2019 update.

quote: The Eternal Staircase. While it may seem to fade away, one can reach the top. By offering it ore from a void corrupted mine, and having it experience the death of reality, the staircase will reveal an alternative path.
overview:
The Eternal Limbo is the Evolved Reborn furnace, the successor to the Eternal Journey, added in Black Friday 2019.
When ore reaches this furnace, they will sit around for exactly thirty seconds before they are fully processed for 19,000x their value. (Ores with effects like poison and fire will still die in this time.)

f.source: Evolve with 20 Eternal Journeys at The Craftsman
f.effects:
• Processes ore at x19,000 times their value.
• Acts as the portal to The Void and the Heart of The Void (see overview)
⭐ Shiny Effect ⭐
• Acts as the portal to the Shiny Void (see overview)
f.drawbacks:
• 30 seconds cooldown to process ore.
• Excess ores are destroyed if they try to enter while another ore is being processed.
f.item_vfx: When an ore gets processed, it is seen climbing up the eternal stairs into oblivion.

submission.name: limbo
submission.description: "how low can you go?"

x.t:
The Eternal Limbo acts as the primary access point to The Void. Three mazes set within the realm can be accessible by combining ore from The Daegelart with an upgrade tag from a maze's associated upgrader, before having the ore get processed by the Limbo.
The associated upgrader are here as follows:
• Daegel's maze - ⟦Void Star⟧ (leads to the Void Drive)
• Heart of The Void - ⟦Daestrophe⟧ (leads to The Forbidden Tome)
For access to the Shiny Void, a shiny version of this item is required. In addition, the furnace must process ore from a The Daegelart, Polished Daegelart that has been upgraded by a Void Star, Stargazed Void Star.

quote: The box. What is inside?? 😱
overview:
The Shoddy Crate is a Fabled artifact item released during Black Friday 2019.
The physical form of the Shoddy Crate Artifact from 2015, it is a small crate that is tilted to an angle. As such, the crate extends beyond its hitbox.

quote: Giant dice that's fun for the whole family! While it's larger than the average human, this dice can be moved around with ease!
overview:
The Giant Dice is a Fabled artifact item released during the 2019 Black Friday Event. It is the physical form of the Gambler's Dice Artifact from 2015.
Similar to the Spicy Meatball, this item can be moved outside of its hitbox to roam anywhere across the map. Players can move the dice around too.

f.effects: Moves if a player comes in contact with it.

quote: A rather wholesome-looking pearl. While it seems purely cosmetic, it'll repel anybody who isn't the owner away from it, allowing you to protect your belongings!
overview:
The Corrupt Pearl is a Fabled defense item added during the 2019 Black Friday Event.
The physical form of the Corrupt Pearl Artifact from 2017, this innocent-looking sphere projects a forcefield extending out for several units. The forcefield will force anyone who is not the base owner out of it, thus making it an ideal tool to safeguard stashes of weapons and infusers from other players.

f.effects: Repels other players away from it when they get too close.

quote: What a funky present. It seems to be rotated at a strange angle. Is this information of use to you? Probably not.
overview:
The Rather Long, But Deluxe Present is an Exotic gift added in Part I of the Christmas Event 2019. It was added along with the Rather Wide, But Deluxe Present into Mystery Boxes until the event ended.
This gift unwrapped to reveal Deluxe Santa's Workshop.

quote: DANG BOY, WHAT A BIG PRESENT!
overview:
The Rather Wide, But Deluxe Present is an Exotic gift added in Part I of the Christmas Event 2019. It was added alongside the Rather Long, But Deluxe Present into Mystery Boxes until the event ended.
This gift unwrapped to reveal the Supreme Christmas Tree.

quote: An upgrader that has 2 different upgrade parts! 2019 Winter Advent Calendar.
overview:
The Dual Festive Refiner was a Collectible-tier upgrader added in the Christmas Event 2019. Players were able to obtain this item on the 12th day of the advent calendar.
It multiplies ore value by 2x for each upgrade beam touched, totalling to a 4x multiplier. Each panel has its own machine tag and both give 0 Upgrade Counter to ores.

f.effects:
• Green: x2
• Red: x2
• Total: x4
f.retire_reason: End of Event/Closure of the Advent Calendar

quote: This device seems to call upon stars and crash them down to the surface! Quite literally, it's a shooting star. Receives bonus upgrade from star items.
overview:
The Stellarite Mine is a Decimal-Rarity Reborn orbital dropper added in the Christmas Event 2019.
The Stellarite Mine acts similar to the Orbital Antimatter Uplink, as it summons ore from high above, around 15-25 studs height and 1-6 studs away from the mine. These ores then drop down at high velocity. Its special ore trait is that the ores of the Stellarite mine ore gain additional upgrades from star items.

f.effects: (see overview)

submission.name: My Life Is In Shambles
submission.description: Nibble Nibble

quote: The combined might of a hydraulic conveyor and an unstable conveyor.
overview: The Hydraulic Unstable Conveyor is a Hydraulic-tier variant of the Unstable Conveyor that was added in a small patch on the 4th of December, 2019.

f.effects: Transport ores at almost any height
f.drawbacks: Caps out at 9 units high

quote: Its funny, this is a reference... Yeah
overview: The Doge Thrower is a weapon that appears to be a doge head with clown paint, held in the right hand of the player's avatar. The method to obtain it is via opening an executive crate dropped by an executive member's daily gift, or to touch the ⭐Ghost Ore Memer⭐.

f.source:
• Touching Ore Memer, Ghost Ore Memer
• Daily Gift with the Executive Membership Gamepass.
f.effects: Launches a random doge head.
f.drawbacks: Can only be used once every 4 seconds. Doge head despawns after 20 seconds.

quote: Nanocrystals, son. They power other electrical based appliances when charged with an electrical power.
overview:
The Tempest Refiner is the Evolved Reborn variant of the Lightningbolt Refiner, released on December 6th, 2019.
Aside from the 6x to 10x upgrade, it also activates other lightning-related items on your base, which include the Arcane Lightning, Lightningbolt Refiner, and the Lightningbolt Predictor without needing to press the buttons on those upgraders. Each click powers up the Tempest Refiner for about 2 seconds.
While the Tempest Refiner does indeed share the same machine tag with all other lightning-related items, it does not seem to upgrade ore on the 2nd upgrade. Thus, it would be a wise choice to use a different item right

f.source: Evolve with 20 Lightningbolt Refiners at The Craftsman.
f.effects:
1st upgrade:
Multiplies ore value by 6x to 10x
2nd upgrade:
Does nothing
3rd upgrade and onward:
Random chance of 1 of the 3 outcomes occuring:
• Does nothing
• Multiplies ore value by 6x to 10x
• Ore is destroyed
f.drawbacks:
• Third usage onward: Chance to destroy ore
• Cumulative usage increases chance of ore being destroyed

submission.name: big tower evo
submission.description: "shoutout to lord_piro for giving me the terrain color scheme and a hidden easter egg"

quote: To this day, the origins of the material this mine harvests is still unknown. What we do know is that we are robbing a dimension of eternal wealth.
overview:
The Dimension Extractor is an Evolved Reborn mine, successor to the Breech Loader, added in the Reincarnation Update.
Like its predecessor, it is tilted at an angle, making it slightly more difficult to use than a conventional mine. It also retains the ability to occasionally duplicate its own ore. This happens at a small chance and requires no maintenance. The chance of the ore getting duplicated seems to be smaller than Breech Loader.

f.source: Evolve with 12 Breech Loaders at The Craftsman.
f.effects: Ores can duplicate themselves at a small chance

submission.name: Breech Accelerator
submission.description: FAT BREECH LOADER

quote: Quite an antique. The wooden design gives Clockwork an even greater value to it. Of course, it's not a clock if it doesn't upgrade ore based on the time.
overview:
The Grandfather Clockwork is an Evolved Reborn upgrader, successor of the Clockwork. It was added in the Christmas Event 2019.
The Grandfather Clockwork features a semi-transparent pendulum acting as a fine-point upgrade beam. The pendulum multiplies ore value depending on the current hour in the UTC time zone, starting at a massive 28x and decreases every hour to a measly x5. The multiplier resets each day at midnight.

f.source: Evolve with 11 Clockworks at The Craftsman.
f.effects:
Multiplier determined by:
5 + (Current Time in UTC)
f.drawbacks: Inconsistent multiplier

submission.name: Grandfather Clockwork
submission.description:
grandson: grandpa, where'd you get this?
me, frenzzyy, the metaphorical grandfather: well this story starts back in April of 2016

quote: All that glitters is gold. Only shooting stars break the mold. Ores cannot be reduced in size.
overview:
The King Gold Mine is a Decimal-Rarity Reborn Massive Dropper added in Part I of the 2019 Christmas Event.
It holds an upgrade counter of -50. This allows it to go through numerous upgraders and still be compatible with cell furnaces. With the addition of upgraders with 0 upgrade count or negative upgrade count upgraders, you can boost its ore value even further. However, its huge ore size cannot be changed, stopping it from working with the likes of Ore Sawmill, Witch's Cauldron, or even [[Or

f.drawbacks: Ore can't be shrunk.

submission.name: King Gold Mine
submission.description: "only shooting stars break the mold"

quote: This ore is extremely unstable, but in a good way. While it's an atomic explosion if it is split in half, it gains advantages through particle acceleration!
overview:
The Atomyke Mine is an Evolved Reborn mine, successor to the Atomium Mine. It was added in the Reincarnation Update.
It serves as a direct buff to its predecessor, dropping ore that are worth, on average, 20x as much as its ore dropped by its predecessor. It also carries over its unique gimmick of receiving gradual upgrades from sparkles, which have a small chance to destroy the ore.
Passing Atomyke ore through an Ore Sawmill will cause an explosion.
(Item requires further testing)

f.source: Evolve with 15 Atomium Mines at The Craftsman.
f.effects: Sparkles give x1.05 upgrades every 0.25s for a duration between 5s and 10s
f.drawbacks:
Each upgrade from the sparkles has a chance to destroy the ore
Will explode if sent through an ⟦Ore Sawmill⟧ or ⟦Ore Chainsaw⟧

submission.name: Moleculium Mine
submission.description: revamped it so that you nerds can't call it 'too atomium like'

quote: A device that used to fill the skies during the steampunk era. Today, people confuse this as a UFO.
overview:
The Atmospheric Steamwork is an Evolved Reborn upgrader, successor of the Gravitational Gearwork, added in the Reincarnation Update.
The Atmospheric Steamwork multiplies ore value by a flat x14. However, it requires ore to be launched or have the anti-gravity effect in order to hit the beam.

f.source: Evolve with 13 Gravitational Gearworks at The Craftsman.
f.effects: Multiplies ore value by x14
f.drawbacks: Anti-Gravity

quote: Jak had a basket of eggs and couldn’t wait until Easter to give it to you.
overview:
The Gift of Funny Eggs 🥚 is an Exotic gift added in Part II of the Christmas Event 2019.
This gift unwrapped to reveal the Easter Statues 🗿.

quote: At long last, you've found it: the free VIP at the end of the game. This is a Premium Gamepass exclusive.
overview:
The Rainbow Path Giver is a Fabled-tier gear giver added in Part I of the 2019 Christmas Event. This item is obtainable to players who owns the Premium Membership Gamepass.
The Rainbow Path Giver serves multiple purposes with its most prominent use of giving users a Rainbow Path Tool. this item allows users to fly around the map by spawning rainbow parts under them, which were often seen as a completion prize in old-style Roblox obbies.
The Rainbow Path Giver also features:
• A classic purple spawn point, but this does not appear to be functional.
• A Rainbow Dominus hat giver which upon touching w

f.source:
Premium Membership Gamepass
Small chance of getting the Path Tool from a daily gift box.
f.effects: Gives the player a Rainbow Path gear.

submission.name: Rainbow Path Giver
submission.description: "ZOMG!!!!"

quote: A rather wholesome upgrader. While ore typically shake in fear when approaching this, it makes sure to politely refine all ore.
overview:
The Wholesome Skull Blaster is an Exotic Fine-Point upgrader added in the 2019 Halloween Event. It was unwrapped from the Wholesome Chilled Present.
The Wholesome Skull Blaster has 2 possible outcomes that are dependent on the flaming effect on an ore. If the ore is on fire, then the ore receives a simple 6x to their ore value and the flame is put out.
However, if the ore is not on fire, it receives a more complex set of effects. First, it has its value multiplied by 4x. After a delay of 15 to 20 seconds, its value is then multiplied by an additional 3x (totaling for a 12x) but is also

f.effects:
If ore is on fire:
• Ore value multiplied by 6x
• Fire is put out
If ore is not on fire:
• Ore value multiplied by 4x
• Delay of 15 to 20 seconds
• Ore value multiplied by 3x (12x total)
• Ore is made slippery
f.upgrade_counter:
• Flaming ore: 1.4
• Non-flaming ore initial upgrade: 1
• Delay upgrade: 0.8

submission.name: from like 30 meshes to 7 lol
submission.description:
egg
• HEAVY BREATHING*
SANS

quote: The phantom haunts the ungrateful until they've seen the hard, cold truth.
overview:
The Phantom of Christmas Future is an Exotic portable upgrader added in the Christmas Update 2019. It was unboxed from the Impending Gift of Phantoms.
The Phantom of Christmas Future upgrades ore value by x5. This multiplier is increased to x10 if the ore has been previously upgraded by one of the other Christmas ghosts, the Ghost of Christmas Past or the Spector of Christmas Present, and is further increased to x20 if upgraded by both.
Together, the 3 Christmas Ghosts upgrades ore value by x360 in total, regardless of which one is used first.

f.effects:
Standalone:
Multiplies ore value by x5
Each Christmas Ghost used before, doubles the multiplier.
f.bok_multiplier:
⟦Ghost of Christmas Past⟧: x2
⟦Spector of Christmas Present⟧: x2

quote: A tower that pieces the fabrics of space. It'll shoot ore with upgrading gamma rays when charged with neon ore.
overview:
The Cosmic Tower is an Exotic upgrader added in the Christmas Update 2019.
The Cosmic Tower is a combination between a furnace and a upgrader. Feeding the Cosmic Tower any neon ore will charge it for 7.5s, causing any ore that is created to be upgraded by 35x. The upgrade cannot be applied twice, even with the use of resetters.

f.effects: One-time multiplier of 35x to dropped ores.
f.drawbacks: Requires Neon ore to activate.

submission.name: The Cosmic Tower
submission.description:
I see the rain is coming to fall on me
I see the rain is coming, there's no telling what it will bring
Is there a hole in the sky, collecting our time, without a reason or rhyme?

quote: Vulcan had a dream. That every person would live for only what they believed in, to fight for it with a burning passion! It's spirit like that which helped him dethrone Daegel.
overview: Vulcan's Destiny is an Advanced Evolution upgrader and is the successor of the Vulcan's Grasp. It was added in the Christmas Event 2019. It functions the same as its predecessor; as it has a base multiplier of x1 that can be increased by the other items on the base, reaching a maximum multiplier of x120. This is also unable to work multiple times, even with resetters.

f.source: Evolve with 6 Vulcan's Grasps at The Craftsman.
f.effects:
Base multiplier of 1x
Multiplier increased depending on the tier of other items placed down
(see overview)
f.drawbacks:
Multiplier capped at 120x
Fine-point beam
Unable to be re-used via resetters.

quote: So you're a funny guy aren't ya? We don't like funny guys 'round these parts.
overview:
The Gift of Trolling is a Limited Reborn gift added in Part I of the Christmas Event 2019.
This gift unwrapped to reveal the Walrus Blaster. For its shiny variant, unwrapping it will instead give you an ⭐ Awesome Walrus Blaster ⭐.

quote: The harsh conditions of the Dystopia will not favor your ores.
overview:
The Frigid Dystopia is an Advanced Reborn upgrader added in the Christmas Event 2019.
It multiplies ore by 15x. However, the ore must be frozen in order for it to receive the multiplier. This can be accomplished by using items such as the Freon Bombarder or the Father of Freon.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by x15
f.drawbacks: Ore must be frozen

quote: As if a floating base extension wasn't already enough... Ascend to even greater heights with this adjustable platform!
overview:
The Hydraulic Standard Platform is a hydraulic platform that was added in the 2019 Christmas Update.
It has the same size of a Standard Platform at 12x12 units big, but has the property of being hydraulic which has an adjustable height that the user can change.
Its price starts at 100 Shards of Life and increases by 150 Shards of Life each time one is bought.
Note: it appears to increase at first by 100 Shards of Life, then later on to 150 Shards of Life. It also appears that the first time you buy this item, the price increases by only 50 Shards of Life.

f.effects: Items can be placed on a higher floor.
f.cost:
100 Shards of Life
(Price increases by 150 Shards of Life each time one is bought)

quote: Rainbonite is found deep within the Azure Caverns. Only a drill of high power is capable of harvesting it.
overview:
The Rainbonite Mine is a Mythic dropper added in Part II of the Christmas 2019 event.
It is priced at $350N; with ores having a neon material and constantly changing colors (like itself) with a value of $1B and retains the standard ore size of 1x1x1 studs.

submission.name: Newtonium Evo
submission.description: Collabed With Vonekorn

quote: Huh. I wonder who went around the map and made all these Snowges. Snowge?Or Snowges? Who knows.
overview:
The Snowge is a Collectible decoration added in the Christmas 2019 update.
It has no purpose other than being a decoration. It could be found near The Craftsman's tower and obtained by clicking on it, similar to how you obtain the Iron Mine-Chan.
This was obtainable during 2020 Winter Event and 2021 Valentine's Event by interact with it near the NPC Snowge near the leaderboard. When the 2021 Spring Update was released, the item was made unobtainable. and the spot for the NPC Snowge has been replaced with a non-interactable melted Snow

f.source: Interact with it near The Craftsman's tower.

quote: Let your ore go down the street and watch the holiday lights! Only obtainable from the Advent Calendar
overview:
The Holiday Street Refiner is a Collectible upgrader added in the Christmas Event 2019. It is only obtainable from the Advent Calendar
Every 6 ores that pass through, the Holiday Street Refiner wraps the 6th ore and drops 5 other ores along with it. These 5 ores have the average value of the previous 6 ores that had passed through, acting similarly to an Ore Tixicator, retaining their original ore's special gimmicks.

f.source:
Day 23 of the Advent Calendar 2019
Day 18 of the Advent Calendar 2025
f.effects:
• Does not increase ore value
• Every 6th ore turns into a present, dropping along with it 5 ores.
5 replicated ores:
• Retain machine tags and status effects
• Value of replicated ore is determined by the average of the 6 ores that passed through

submission.name: Festive Street
submission.description: a glimpse of a street with christmas decorations

quote: A weak blaster which has flames burning coal from Santa's Workshop. While this seems like an innocent item, your ore are bound to be on Santa's Naughty List. Only obtainable through the Advent Calendar.
overview:
The Ornament Blaster is a Collectible portable upgrader added in the Christmas Event 2019. It is only obtainable from the Advent Calendar.
It multiplies ore value by 3x and sets the ore on fire. It is also a portable upgrader, so inserting this into a setup should prove with ease.

f.source:
24th day of the Advent Calendar 2019 & 2020
12th day of the Advent Calendar 2025
f.effects:
Multiplies ore value by 3x
Sets ore on fire
f.drawbacks: Fire destroys ore in 4s
f.item_events:
Christmas Event 2019
Winter Event 2020
Winter Event 2025

quote: 65. This isn't openable yet.
overview:
The "???" is an Exotic gift item introduced in the Reincarnation Update, and was later made widely obtainable in the Winter Event 2020.
Formerly, this item was a replacement for when the Relic-tier Iron Mine was moved to another item slot when it transitioned into Heavenly Boxes. Now, it is the rarest gift obtainable from Santa, superseding the GIGANTIC Gift of Mischief. To have a chance to obtain the "???" Gift, a present procured from the Present Center must have the highest possible value of 65. This means you will have to try multiple times to get the 65 value, for the Blizzard Predictor and Present Schrodinger both have inconsistent present upgrades.
The gift used to award either a Basic Iron Mine, Basic Furnace, or Basic Conveyor when opened, but as it has been updated for the Winter Event 2020, it cannot currently be opened.

quote:
A giant machine that spits out one coal ore every time it is fueled with a coal ore.
Wait, what?
overview:
The Industrial Coal Mine is a Fabled Industrial Dropper added in the Halloween Event 2019. It is obtained if the player owns the Shaving Cream game pass from Miner’s Haven 2, which costs 50 Robux.
The item originated from the troll sequel game, and functions the same here: it will produce one coal ore for every coal ore used to power it.
Because this item requires coal to drop coal, this item's usage is very situational and it requires some usage with Ore Replicator in order to maximize this item's usefu

f.source: Shaving Cream Gamepass from Miner's Haven 2 Alpha
f.effects: Drops one coal ore for every coal ore processed.

quote: Show your meme mastery with these meme swords.
overview:
The Meme God Shrine is a Fabled weapon giver added in the 2019 Halloween Event. It is obtained if the player owns the Shaving Cream game pass from Miner’s Haven 2, priced at R$50.
The weapon giver will dispense a Dankheart into the player's inventory. The sword will play a mashup meme song when equipped, and will force enemies to trip when struck by the sword.
It represents a Sword God Shrine with meme textures everywhere.

f.source: Shaving Cream Gamepass from Miner's Haven 2 Alpha
f.effects: Gives the player a Dankheart gear.

quote: It’s more of a suggestion than anything.
overview:
The Polite Wooden Wall was a Fabled joke wall added in the 2019 Halloween Event. It formerly can be obtained from owning Shaving Cream Gamepass from Miner's Haven 2 Alpha for R$50. 20 copies of this item are obtained if the player owns the gamepass.
It is a wall with nearly half the height of a regular wall, with the words "I would really prefer if you not come in here." imprinted on it.

quote: Now your mines can dab just like berezaa!
overview:
The Dabium Mine was a Fabled joke multi-spout dropper added in the Halloween 2019 event. It's a mine in the shape of a person "dabbing". Two dropper spouts are present on the mine where the end of the mine's arms are. The mine produced water bottles instead of actual ores.
It formerly can be obtained by owning Shaving Cream Gamepass from Miner's Haven 2 Alpha for R$50. 5 copies of this item are awarded if the player owns the gamepass.
This item was considered a meme item, thus granted an

quote: Spicy meatball for a spicy setup.
overview:
The Spicy Meatball was a Fabled-tier Swedish IKEA meatball, added in the 2019 Halloween Event. It was obtained if the player owns the Shaving Cream game pass from Miner's Haven 2, which was priced at R$50.
The meatball itself is an ore. While it won't disappear upon touching the baseplate, it can leave its hitbox to roll around endlessly until it's destroyed.

f.source: Shaving Cream Gamepass from Miner's Haven 2 Alpha
f.effects: Can leave its hitbox to roll around the place.

quote: A gun that shoots nothing but candy.
overview:
The Candy Gun Giver is a Collectible weapon giver added in the 2019 Halloween Event which could be bought from the Candy menu for 173 Candy.
The candy gun deals around 5-10 Damage per shot, making it one of the most inefficient weapons. It is extremely accurate, however, which can make up for it's inefficiency damage-wise.
After the Halloween 2019 event finished, the description was changed because The Evil Pumpkin boss never actually occurred (which was supposed to be released in the second part).

f.effects: Gives a Candy Gun upon interacting with it

quote: A large converter-type ramp that is used to move ore up to a raised-ier conveyor.
overview: The Large Converter Ramp is an Intermediate conveyor piece that can load ore onto raised-ier conveyors such as the Raised-ier Conveyor, all 3 Two-Level Conveyor Pieces, Way-Up-High upgraders and the Ore Recliner.

quote: Prove you are the king of memes with this sword.
overview: The Dankheart is a sword obtained from either the Meme God Shrine or a daily Executive Crate.

f.source:
Meme God Shrine
Executive Daily Crates

quote: A corner turn for all your raised corner turning needs!
overview:
The Raised Turns are a set of Novice conveyor added in the Halloween Event 2019.
They allow ores on raised conveyors to be turned to the left or right, depending on which turn is used.

quote: A relic granted to users who are deemed worthy by OutOfOrderFoxy.
overview:
The Lightning Horn is a secret weapon obtained from an Executive Crate.
When equipped, a simple click anywhere within range of the weapon will trigger a lightning barrage. It takes 6.5 seconds to summon the actual lightning, as an animation is played beforehand. The lightning does very heavy damage to its victims, capable of killing a non-infused player in a single hit. The lightning also happens to bypass base protections, as it can kill base owners while they are on their baseplate.
At the moment, this gear is currently broken and clicking has no effect.

quote: An upgrader made to fix ore broken by the Robotic Enhancer! On its own this item does a small upgrade, but its upgrade increases if your ore was broken by a Robotic Enhancer.
overview:
The Maintenance Supporter is a Contraband-tier upgrader, added in Part II of the Halloween Event 2019.
It multiplies ore value by x5 only if the ore have the smoke status effect.

f.effects:
Multiplies ore value by x5
Removes smoke
f.drawbacks: Requires smoke effects to function

submission.name: Maintenance Supporter
submission.description: the brother of robotic enhancer

quote: Spawn a fake RP crate.
overview:
The Fake Crate was obtained during the 2016 Black Friday Sale.
It costed 200R$, the gamepass was called "Pocket Nebula"
Inside was the Ore Nebula and Ore Nebula Receiver, and also the Fake Crate tool.
When the Fake Crate is interacted with it plays a fart noise and blows up, launching the player far away. The Fake Crate is notorious for being annoying and shooting ores everywhere if dropped near any. It can be really annoying if you are star looping your ores and it is activated near them. Fake Crate flings also bypass base protection, so even if you touch it in your base, you will be flung

f.effects: When touched by a player, the crate makes a fart noise and blows up, throwing nearby players away but dealing no damage.

quote: A box of a fairly indie cereal brand. This box of cereal is by far the heathiest [sic] and most iron-heavy cereal in the land!
overview:
The Iron Flakes Mine is a Redeemed dropper added in the Halloween 2019 Event.
It appears to be an "Iron Flakes"-branded family-size pack of cereal with a dropper on the side, spewing 5 ores in a row before going on a cooldown. The "ores" produced will look like small Basic Iron Mines, although when the ores travel through a resetting-device, their models revert from their iron mine model to a white standard brick ore.
Because this mine lacks in quality, its usefulness is overwhelmingly situational, limited to research.
Note that Ore Sawmill is capable of duplicating the ores.

submission.name: Cereal Mine
submission.description: mmm, toe cereal

quote: On Halloween Day in 2019, A poor Iron Mine was corrupted with a mysterious black substance. The result of that corruption lead [sic] to this mine. Witnesses call this mine "The Abomination".
overview: The Abomination is a Reborn dropper released in Part II of the 2019 Halloween Event.

f.effects: Ores have collision.
f.drawbacks: Ores may potentially clog up upgrader lines.

quote: Perhaps evolutions have gone too far. By forcing The Abomination to evolve, you have created a monster that is capable of destroying other mines entirely to fuel its hunger.
overview: The Daegelart is an Evolved Reborn dropper added in Part II of the 2019 Halloween Event as an evolution to The Abomination.

f.source: Evolve with 10 The Abominations at The Craftsman.
f.effects: Absorbs other ores upon touch, granting x5 to its own value and increasing in size as well, this can be done up to 6 times for a total of x15,625, upping the ore value from $420T to $6.56Qn.
f.drawbacks: Ores can collide with each other.

submission.description: ewigfuewoghfoihewbfcijubdhewfoijoejbdf colaboration with nerdy san eflewbvfrueiwdfjgiwehfjuihvgirewfj

quote: A mine that was made with nothing but candy. While candy isn't produced from this mine, a rare ore called Pumpkinite is mined instead! It is said this ore used to grow on the walls of the faraway Azure Mines.
overview:
The Pumpkinite Mine is an Exotic mine added in Part II of the 2019 Halloween Event and reintroduced in the 2020 Halloween Event. It is the most expensive excavator purchasable with candy corn. Its primary purpose is to generate Candy in conjunction with the Candy Center.
Unlike other candy-based droppers, the Pumpkinite Mine's candy value is 3 when processed by a Candy Center.

The Draedon's Gauntlet is a Superstitious upgrader first revealed and given to several well-known contributors, then fully released in the Reincarnation Update.
It goes through 2 phases. It first multiplies ore value by a massive 250x, then multiplies ore value by 1.05x 50 times over the course of 10 seconds, resulting in a total multiplier of roughly 2867x. A drawback, shared with the Ore Illuminator, is that the ore cannot have its upgrade counter changed while it is being upgraded. However, 0 Upgrade Counter upgraders may still be used during this.
The Ore Hypernova, together with the Gargantium Core and the Gargantium Mine, can be used to let ores instantly receive the total multiplier of the Draedon's Gauntlet, as well as a bonus x1.05, totaling to a x3010 upgrade.

The wings that this infuser gives the player were shown in a tweet here, and the item's full effects and crafting recipe were revealed in a live stream the day after.
By itself, it applies wings to the user, allowing them to fly. By placing other infusers on your base, the Champion Infuser will infuse itself with their powers, boosting its own power. You can use multiple copies of the same infuser. Walkspeed and Health can be stacked up to a limit, while unique attributes such as the Zenith Will's glow effect are only applied once. The Resetting Infuser and Bunny Infuser cannot add their main effects to the Champion Infuser.

It starts at a base multiplier of x6 for all ores with a 20 or less upgrader counter. For every upgrade counter greater than 20 that the ore has, the Hades' Palace's multiplier increases by 0.3. The multiplier caps at x30, or at an upgrade counter of 100. (For example, if an ore has 24 upgrade counters, its value would be multiplied by x7.2.)

quote: This drill is capable of harvesting large amounts of Palladium ore. However during the drilling process, it creates a side product from its fast speed.
overview:
The Palladium Drill is an Advanced Reborn mine that was added as part of the Halloween 2019 Event.
The main dropper part drops large chunks of Palladium consistently, worth $100B each, while also dropping small blue chunks of Cobalt in a way similar to the Yunium Mine, worth $100T each. The mine drops Cobalt in an 8x6 area while the mine drops Palladium directly in front of it.

Orange ores are dense
Blue ores are light
f.drawbacks:
Large Ore Size (Orange Ore)
Messy (Blue Ore)

x.t:
If you only want the cobalt ores (small blue ores), here are some methods:
• Using a Separation Conveyor.
• Using a Precision Refiner to set the large orange ore on fire, while the small blue ores remain unaffected.
• By using a Hydraulic Standard Platform with an elevation of 3, you can catch the cobalt ores with a conveyor.
• A consequence of this is that feeding this mine directly into furnaces only processes the cobalt ores so feeding this mine directly into a furnace at this height for RP farming is bad.
• Using an Ore Evaluator set to $1T, you can divide them in to 2 lanes, provided you haven't increased their ore value before.

It is nothing more but a buffed version of The Fracture, however, sometimes ores explode rather than get processed. Its “Teeth” are now spiked and jagged, giving it a more sinister look.

The Draconicglass Mine is an Evolved Reborn remote dropper, successor to the Dragonglass Mine, that was added in the 2019 Halloween Event.
The amount of ore dropped per click is random, ranging from 1 to 5 ores. Unlike the Dragonglass Mine, which increases ore value every burst, ore value increases with each ore, starting from $100qd and caps out at $10Qn before resetting to $0. Like its predecessor, ores from this mine have a reduced chance of being destroyed by blasters.
Upon use, the dropper may temporarily "rage", turning dropped ores and the mine red. Ores dropped during this time have a higher value.

quote: The altar's power is hidden by an ancient code, only crackable to the most dedicated of miners.
overview: The Crystal Altar is an Advanced Evolution furnace that was added during Part I of the Christmas Event 2019. It is the evolution of the Crystal Shrine, and like its predecessor, it requires a complex combination of inputs to unlock its power.

f.source: Evolve with 5 Crystal Shrines at The Craftsman
f.effects: A multiplier of x20,000 is locked behind a series of seals (see overview)
f.drawbacks:
• Sealed Crystal Altar will process ore at rate of x0.
• Processing any ore from the ⟦Noobite Mine⟧ will curse the Crystal Altar, resulting in a processing rate of x1.
• Ores must be worth over $1qd to unseal the Altar.

submission.name: Crystal Sanctuary
submission.description: Crystal shrine evo

x.t:
When placed, the Crystal Altar is initially sealed, and requires a series of inputs to unseal in the form of ores with specific effects. Each correct input will advance the unsealing processing into the next stage, changing both the color and name of the Crystal Altar. Ores used to unseal the Crystal Altar require a value of at least $1qd to properly work; otherwise, the ore will be rejected.
If an incorrect ore is submitted into the furnace, it will be rejected, shown with a red X. Incorrect steps do not reset the seal or alter the current stage.
Like its predecessor, the Crystal Altar will emit tremor sounds when it changes states, and will emit a thunderous roar upon being unsealed.
If an ore that was dropped from a Noobite Mine is processed into the Crystal Altar, it will cause the Crystal Altar to become cursed, resulting in a processing rate of x1.

The Daestrophe acts as another Resetting Device, resetting all Machine tags for that ore. It also multiplies ore value by x100 with an additional x2 if the ore is on fire for a total of x200.
This upgrader is required to open the gate to The Heart of the Void, upgrading an ore from The Daegelart to be processed in an Eternal Limbo.
Upon placement, a loud and deep laugh accompanied by thunder sound is heard across the server.

However, this 11th ore receives pink flames which will destroy the ore in 4 seconds unless extinguished.

quote: The mind of a dreamer can be easily decayed over time. But at that point, it only becomes a nightmare.

It also increases the multiplier of spore-related upgraders just by having the furnace placed down:

After 500 seconds, the Dreamer's Blight becomes fully decayed, no longer providing buffs to other upgraders; its process multiplier will continue to decay regardless. This can be remedied by replacing the item. However, this may be broken as the bonus multiplier seems to be given regardless of how long Dreamer's Blight is placed for.
Ores do not have to be processed by the furnace in order to get the increased upgrade from spore related items, making it very useful to still have it place down if another furnace is used.

overview:
The Ancient Tablet is a Contraband utility item added in the Reincarnation Update. It first appeared in The Masked Man's shop on 18 April 2020.
When placed down on the base upon rebirthing, The Ancient Tablet is destroyed, and the player is guaranteed to receive a Slipstream item from that rebirth. It does not activate if the item is only in your inventory.
This item is very effective at obtaining slipstream items that are used to craft enchanted items. However, players normally have better uses for uC uC.

quote: Old tales follow the life of a king who turned everything he touched into gold, including those he loved. Dare risk everything you have just for a bit of cash? Upgrade Limit: 0.333s/upgrade
overview:
The Midas Blaster is a Superstitious blaster that was added in the 2020 Easter Event. It was revealed in a discord live stream by OutOfOrderFoxy.
The Midas Blaster is an immensely powerful portable blaster with a very large multiplier. Ores receive increasingly large multipliers the more times they are upgraded by it. In addition to its typical role as a Blaster, the Midas Blaster colors ores gold, changes their material to metal, and makes them incredibly dense, preventing them from being flung by explosions.
After an ore has been upgraded by a Midas Blaster, each subsequent Midas Blaster use will add +1x to its chosen multiplier value. This effect continues to stack with each Midas Blaster use until it reaches the maximum cap of +10x. This effect will be reset by Resetting Devices.

f.source: Using the ⟦Catalyst of Fortune⟧ and elements from Reborn-tier items with Draedon
f.effects:
Multiplies ore value by 36x to 123x
Upgrade multiplier increases by +1 per use
Sets ore on fire
Colors ore gold
Makes ore incredibly dense
f.drawbacks:
Fire destroys ore in 4 seconds
Chance to destroy ore
Explosions can fling ore away
Upgrade multiplier increase is capped at +10x
Upgrade multiplier increase is removed by resetters

x.t:
Like most other blasters, the Midas Blaster destroys ore randomly, but the Midas Blaster also upgrades randomly like the Hydra Blaster. Both ore destruction and ore upgrade are independently chosen events; one does not influence the other.
The average upgrade of Midas Blasters in endgame setups should be taken as x76.593, the geometric mean of its probability distribution. To summarise why, that is approximately where the median multiplier lies after averaging across repeated uses of the item.

quote: The poison from this upgrader not only is deadly, but it also burns and dissolves skin cells.
overview:
The Son of Poison is an Advanced Reborn upgrader added in the Reincarnation Update. It is one of the Trinity Upgraders, along with the Father of Freon and the Spirit of Fire.
The Son of Poison multiplies ore value by a high 12x while also poisoning the ore. The poison takes 4 seconds to destroy the ore, but can be cured by items like the Wild Spore.
If the Son of Poison is used as the last of the Trinity Upgraders, it starts off by multiplying the ore's value by x80 and then proceeding to apply a poison effect to the ore value, instead of the ore itself, where the ore loses 2% of its value every 0.5 seconds for 5 seconds. If the ore then stays untouched, this totals for a ~65.4x multiplier altogether.
Similarly to the Lightningbolt Refiner and its variants, large ores cannot pass through this upgrader as there is a horizontal beam preventing their passage. This can be bypassed with an Ore Cannon or Hydraulic Conveyors. (You will also need the Hydraulic Ramp)

quote: This device seems to sort your ore based on the ore value inputted on the side!
overview:
The Ore Evaluator is an Contraband utility item that was added in the Reincarnation Update and first debuted on The Masked Man's shop on 11 April, 2020. The item was initially revealed in a tweet from OutOfOrderFoxy.
The Ore Evaluators primary function is to test ore based on its value. Upon interacting with the item, a menu will appear with three buttons for changing its criteria: one that controls inequality, one that controls value, and one that controls magnitude. If an ore successfully passes the test based on the set criteria, the ore will be teleported to the orange pad; otherwise, the ore will be let through. Ores will have their velocity reset upon being teleported to the orange pad.
The Ore Evaluator cannot be set to separate negative values. The range of the Ore Evaluator is from $1k to $999UNCENT.

Tests ore based on set criteria
If ore meets criteria, it is teleported; otherwise, it is let through

submission.name: Mechanical Ore Sorter
submission.description: First MH sub in a while. Separates ores based on their ore value. Fully scripted and will work when inserted into Miner's Haven.

x.t:
• The Ore Evaluator can be used to separate positive/high-value ores and negative/low-value ores, making it useful for removing low-quality ores from a setup, such as those created by Schrodingers.
• The Ore Evaluator is insanely helpful for star setups, as it automates the manual process of making sure ores reach the required value.
• It is also good for making an automatic resetting device line that does not need shop items, allowing for the use of all use-cap upgraders after each resetter, maximizing ore value.

overview:
The Ore Nova is an Advanced Fusion pulsar, a fusion between the Nova Star and the Stardust Pulsar, added in the Reincarnation Update. It was first leaked in a tweet by OutOfOrderFoxy.
Upon use, the Ore Nova will apply a Nova effect to all ores on the users base, which applies an extra 4x to all upgrades from Star upgraders, while also giving a whopping 70x to all ores in your base, making it double the multiplier when compared with the Stardust Pulsar. This uses the same machine tag as the Nova Star and Stardust Pulsar, so using both is redundant.
It a

f.source: Fusing 3 Nova Stars and 6 Stardust Pulsars at The Craftsman
f.effects:
• Multiplies ore value by x70.
• Applies Nova effect to all ores, stacking an additional 4x to Star Upgraders.
• Changes ores' color to different shades of purple depending on the time of day.
f.drawbacks:
• Nova effect is removed after using a Resetting Device, exception of Gargantium Mine.
• Effect only lasts for 15 seconds.
• 30-second cooldown between pulses.
f.bok_multiplier:
• ⟦Interstellar Conqueror⟧ x5.96
• ⟦Gargantium Mine⟧: Gives perm. Nova effect
f.other_notes: Shares the same Machine Tag with the Nova Star

quote: The guardian doesn't need to pay attention to guard the gate. The furnace itself inflicts torment on trespassers.
overview:
The Anguished Guardian of the Gate is a Reborn Fusion furnace, a fusion between the Dreamer's Anguish and the Guardian of the Gate, added in the Reincarnation Update. It was foreshadowed in this tweet by OutOfOrderFoxy.
The furnace has a multiplier which ranges from x400 to x25,600. However, these multipliers depend on two variables:
1. User's current cash.
2. If the user is on their base, or not.

f.source: Fusing 4 Dreamer's Anguishes and 8 Guardian of the Gates at The Craftsman
f.effects:
Multiplier increases as the player gains more money:
• $100sx: x800
• > $100Sp: x1600
• > $100O: x3200
• > $100N: x6400
If the user is on their base, then an additional 4x is applied
Highest total multiplier of x25,600.
f.other_notes: User has to be on their base for a higher multiplier.

quote: The Crystallized System. It is on fire . 🔥
overview:
The Firecrystallized System is a Reborn Fusion upgrader, a fusion between the Industrial Firecrystal Mine and the Crystallized System, added in the Reincarnation Update. It was foreshadowed in this tweet by OutOfOrderFoxy.
It multiplies ore value by 12.75x, but requires a constant source of coal in order to function. Otherwise, its crystal upgrade beam stays dark, signaling whether it is functional or not.
Each piece of coal powers the upgrader for 1 second. This incremental timer has no cap.

f.source: Fusing 4 Industrial Firecrystal Mines and 8 Crystalized Systems at The Craftsman
f.effects:
Multiplies ore value by 12.75x
Each coal ore powers it for 1s
f.drawbacks: Requires constant coal input

submission.name: Industrial Firecrystallized System
submission.description:
Blazing!
Still my heart is blazing!

quote: This item appears to be a glitch, having first appeared randomly in the sky surrounded by binary code.
overview:
The Virtual Gearwork is an Advanced Fusion Anti-Gravity hydraulic-upgrader, a fusion between the Virtual Enhancer and the Gravitational Gearwork, added in the Reincarnation Update.
It has a dynamic multiplier that increases with the horizontal distance between the ore to be upgraded and (the center of) its corresponding dropper, which caps at x50.
Like the Gravitational Gearwork, it features a hydraulic anti-gravity conveyor that can be raised and lowered.

f.source: Fusing 5 Virtual Enhancers and 10 Gravitational Gearworks at The Craftsman
f.effects:
• Base multiplier of x1.
• Multiplier increase depending on distance between dropper and upgrader.
f.drawbacks: Capped at 50x
f.upgrade_counter:
Depends on distance between dropper and upgrader.
Capped at 40.

submission.name: Virtual Gearwork
submission.description: I'ma be on this TV, Mama

quote: Ancient ruins will never have as much history as nature. But such ruins can make history in nature.
overview:
The Nature's Temple is a Reborn Fusion cell furnace, a fusion between the Nature's Grip and the Ancient Temple, introduced in the Reincarnation Update. This item's appearance was revealed alongside the Ambrosia Garden in this tweet by OutOfOrderFoxy.
It processes ore depending on its value. If the ore's value is a whole number, then it is processed at a x30T multiplier. But if the ore's value is a decimal, it is instead processed at a x5qd multiplier.

f.source: Fusing 10 Nature's Grips and 5 Ancient Temples at The Craftsman
f.effects:
If the ore value is a:
• Whole number: x30T
• Decimal: x5qd

quote: Miles off the coast of the Haven, a diver found ancient underwater ruins. Someone then thought "Hey lemme put a conveyor through that!
overview:
The Atlantic Monolith is a Reborn upgrader first shown in this tweet by OutOfOrderFoxy. It was added in the Reincarnation Update.
The Atlantic Monolith has an additional function in addition to its 4x multiplier, which is that it also gives ore the wet status effect, which is a temporary variant of the fireproof status effect. This property lasts for 5 seconds, and ores are turned a shade of blue to reflect this change and has their material changed to glass.

f.effects:
Multiplies ore value by 4x
Applies wet status effect for 5s
Extinguishes flames
Turns ore blue + glass material

quote: While industrial, there is gigavolts of electricity flowing through this item. However it relies on a burning power to make use of any of it.
overview:
The Igneous Lightning is an Advanced Fusion upgrader, a fusion between the Igneous Forge and the Arcane Lightning, added in the Reincarnation Update. It was vaguely shown on Foxy's stream.
It has a massive multiplier cap of 121x, but requires a constant input of coal, as it has a decay rate of 1 charge per second. Its conveyor is also affected by this, and is fastest when fully charged.
Its charge can be seen in the lightning bolt effect at the top, having a black background when at 0 charge. As it charges up, this black background around the beam disappears, becoming increasingly transparent.

f.source: Fusing 3 Igneous Forges and 6 Arcane Lightnings at The Craftsman
f.effects:
Base multiplier of x1
Multiplier increased by +1 for each coal input
f.drawbacks:
Capped at x121
Decay rate of -1 charge/s
f.other_notes: Requires coal input for better multiplier.

submission.name: Igneous Lightning
submission.description:
I'm a scary gargoyle on a tower
That you made with plastic power
your rhinestone eyes are like factories far away

quote: The guardian is practically on defcon 1. To even cross its line of sight is asking for a fight.
overview:
The Guardian of the Portal is an Evolved Reborn furnace, successor of the Guardian of the Gate, added in the Reincarnation Update.
It has a higher multiplier of x300 when the user is on their base. When the user is off their base, this multiplier is bumped up to x900.

f.source: Evolve with 12 Guardian of the Gates at The Craftsman.
f.effects:
User at base: x300
User off base: x900

quote: Whether this is a warning, threat, or if it just got the blue screen of death, something is dangerously wrong with this computer.
overview:
The Breached Motherboard is an Evolved Reborn-tier furnace added in the Reincarnation Update.
The Breached Motherboard works similarly to its predecessor, Invasive Cyberlord, in that it has 3 upgrade beams above the furnace, each multiplying ore value by x2 for a total multiplier of x8. With an initial x500 multiplier, if all beams are hit, this furnace will process ores at a multiplier of x4000.

f.source: Evolve with 10 Invasive Cyberlords at The Craftsman.
f.effects:
• Processes ore at x500 value
• There are 3 upgrader beams above the furnace; each does x2 to ore
• Total x4000

quote: Oooooh who lives in an ocean monument under the sea?
overview:
The Atlantic Monument is an Evolved Reborn upgrader, successor to the Atlantic Monolith, added in the Reincarnation Update.
Along with its increased multiplier of 13x, it also has an increased duration of the wet status effect (fire immunity) that it gives to ores, giving them immunity from fire for 7 seconds instead of 5.

f.source: Evolve with 10 Atlantic Monoliths at The Craftsman.
f.effects:
Multiplies ore value by 13x
Gives wet status effect for 7s
Extinguishes flames
Turns ore blue

submission.name: Atlantic Monument
submission.description: "big fish theory"

quote: This scanner is powerful enough to burn through concrete! Multiple uses of this scanner is rather risky, so caution should be taken when using this scanner
overview:
The Plasma Scanner is a Reborn scanner added in the 2020 Valentine's Day Update.
It multiplies ore value by x6. However, if the ore was upgraded a second time without using a resetting device, any sequential upgrade by the Plasma Scanner is ignored. This effect lasts indefinitely and can NOT be removed by a Resetting Devices.
An unexpected upside is that the Plasma Scanner does not share the same machine tag with other scanners.

f.effects:
• Multiplies ore value by x6.
• Does not share the same Machine tag with other scanners.
f.drawbacks: Ores cant get upgraded by Plasma Scanner if they get upgraded a second time without a resetting device.

submission.name: Scanner 2: Electric Boogaloo
submission.description: The big ####### of scanners. The tomato of the pea pod. The jock among the nerds. Providing ores a hefty x10 upgrade, this scanner asserts its dominance over all scanners and ensures it is the alpha across all planes.

quote: It took half a decade for scientists to figure out what usages Newtonium has, and finally there was a breakthrough! CAUTION: UNSTABLE RADIOACTIVITY!
overview:
The Newtonic Corroder is a Reborn upgrader added in the Reincarnation Update.
The Newtonic Corroder's upgrade beam, unlike most other upgraders, is situated above the conveyor. Upon successfully hitting the upgrade beam, ores are multiplied by x7. However, they will also have a radioactive effect applied to them which will destroy the ore after 5 seconds, unless removed.

f.effects:
• Multiplies ore value by x7.
• Radiate ore.
f.drawbacks:
• Radioactive destroys ore after 5s.
• Raised upgrade beam.

submission.name: Trisectralyde Impaler
submission.description:
You can lift your head up to the sky
Take a deeper breath and give it time
You can walk the path among the lines
With your shattered Frame of Mind

quote: This scary upgrader warps the atomic composition of ore by sending it through vortexes!
overview:
The Vortex Chamber is a Reborn-tier Way-Up-High upgrader added in the Reincarnation Update.
The Vortex Chamber multiplies ore value by 5x but requires ore to be at the Way-up-high elevation in order to reach the conveyor.
Because of its high speed conveyor, it is advised to use alongside upgraders that require ores to be Way-Up-High such as Big Bertha in order to reach the upgrade beam.
This item has 2 animations. The inside of the chamber has swirling clouds which transition between a large amount of clouds which make the chamber opaque and vice versa.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by 5x

submission.name: Antimatter generator MHS
submission.description: nou100

quote: Toxic waste so dangerous that even standing near this upgrader is enough to give third degree burns.
overview:
The Toxic Waste Disposal is a Reborn-tier upgrader added in the 2020 Valentine's Day Event.
The Toxic Waste Disposal multiplies ore value by an random integer between 3 and 6. It also guarantees that the ore will explode after 6 seconds and be destroyed without the use of items that clear negative status effects, such as the Wild Spore or the Deadly Spore.
A smaller attribute is that the Toxic Waste Disposal does not alter the ore's upgrade counter, so it can still be used in Cell Furnaces or during the education period of the Ore Illuminator and its [[Ore Indoctr

f.effects:
Multiplies ore value by 3x to 6x
Applies radioactive effect to ore
f.drawbacks: Ore will explode in 6 seconds if not cured

quote: Born underground, grown inside a rocky womb. The earth is our cradle; the mountains shall become our tomb. Face us on the battlefield; you will meet your doom. We do not fear what lies beneath. We can never dig too deep.
overview:
The Havium Mine is a Superstitious mine added in the Reincarnation Update. This mine's ores have the highest value in game and in addition to that, several bonus properties including immunity to poison, frostbite and radiation. The ore is also protected by 3 shields, a powerful attribute shared only by the SpookBaron-360,000. These shields protect the ore from getting destroyed by anything except educators such as the Draedon's Gauntlet. All the 3 shields can be removed by the Witch's Cauldron, an Ore Sawmill or its successor.
As Havium ores are immune to poison, frostbite and radiation, they do not work with upgraders that require these attributes to work.
Upon placement, it emits the sound of torches being lit. This sound is shared with Pandora's Box.
This mine is based off of the now dead God of Earth in Miner's Haven lore, Atalia.

f.source: Using the ⟦Catalyst of Earth⟧ and elements from Reborn-tier items with Draedon
f.effects:
Bonus attributes to ores:
• Immune to Poison, Radiation, and Frostbite
• 3 shields that protect against destruction
f.drawbacks:
Certain items remove all shields:
⟦Witch's Cauldron⟧
⟦Ore Sawmill⟧
⟦Ore Chainsaw⟧

quote: Such a marvel of phase technology, such an upgrader capable of turning ore into pure phase!
overview:
The Phase Bombarder is an Evolved Reborn-tier upgrader added in the Reincarnation Update.
As a standalone upgrader, this multiplies ore value by 15x and infuses Phase into the ore. This Phase property can be used in correspondance with a Phasecursor Furnace or Phase Processor to activate them, buffing their multipliers. It also features a fine-point beam in contrast to its predecessor which has an upgrade beam that covers the entire conveyor.
When used with a Phasecursor Mine, the multiplier that the ore receives is increased to x50.

f.source: Evolving with 11 Phase Refiners at The Craftsman.
f.effects:
Multiplies ore value by 15x
Infuses ore with Phase which can be used to activate ⟦Phase Processor⟧/⟦Phasecursor Furnace⟧
⟦Phasecursor Mine⟧ ores will receive 50x
f.drawbacks: Fine-point upgrade beam

submission.name: a^2
submission.description: what does it equal

quote: The solution to peace with the phase invaders: A mine capable of producing raw phase! But they will only want more, and more.
overview:
The Phasecursor Mine is an Advanced Fusion dropper, a fusion between the Precursor Mine and the Phase Refiner, added in the Reincarnation Update.
Ores from this mine get bonus upgrades from the Phase Refiner (x8) and Phase Bombarder (x50).

f.source: Fusing 6 Precursor Mines and 3 Phase Refiners at The Craftsman
f.effects: Buffed x8 from Phase Refiner and x50 from Phase Bombarder

quote: Blast your pizza with the force of a thousand catalysts!
overview:
The Pizzalyst is a Reborn Fusion upgrader, a fusion between The Catalyst and the Pizza Blaster, added in the Reincarnation Update.
This upgrader has 2 different upgrades. The Catalyst upgrade beam multiplies ore value by 5.06x and the Pizza upgrade beam multiplies ore value by 5.9x for a total multiplier of 29.854x.

f.source: Fusing 6 The Catalysts and 3 Pizza Blasters at The Craftsman
f.effects:
• Catalyst upgrade: x5.06
• Pizza upgrade: x5.9
Total: x29.854

submission.name: The Pizza.
submission.description: Buy vonekorn pizza

quote: The mineral produced by this mine is very similar to Newtonium, yet contains the seemingly liquid properties of Yunium ore.
overview:
The Yuntonium Mine is a Reborn Fusion dropper, a fusion between the Newtonium Mine and the Yunium Mine, added in the Reincarnation Update.
The Yuntonium Mine combines the properties of its predecessors, carrying over both their buffs to radioactive and cannon upgrades. It also has an increased ore value, from the billions of either dropper to a constant $1T. The following are the buffs from the mine:

f.source: Fusing 6 Newtonium Mines and 3 Yunium Mines at The Craftsman
f.effects:
Buffs multiplier of radioactive upgraders
Buff from Cannon upgrades
f.other_notes:
Ore has minimal transparency
(exact value unsure; transparency range 0 < x < 0.3, possible value either 0.2 or 0.25?)

atomium evo is a collab with spike yo
yes going ponngers

quote: A mothership that travelled millions of light years, destroying entire galaxies. All in search for the Phase.
overview:
The Phasecursor Furnace is an Advanced Fusion furnace, a fusion between the Precursor Furnace and the Phase Processor, added in the Reincarnation Update.
It has a base multiplier of x1k when deactivated. To activate it, it has to process an ore that has been upgraded by a Phase Refiner or its evolved variant, the Phase Bombarder, as they give the Phase machine tag which is required to activate it.
Once activated, its multiplier is buffed to x5k. The multiplier is increased to x10k for ores with the Phase tag.

f.source: Fusing 8 Precursor Furnaces and 4 Phase Processors at The Craftsman
f.effects:
• Base multiplier of x1k.
• Multiplier increased to x5k when activated by Phase-infused ore.
• Phase-infused ore receive bonus x2.
----Total: x10k

quote: An upgrader very similar to the Freon-Blast Upgrader, except it blasts fire. While it shares the same money limit as Freon, it'll upgrade faster, but catch ore on fire.
overview:
The Fire-Blast Upgrader is an Epic upgrader added in Part II of the 2019 Christmas Update.
The Fire-Blast Upgrader serves as an alternative to the Freon-Blast Upgrader. Of the two, the Fire-Blast Upgrader has a higher multiplier at the cost of igniting ore, and a higher price, requiring ore to be extinguished.
However, unlike the Freon-Blast Upgrader, the multiplier of the Fire-Blast Upgrader does not decay overtime and does not upgrade ores worth more than $50B, despite its description saying both this and the Freon-Blast Upgrader have the same money cap

f.effects: Multiplies ores by x2
f.drawbacks:
• Sets ore on fire for 5 seconds
• Does not upgrade ore worth more than $50B

submission.name: Fine Point Thermocrusher
submission.description: "I'll see you on the dark side of the moon!"

quote: A spiced up Quantum Ore cleaner, despite it having only 3 upgraders.
overview:
The Digital Peppermint Refiner is a Limited Reborn upgrader. It is the Christmas-themed version of the Quantum Ore Cleaner. It was added in the Christmas Event 2019.
The Digital Peppermint Refiner multiplies ore value by 4x, and increases the value of presents by 3. This item is incompatible with the Quantum Ore Cleaner, Quantum Ore Polisher and the Quantum Clockwork.

f.effects:
Multiplies ore value by x4
+3 to Present Value
f.drawbacks: Can't be used with ⟦Quantum Ore Cleaner⟧ and its variants.

quote: It's not Santa's WorkSHOP, it's Santa's WorkCLOCK.
overview:
The Santa's Workclock is a Limited Reborn Fine-Point upgrader added in Part II of the 2019 Christmas Event.
This upgrader simply multiplies ore value by x5. Like an evolution, this does not stack with its counterpart, Clockwork. It's also a fine-point upgrader, thus requires ores to be centered on the conveyor in order to hit the beam unless if you have bigger ores.

f.effects:
Multiplies ore value by x5.
+2 to Present Value
f.drawbacks: Fine-Point upgrader beam.Can't be used with ⟦Clockwork⟧ and its variants.

submission.name: Christmas work MHS
submission.description: Collab with Luckily_dragon

quote: A freezing version of The Catalyst, so cold that it can cause severe burns!
overview:
The Cryolyst is a Limited Reborn upgrader. It is the Christmas-themed version of The Catalyst, added in Part II of the 2019 Christmas Event.
It quadruples the value of ores and increases the value of presents by 2.

f.effects:
Multiplies ore value by x4
+2 to Present Value
f.drawbacks: Can't be used with ⟦The Catalyst⟧ and its variants.

submission.name: The Cringelyst
submission.description: Cringe

quote: The most generous of giving trees. Winter 2019 Exclusive.
overview:
The Tree of Giving is an Exotic upgrader added in Part II of the Christmas 2019 event.
The Tree of Giving features a Ground-to-Raised conveyor that loops around in a U-turn. It also features an upgrade panel that multiplies ore value by x5.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by 5x

submission.name: Tree of Giving
submission.description: This was a collab with Frenzzy and Hoshiisan

quote: The spector of the modern age. Who knows what information is in that book. Only time will tell.
overview:
The Spector of Christmas Present is an Exotic portable upgrader added in the Christmas Update 2019. It was unboxed from the Haunted Buried Green Gift.
The Spector of Christmas Present multiplies ore value by x3 with no additional effects. This multiplier is increased to x6 if the ore has been previously upgraded by one of the other Christmas ghosts, the Phantom of Christmas Future or the Ghost of Christmas Past, and is further increased to x12 if upgraded by both.
Using all three ghost upgraders in conjunction of each other regardless of order results in a total multiplier of x360.

f.effects:
Standalone:
Multiplies ore value by x3
Each Christmas Ghost used before, doubles the multiplier.
f.bok_multiplier:
⟦Ghost of Christmas Past⟧: x2
⟦Phantom of Christmas Future⟧: x2

quote: Santa is jolly most of the time. To those on his naughty list, they face his rage.. they face mountains of coal!
overview:
The Santa's Rage is an Exotic utility dropper that was unboxed from the GIGANTIC Gift of Mischief during Part III of the Christmas Update 2019.
The Santa's Rage produces coal at a fast rate, producing 6 coal every second.

quote: One does not dare trespass on a base if it has a Lobster Telephone.
overview:
The Lobster Telephone is a Fabled guardian that was added in the Christmas Event 2019 by owning the Lobster Telephone Artifact.
It takes on the appearance of the artifact itself. The Lobster Telephone is a zombie-like being. It chuckles when it's placed down. This is the fastest and strongest (in terms of hp) guard mob. They also jump at insane heights.
Each day, they will call you and give you a random amount of boxes. The boxes are also random.

f.effects: Attacks players that are not on your permission list.

quote: Quite the popular vehicle. There's no other vehicle capable of beating this car in a race, not possible!
overview:
Berezaa's Car is a Fabled artifact that can obtained by purchasing Berezaa's Car Keys.
The car can also be found on the top of the mountain next to The Craftsman's tower, but is commonly driven off the map, flipped over, or lost on public servers.
The car drives forward if not occupied by the player immediately after placing it down. The car also leaves its item hitbox behind, making it invisible. This glitch was patched in the 2020 Countdown Event.

f.effects: Works like a normal vehicle.

quote: I don't think anybody was expecting this from the Gift of Trolling..
overview:
The Walrus Blaster is a Limited Reborn portable upgrader added in Part III of the Christmas 2019 Event. It can be obtained by unwrapping the Gift of Trolling.
The Walrus Blaster multiplies ore value by x5 with no other effects.
Its Shiny variant has a green color scheme and has a horn protruding from its head, making it resemble more of a narwhal than a walrus.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by x5

submission.name: walter
submission.description: people think they really being helpful by telling me 'please be careful'

quote: A tree that puts the Grand Christmas Tree to shame. The beauty of this tree can be seen from miles away.
overview:
The Supreme Christmas Tree is an Exotic furnace that came out of the Rather Wide, But Deluxe Present in part III of the Christmas 2019 event.
The multiplier increases the higher the user's life. It also increases by +1 for each Festive Box owned.

f.effects:
Multiplier is based off the user's life count and Festive Box count.
• 1 to 99: x50
• 100 to 299: x125
• 300 to 499: x250
• 500 to 999: x500
• 1000 to 4999: x1250
• 5000 to 9999: x2500
• 10000+: x5000

quote: WHAT DID YOU SAY THE GIFT UNBOXED INTO?! I'M SORRY THIS GIFT IS TOO NOISY CAN YOU SPEAK UP!?
overview:
The Golden Bell Upgrader is a Collectible Way-Up-High upgrader obtained in Part III of the Christmas 2019 event by opening the Noisy Golden Gift.
It multiplies ore value by 3x with no other effects.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by 3x

when the moon about to crash
this item intensifies

quote: Yes it's an upgrader in a gingerbread mansion. The wealthy gingerbread that live inside seem not to mind ore passing through.
overview:
The Gingerbread Mansion is an Exotic Way-Up-High upgrader added in Part III of the Christmas Update 2019. It is obtained from the Frosted Gift of Spice.
It multiplies ore value by x6, if an ore had gone through the Gingerbread House, then a bonus x1.5 is applied, resulting in a total multiplier of x9.

Multiplies ore value by x6

x1.5 is applied to base multiplier
Total: x9

Santa's Castle is an Exotic Way-Up-High upgrader which was obtained in Part III of the Christmas Update 2019 by opening the Sophisticated Gift of Kings.
It functions as a Christmas-themed variant of the Great Pumpkin, becoming more powerful as ores are upgraded by more Christmas-themed Exotics.

Base multiplier x6

quote: There's no gifts this Christmas.. only close memories of the past.
overview:
The Melancholy Holidays is a Collectible Way-Up-High upgrader added in Part II of the Christmas 2019 event.
It multiplies ore value by x1.75 with no other effects.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by 1.75x

quote: One million favorites. We award you with a whale gun, fires whales with the force of a million.. whales..!
overview:
The Whale Gun is an Exotic weapon added during the Part III of the Christmas Update 2019 as the item being contained inside the Favored Millionaire Present.
When the gun is fired, a killer whale is fired from the gun, which flies up in the air before landing behind the initial target, then swooping in towards the player who shot it, dragging and killing any players which are in the path. Pressing the letter Z or Q on your keyboard will result in you zooming in with the whale gun.

f.effects: Gives the player a Whale Gun gear.

submission.name: pog whale death from above
submission.description: pog

quote: Just in time. The gift inside hasn't melted completely. Whether or not this mine is preserved eternally is unknown.
overview:
The Frosty the Snowmine is a Collectible dropper added in Part III of the Christmas Update 2019.
This mine drops ore worth $20M at approximately 1 ore every 0.75 seconds.

quote: A quirky snowflake that upgrades your ores in a freezing way!
overview:
The Winter Snowflake is an Exotic Way-Up-High upgrader that was added in the Part III of Christmas Update 2019. It can be unwrapped from the Delicate Precipitation Gift.
The Winter Snowflake adds $10k to the ore's value and then multiplies it by x4.75. This is done with the additional effect of removing fire if possible. However, it changes the ore's material to ice, giving it the slippery/frozen effect.
While a Blazing Annihilator can come in handy to negate this effect, the ore thaws itself after 10 seconds. This only occurs if

f.effects:
• Adds $10k
• Multiplies ore value by x4.75
• Extinguishes fire
• Makes ores slippery for 10 seconds
f.drawbacks: Only self-thaws if not already frozen

quote: A legendary snowflake said to have been capable of creating an entire ice age!
overview:
The Behemoth Snowflake is a Collectible upgrader obtained in Part III of the Christmas Update 2019 by opening the Shockingly Freezing Present.
It upgrades ore by x3 once, and applies a frozen effect, similar to the Permafrost Refiner. It can be used to unlock the Crystal Shrine.
The slippery (frozen) effect can be removed with a Blazing Annihilator.
Even though this makes ore "cold" and slippery, they aren't fireproof, as the frozen effect no longer provides fireproofing as of the Reincarnation Update.

f.effects:
Multiplies ore value by x3
Freezes ore

quote: The shiniest upgrader you'll possibly see. This upgrader will make your ore into red tinted glass!
overview:
The Shiny Red Upgrader is a Collectible-tier upgrader unboxed from the Shiny Red Gift.
It multiplies ores by 1.5x. The upgrader transforms ores into red-tinted glass, which increases the multiplier of Santa's Castle by +3.
You can use an Ore Recliner to easily get an ore into the conveyor.
Ores that are size 1.5 or larger won't fit.

f.effects:
• Multiplies ore value by x1.5
• Increases multiplier of ⟦Santa's Castle⟧ by +3

quote: Light up Miner's Haven throughout the new year! New Years 2020 exclusive.
overview:
New Year's City is a Collectible-tier furnace released in the 2020 Countdown Event.
With a max cap of x65, this furnace‘s value is dependent on your life, so early life users will find this item useful.
It takes on the form of a city, ready to drop the ball for the new year.

f.effects: Starts off processing ore at 25x and increases by 0.5 for every life the player is at, capping at 65x at life 81.

quote: Who said celebrations couldn't be a daily thing? New Years 2020 exclusive.
overview:
The Confetti Particle is a Collectible particle giver added in the 2020 Countdown Event.
1 of these was given away to every player online for the New Year 2020 in Miner's Haven.
During the New Years 2025 event these were available through Mystery Boxes.

quote: Speed into 2020 with this fashionable conveyor! 2020 New Years exclusive.
overview: The 2020 Conveyor is a Collectible conveyor added in the 2020 Countdown Event.

quote: Not so basic now huh?
overview:
The Iron Mine is a Relic joke dropper only available from at a 0.5% chance, added in the 2020 Countdown Event. This mine reused the model from Basic Iron Mine.
It produces ores that are worth $15M each, compared to the Basic Iron Mine's $2 ores. The ores also cycle through the RGB spectrum, which will be invisible at night. Putting the ore through a resetting device will freeze the RGB rotation on the color the ore was when it hit the upgrader part of the resetter, or if the iron mine it came from is removed. The ore also emits flame particles that also cycle through the RGB spectrum but will not always be the same color as the ore and will be removed if it goes through a resetter and paused if the original mine is removed
The ores are immune to fire. Due to the ores having a rainbow flame effect they cannot go through items such as the Azure Refiner, so the fire must be extinguished first.

f.item_vfx: Ores from this mine and the slate parts of the mine itself constantly shift color.
f.other_notes: Ores are Immune to fire, and frostbite.

quote: The Haven sure is fortunate to have huge deposits of Ambrosia. So much so that it tends to seep out of cracks in the ground!

The Ambrosia Garden is a Reborn Fusion furnace, a fusion between the Ambrosia Fountain and the Sakura Garden, added in the Reincarnation Update. This was revealed by OutOfOrderFoxy on two tweets: one with a picture of it, and another hinting about its existence.
It processes ore at a multiplier depending how long the ore has existed, ranging from x10k at less than 1 minute to x25k at >10 minutes.
As for the Sakura Garden side of the furnace, ores that enter the furnace will permanently reduce

f.source: Fusing 6 Sakura Gardens and 3 Ambrosia Fountains at The Craftsman

Processes ore based on ore lifespan:
• 10 minutes: x25k
f.drawbacks:
Multiplier reduced by processing ores:
• Normal ores: -10
• Flaming ores: -100
Incompatible with flaming ores.

quote: Scholars say trees like this are anchor points in time, they do not age, they aren't phased by time.
overview:
The Temporal Enchantment is an Evolved Reborn to the Timeless Enhancement. It was introduced in the 5th Anniversary Event.
This furnace processes ore at a base multiplier of 2.1k which decreases the longer the ore is present.

Base Multiplier of 2.1k (needs further testing)
Minimum Multiplier of 900x (needs further testing)

quote: An upgrader from an artificial universe. It seems to digitalize our reality surrounding it.
overview:
The Virtual Enchanter is an Advanced Evolution upgrader, successor to the Virtual Enhancer, added in the Reincarnation Update.
Just like its predecessor, It multiplies ore value depending on the dropper location. With higher multiplier the further its placed, has a maximum multiplier of x45. Additionally, it has slightly better scaling, allowing it to reach the maximum multiplier when placed closer than its predecessor.

f.source: Evolve with 15 Virtual Enhancers at The Craftsman.
f.effects: Multiplies ore value depending on distance between upgrader and dropper up to x45
f.drawbacks: Must be far from parent mine for full benefit.
f.upgrade_counter:
Based on the multiplier.
Capped at 6.

The Mystical Thunder is an Advanced Evolution Upgrader, successor to the Arcane Lightning, added in the Reincarnation Update.
The upgrader begins at 1x, which charges up to a maximum of 95x as the user clicks the button. The more charge the item has, the more prominent its visual effects become.
After around 15 seconds of inactivity, the Mystical Thunder's charge quickly depletes as opposed to its predecessor's full minute of required inactivity.

f.source: Evolve with 8 Arcane Lightnings at The Craftsman.

Base multiplier of x1
Each click adds +4 to the multiplier

Capped at x95
Charge depletes after 15s of inactivity

The Azure Purifier is an Evolved Reborn upgrader, successor to the Azure Refiner, first teased in a tweet by OutOfOrderFoxy. It was then added in the Reincarnation Update.
It upgrades ores in the same way as its predecessor, except with a x9 multiplier instead.

The Searing Heat is an Evolved Reborn upgrader, successor of the Scorching Heat, confirmed by a tweet from Foxy, then added in the Reincarnation Update.
For normal ores, the Searing Heat's capabilities are wasted as it only sets ores on fire, as well as setting the first upgrade beam to neon white. However, if the ore is already ignited, a 11x multiplier is applied but the ore will still need to be extinguished afterwards. Note that unlike Scorching Heat, it will not destroy ores instantly if not on fire.

Gaia's Grasp is an Evolved Reborn cell furnace added in The Trinity Update. It is the successor to the Nature's Grip.
It processes ore worth under $1k at x3T and ore worth $1k or more at x3B. It also has a very lax criterion compared to other cell furnaces as the ore only needs to have an upgrade counter of less than 20, whereas most cell furnaces require an upgrade counter of 0 or less.

quote: A true balance between utopia and dystopia. If only the previous empire knew this, it would never have collapsed.
overview:
The Neutropian Refiner is a Slipstream upgrader added in the Reincarnation Update.
The upgrader makes ores slightly less reflective. It also upgrades ores with no negative status effects by x90, while ores with a negative status effect (fire, radiation, poison, etc.) are multiplied by x125; the negative status effect is not reverted. Additionally, the upgrader has an upgrade counter of 0, which becomes -6 if the ore's current upgrade count is 6 or more.

quote: The red sands of this garden burn not with heat, but with the anguish the statue suffers.
overview:
The Anguished Garden is a Reborn Fusion furnace, a fusion between the Dreamer's Anguish and the Sakura Garden, released on the Reincarnation Update.
It is very similar to the Sakura Garden, expressing almost no statistical traits from the Dreamer's Anguish.
It has a base multiplier of x17k, which decreases by x2 for each ore processed. If an ore is processed that has a negative effect such as fire, the multiplier is decreased by x4 and the ore is not processed. The decreasing in multiplier is shown above the furnace. (Requires further testing.)

quote: Rogue colonies from other planets may attempt to invade us if we try growing too powerful.

Orbital Cataclysm is a Slipstream fine-point upgrader released during the Reincarnation Update.
The Orbital Cataclysm is an upgrader that stores the upgrade count of the first ore to touch it, but destroys it in the process. However, the next ore to pass through will be multiplied by that upgrade count, potentially leading to very powerful multipliers. This process repeats immediately afterward, but instead of destroying the first ore in the cycle of 2, it does not.
It is important to note that every 1 reflectance the ore has,
