quote: After defeating Daegel, Vulcan created a volcano over where he won, to live at forever. Each eruption of this volcano is a symbol of his rage.
overview:
The Vulcan's Wrath is a Superstitious upgrader added in the 2020 Easter Event.
As a standalone upgrader, it multiplies ore value by 65x and changes ore material to neon. Every ore fed in the top adds +1 to the multiplier, +5 if the said ore is on fire. The maximum multiplier is 165x (aka 100 regular ores or 20 flaming ores fed), indicated by the volcano erupting, and ore that goes through this upgrader afterwards will be set on fire, which kills ore in 4 seconds. One should use any mines that can supply the Vulcan's Wrath a large amount of ores fast enough to erupt the Volcano,
Rather than producing a sound upon placement, it instead produces the sound of a bursting volcano when erupted, heard across the server.
This item is based off the God of Fire, Vulcan.

quote: An upgrader with a broken and hardened heart. It shows so [sic] mercy to ore when upgrading, and is rather random with its upgrades.
overview:
The Heartbreaker is a Exotic upgrader added in Part II of the Valentine's 2020 Event.
The Heartbreaker has a base multiplier of x2.5, which is increased to x3.5 if a flaming ore passes through the upgrader, lighting the surrounding candles. The new multiplier will permanently be applied to the upgrader until replaced. This has a total multiplier of x15.6-x97.5. With fire, it is increased to x42.9-x525.2.
The Heartbreaker caps at 3 to 5 uses, which is decided at random. Whenever an ore passes through, it adds 1 or 2 machine tags to the ore, and will not upgrade the ore if it has at least 5 tags. The chances of the 3 to 5 max usage cap are as follows:
• 50% (8 in 16) will end up getting only 3 upgrades.
• 43.75% (7 in 16) will end up getting only 4 upgrades.
• 6.25% (1 in 16) will end up getting all 5 upgrades.

f.effects:
• Multiplies ore value by 2.5x
• Multiplier permanently increased by +1 if a flaming ore passes through.
f.drawbacks:
• Multiplier increase requires flaming ore.
• Multiplier increase from flaming ore can only occur once.
• Machine tag count is decided at random, resulting in an inconsistent upgrade limit.

quote: Fly like a butterfly, sting like a butterfly. This upgrader is as strong as a butterfly, it ain't a glass cannon.

The Glass Butterfly is a Limited Reborn upgrader added in the 2020 Valentine's Event.
It multiplies ore value by x8, However, the ore has to be on the Way-Up-High elevation. This can be achieved via the Large Converter Ramp.
The "glass" part of the glass butterfly changes in color frequently, from yellow to green, sometimes red and even purple. The color changing of the upgrader part is related to the changing of day and night. The stained glass decorations and the upgrader itself also changes to a random color pattern when placed/moved.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by 8x

quote: Passed down through the gods: The True Book of Knowledge. Unlike the fake book you got from Enchanting, this tome contains the knowledge behind Superstitious items.
overview:
The True Book of Knowledge is an Ultimate utility item released in the Reincarnation Update.
Once you are life S+1,000 and above, you can go talk to Draedon in the Sporest to receive this item. This book is not a furnace, unlike the Enchanted-tier Book of Knowledge. Instead, it contains information regarding the Superstitious items in the game. It shows their respective deities, and the items compatible. Each item also has a part of the Miner's Haven lore under it.

f.effects: Gives recipes for Catalysts to use for Superstitious items.

quote: A machine which performs an outstanding job at cooling down flaming ore! However with all its work, it's bound to overheat and degrade value.
overview:
The Cooling Chamber is a Reborn-tier upgrader added in Part II of the 2020 Saint Patrick's Day Event.
It's a very unique item as it serves as an upgrader with heavy multipliers and a fire extinguisher. However, it has to be maintained in order for it to work at maximum power.
It holds an internal variable that determines whether it is neutral or overheated. This variable starts at 36 and can increase or decrease depending on the ores that pass through it. This variable does not have an upper nor a lower limit.
If the Cooling Chamber's internal variable reaches 0, it will become overheated (visible when the lights on the upgrader turn from white to orange). In order to revert the overheat status, the Cooling Chamber requires its internal variable to reach 18, equivalent to 6 frozen ores.
The Cooling Chamber cannot be maintained solely by frozen, flaming ores. If the Cooling Chamber is neutral, then the flaming ore's -3 takes priority, and vice versa for the overheated status.
(Frozen ores are not the same as fireproof ores. Frozen ores are slippery, but fireproof ores cannot be set on fire.)

quote: Dubious Noobius, a reckless, yet absurdly intelligent creature, have harbored technology capable of upgrading any ore based on how many digits is in the value. Truly an Ooftopia for them.
overview:
The Ooftopian Refiner is a Decimal-Rarity Reborn upgrader added in the April Fool's Update.
It multiplies ore based on their order of magnitude. The multiplier is calculated by the following formula, where x is the value of the ore:
(3 / 2) × _10x3
(x represents the floor function, which rounds down a number to the closest integer.)
Alternatively, if n denotes the exponent of the ore value in scientific notation, the formula for the multiplier is simply:
(3 / 2) × (n / 3)
In other words, the exponent is divided by three, rounded down to the nearest integer, then multiplied by 1.5.
The minimum upgrade is x0 for ores worth less than $1,000 and the maximum possible upgrader is x150.

f.effects:
• Multiplies ore value based on suffix exponent.
• 1 suffix = additional x1.5.
• Temporarily increases ore density.
• Changes ore color into bright yellow.
f.drawbacks:
• Capped at x150 ($1NONONGNTL).
• Does x0 to ores if under $1k.
f.other_notes: Plays an "Oof!" sound effect when ore or player passes through.

If successfully upgraded and then processed, this applies a 1575x multiplier to the ore.
Ore sent through the portal cannot enter it again, even if the ore passes through a Resetting Device, and will instead bounce off into the processor.

x.t: *Shiny versions of items are also buffed.

*Gradual x1.8 upgrade, upgrades by x1.03 every 0.5 seconds 20 times. Does not apply additional upgrade counter.
**Instant Education, skips the education effect of the Ore Illuminator and any of its related items. This is identical to the behaviour of the Gargantium Mine with the Stardust Illuminator.

While it has a really good multiplier per unit even at the worst case (anything greater than 2 is considered very good), the Enchanted Library has a secondary yet equally as important use.
This is the only upgrader in the game, other than Gargantium Core, that is able to give ores the ability to be instantly educated. Furthermore, because Gargantium Cores select pulsars randomly, it is unreliable if you have only 2 or 3 of them to split to different colors. The Enchanted Library is a good replacement for the green Gargantium Core as only a small amount of ores can guarantee the instant education effect. It is best to power your Gargantium Core with the Ore Hypernova as the Enchanted Library is a good replacement for instant education.
For reference, the chance that at least one out of 30 ores that pass through this upgrader get the instant education effect is roughly equal to the chance that 6 Gargantium Cores will receive two different colors by random selection (~97%). What makes it even more viable is that the instant education effect cannot be reset, and is also carried over when ore is replicated.

overview:
The Way-Up-High Mini Converter and the Way-Up-High Regular Converter are Intermediate conveyors released in the 2019 Halloween Update. It can be used for converting regular way up high conveyors to mini conveyors.

The Way-Up-High Regular Converter allows ores coming in from 1-unit wide way-up-high upgraders to transition into a 2-unit wide way-up-high conveyor. The Regular converter also features part of a Centering Conveyor.

quote: This construct was believed to be used by Kromos. Of course this isn't his exact hourglass, but a mortal like you couldn't understand the immense value each grain of sand contains.
overview:
The Hourglass is a Superstitious upgrader that was added in the 5th Anniversary Update. It is tied to the Titan of Time, Kronos.
The Hourglass has a high base multiplier of x90 which increases by +1 for every second since it has been placed down. This multiplier caps at x290, in 3 minutes and 20 seconds. This cannot be boosted by placing down more of this item.
The Hourglass also features a secondary effect that increases the speed of conveyors of all items on the users base and will cap at x2 conveyor speed. Similarly, this caps after 200 seconds with one Hourglass. It can also be boosted by placing down more Hourglasses. For every Hourglass that is placed down, every second, 1/200 of the conveyor's speed (for all items) is added to itself. Simply put, assuming a specific number of Hourglasses x are placed down simultaneously, the time to reach the conveyor speed boost cap is (200 ÷ x) seconds.
The conveyor speed boost retains unless the player rebirths or leaves the game. As long as The Hourglass has previously been placed, all conveyors placed and would-be placed will receive this conveyor speed bonus, even if The Hourglass has already been withdrawn.

overview:
The Swag City is a Superstitious upgrader added in The Magic Update. It is the item of Billy Lucifer, the Demigod of Hemomancy.
Swag City is unique in that the area under the three streetlights serve as the upgrader beams, each being able to upgrade ores once. Using a Centering Conveyor, Railgun Cannon, or Dragon Cannon usually helps ensure the ores hit all three upgraders, assuming the ore is large enough to catch each beam. Another method is to use both, a Centering Conveyor first and then a Cannon.

• During the night, each beam does 5.7x for a total multiplier of 185.193x

Ores have to hit all the upgrader beams to get a complete upgrade.
May set ores on fire.

submission.name: Swag City
submission.description: DIE FOR MY WITCH

x.t:
Swag City functions differently during daytime and nighttime.
During the day, each streetlight upgrades ores by 4.5x, resulting in a total multiplier of 91.125x.
During the night, each streetlight upgrades ores by 5.7x, resulting in a total multiplier of 185.193x.
Each beam has a 20% chance of setting ores on fire, resulting in a 48.8% chance for ores to be ignited if every beam is used.

overview:
The Soul Blossom is a Decimal-Rarity Reborn utility furnace added in The Magic Update.
It possesses an aura that clears most negative status effects of any ore within its radius, similarly to a Wild Spore. It initially processes ore at x0, but if an ore upgraded by The Sporest, Mycolympus or Big Fungus has previously been processed, its multiplier becomes x1 permanently until removed.
Its aura encloses a cylinder with a radius of ~6 units and height of ~4 units. However, since it takes up some of the area enclosed, it can only maximally reach 3 or 4 units out.

quote: GET BACK TO WORK OR YOU'RE FIRED! Maximum of 5 per base.
overview:
The Goliath Gumball Machine is an Exotic mine added during Part I of the Halloween 2020 event.
You can have at most five Goliath Gumball Machines on your base. If you place more than five, all of the Goliath Gumball Machines will be disabled.
Unlike the Swintite and Pumpkinite droppers, this dropper is not an excavator, having an automated fixed drop rate. The drop rate is approximately one ore every 0.75 seconds. In addition, the gumballs have spherical physics, meaning that they accelerate down slopes, cannot ascend ramps, and have a rather difficult time navigating through a conveyor line.

f.drawbacks:
Can't have more than 5 placed on your base, or else it won't be activated.
Ore shape is spherical, difficult to control.
Ore can't be replicated.

x.t:
As the ore produced by this mine is a polar opposite compared to the common, cuboidal shape, it is important to understand how the ores work.
• There are no flat sides to this ore, meaning there is extremely low friction between them and the conveyors they're on, making it difficult to control on conveyors and almost impossible to travel up slopes.
• Unlike other ores, these ores have rotational velocity (RTV).
• This means the ores create a backspin, allowing them to increase their RTV and ultimately their speed.
• RTV works fairly strangely when paired with teleporters. Upon exiting a teleporter receiver, spherical ores with any RTV will roll in the direction opposite of the direction they entered the teleporter sender as a result of backspin.
• Spherical ores with high RTV have a small chance to be flung out of the receiver in the direction they entered.
• Instead of using ramps, Use the Ore Elevator from the shop to let your ores go higher, and use the raised candy upgraders.

quote: This isn't the real Frankenstein monster, but happens to be a regular zombie dressing up for Halloween.
overview:
The Frankenstein Guardian is a Collectible guardian added in Part I of the Halloween Event 2020.
When placed down, it will attack other players within a radius estimated to be around half the distance of your base. It will not attack your friends.

quote: A doge trained by Meralin himself. Not to learn spells, but just to glow in the dark.
overview: Witch Doge is a Collectible Doge added in the Halloween Event 2020.

quote: Can you not be yourself for five minutes?!
overview: The Pumpkin Carriage is a Collectible upgrader added in the 2020 Halloween Event. It multiplies ore value by x3.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by x3

quote: A strange and muscular spider created a strong and thick web which has suspended an upgrader off the ground!
overview:
The Silkweaver is a Collectible upgrader added in the 2020 Halloween Event.
It multiplies ore value by x1.75, with a Way-Up-High elevation with no side effects.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by 1.75x.

quote: This conveyor used to be a hay field, until some spiders came along and made it a nest.
overview:
The Webbed Conveyor is a Collectible conveyor added in Part I of the 2020 Halloween Event.
This conveyor is as slow as a Basic Conveyor. It most likely could be useful for timed upgraders such as the Ore Illuminator or the Draedon's Gauntlet.

quote: |A soda machine containing sugar-free Dr. Berza. The quality of the soda never passed safety regulations|Item Description|0% sugar!|In-game Tooltip
overview: The Diet Dr. Berza Machine is a Divine Decoration added in the Halloween Event 2020.Halloween Event 2020

f.effects: Dispenses Diet Dr. Berza cans

quote: The blade Ghosdeeri wields when inflicting the land with disastrous plagues and diseases.
overview: Ghosdeeri's Plague is an Collectible weapon giver added in Part I of the Halloween 2020 event.

f.effects:
Give Player the Blade of Plague
Increase the User's movement speed by 5

quote: Plague Doctors, the mortals who dared challenge Ghosdeeri's plagues. While they had good intentions, their practices only caused more problems.
overview:
The Plague Doctor is an Collectible upgrader added in Part I of the Halloween Event 2020.
It multiplies ore value x5 and randomly applies 1 of 3 status effects (Fire, Poison, Radioactivity). It also removes the Plague effect from ores that have it.

f.effects:
Multiplies ore value by x5
Removes Plague
Applies one of the following:
• Fire
• Poison
• Radiation

overview:
The Demon is an Phantasmal Upgrader added in Part I of the Halloween 2020 event.
It upgrades ore value by x6. Ore that have been previously upgraded by the ghosts of SpookDemon-66,666 gain an additional +2.5 multiplier.
This item can be obtained from Phantasm if the player owns the SpookDemon-66,666.

It multiplies ore value by x6.6, which is increased by +1 for each unique Spook mine that has been placed on the base.
This item is available from Phantasm by having the Spookmaster-5000 in your inventory.

The Boy is an Phantasmal portable upgrader added in Part I of the Halloween 2020 event.
It multiplies ore value by x1.75 and sets ore on fire for 4 seconds, destroying them if not extinguished.
This item can be obtained from Phantasm if the player owns the Spookboy-500.

The Lord is an Phantasmal Upgrader added in Part I of the Halloween 2020 event.
It multiplies ore value by x4, but ores that have been previously upgraded by the ghosts of the SpookLord-95,000 gain an additional +3 multiplier.
This item can be obtained from Phantasm if the player owns the SpookLord-95,000.

quote: Candy Corn, some hate it, some love it. But no matter which side of the spectrum you're on, both must agree this is an effective use of it. This adds candy value to ores
overview:
The Candycorn Refiner is a Collectible upgrader added in Part I of the 2020 Halloween Event.
It multiples ore value by x1.4 while also adding 1 Candy to Candy ore. However, it is incompatible with the Candy Castle due to them both being candy corn-styled upgraders.

f.effects:
Multiplies ore value x1.4
+1 Candy Value
f.drawbacks:
Does not work on ore worth >3 Candy
Cannot be used with ⟦Candy Castle⟧.

quote: A refiner which fuses the ore with a core made entirely out of gum, while converting the shell to solid candy. Adds candy value to ore.
overview: The Lolipop-inator is a Collectible Upgrader added in the Halloween Update 2020. It multiplies ore value by 1.75x, adds 1 Candy value to candy ores, and changes the ore's material to smooth plastic.

f.effects:
x1.75 to ore value
+1 Candy to candy value
f.upgrade_limit:
1 for multiplier,
(not resettable) for candy value · resettable

quote: A comically large chocolate bar. Ore are upgraded normally, however flaming ore gets put out while also earning a rich coat of chocolate. This adds candy value to ore.
overview: The Chocolate Coater is a Collectible upgrader that was added in Part I of the 2020 Halloween Event. It multiplies ore value by x1.6667, while also adding 1 Candy to Candy Ores. It also extinguishes fire.

f.effects:
Multiplies ore value by x1.666666
Extinguishes fire
+1 Candy Value
f.drawbacks: Non-resettable upgrade

quote: A special center used to manufacture candy in larger quantities.
overview:
The Candy Factory is a Certain- added in the 2020 Halloween Event.
The furnace can store up to 10,000 Candy at once before needing to be manually collected. It also increases the value of any Candy ore that enter it by 25%. It also processes normal ores by x25.
Upon pressing the button to empty the furnace, a GUI will pop up asking to confirm whether or not you would like to empty the furnace. In order to counter being AFK, the position of the yes button will change occasionally when it is pressed.

f.effects:
• Stores up to 10,000 Candy at once.
• Increases Candy value by 25%
• Processes normal ore at x25 its value
f.drawbacks: Can only store up to 10,000 Candy at a time.

quote: Hello customer, we sell colored tubes of candy for you to ingest. Better yet, you choose the flavors! Green sugar, orange sugar, you name it!
overview: The Candypreneur Wall is a Collectible wall added in the 2020 Halloween Event. It can be obtained from Lucian for 15 Candy .

quote: |A third-party company tired pitching the idea of a cherry flavored Dr. Berza. Due to a shortage of cherries, they used cherry bombs instead|Item Description|12lbs of gunpowder in every drink!|In-game Tooltip
overview: The Dr.Berza Zer0 Machine is a Divine Decoration added in the Halloween Event 2020.

f.effects: Screen distortion, hallucinations and death.
f.drawbacks: Will cause user to die.

quote: |A more wholesome energy bar, usually putting people in a good mood if they haven't gotten the proper sleep.|Item Description|Made by blobcats|In-game Tooltip
overview: The Foxerbar Machine is a Divine Decoration added in the Halloween Event 2020.

f.effects: Dispenses Foxerbars

quote: A cake with a nice sear on it, with extra crisp too! What? Cakes aren't supposed to be seared and crispy?
overview:
The Smore Cake is an Exotic upgrader that comes only from the Cake-Raffle Box.
It multiplies ore value by x7, up to 3 times for a total multiplier of x343. The upgrader has a chance to set ore on fire, destroying the ore unless the fire is extinguished (At the moment we estimate this chance to be 69%).
Uniquely, it shares an upgrade limit of 3 with the other cakes items from Cake Raffle Box.

f.effects:
• Multiplies ore value by 7x
• Chance to set ore on fire
f.drawbacks: Fire destroys ore in 5 seconds
f.upgrade_limit:
3
(Shared with the other cakes within the same box) · resettable

quote: The name's Deez.
overview:
The Peanut Butter Cake is an Exotic upgrader that comes only from the Cake Raffle Box.
It multiplies ore value by x5 and replicates the first 9 ores that enter the cake. On replication, peanuts on the model disappear as a visual indicator.
Uniquely, it shares an upgrade limit of 3 with the other cakes items from Cake Raffle Box.

f.effects:
• Multiplies ore value by 5x.
• Replicates first 9 ores
f.upgrade_limit:
3
(Shared with the other cakes within the same box) · resettable

quote: Hammed burger :(
overview:
The Forsaken Cake is an Exotic Furnace which can be obtained via Cake Raffles Boxes. It multiplies ore value by x15. This value increases to x30 if the user has talked to Fargield during that day.
The look of the furnace shares resemblance with Fargield.

f.effects:
• Multiplies ore value by 15x
• Multiplier increases to 30x if the player has talked to Fargield

quote: This shrine houses a sword the warriors of Zeus wielded while defending his kingdom. It's a shame that kingdom has long since fallen.
overview: The Windforce Shrine is an Exotic weapon giver that was added during the Sixth Anniversary Event. Upon touching the item, the player is given the Windforce, a sword that flings players on contact. The fling is very low, making the opponent float for a little bit before landing about 10-15 studs away. Should you want to fling someone, use the Doomsday Apparatus instead.

f.effects: Gives the player a Windforce gear.

quote: A cake that produces orange juice when squeezed.
overview:
The Citrus Cake is an Exotic upgrader from the Sixth Anniversary Event. It currently does 5x, though if an ore that passes through it has been upgraded by the Citrus Enhancer before, it upgrades the ore by 10x.
Uniquely, it shares an upgrade limit of 3 with the other cakes items from Cake Raffle Box.

f.effects:
• Multiplies ore by x5
• Ore that has been previously upgraded by Citrus Enhancer gets a 10x multiplier.
f.upgrade_limit:
3 
(Shared with the other cakes within the same box) · resettable

quote: Evolving the Vortex Chamber had only caused the vortex to grow incredibly unstable, distorting gravity entirely!
overview:
Vortex Singularity is an Evolved Reborn upgrader item added in Miner's Haven's 6th Anniversary Event in June 2021. It upgrades the ore by 9x and flips its gravity, making it Anti-Gravity if they weren't already, and vice versa.
Its 9x multiplier only works once without a Resetting Device. Its other function of reversing ore gravity can be used indefinitely.

f.source: Evolve with 15 Vortex Chambers at The Craftsman.
f.effects: Multiplies ore value by 9x, and reverses ore gravity.
f.drawbacks: Reverses ore gravity.

quote: L.I.M.E. stands for "Lemon Imposter". The "M" and "E" means nothing.
overview:
The L.I.M.E. is a Collectible upgrader added in the 2021 Birthday Event. It upgrades ore by 20% (1.2x) and shrinks ore size.
Can be used with Massive Diamond Mine to decrease the size of the ore two times, due to the size of the ore.

f.source:
Birthday Box
Premium Shop
Mystery Boxes
f.effects:
Halves the size of ores.
Upgrades ore value by 1.2x
f.drawbacks: Ores can be clogged without being centered.

quote: A big pile of presents! Who knows what is inside, one can tell.
overview:
Birthday Gifts is a Collectible decoration added during the Sixth Anniversary Event.
It is a collection of presents with various sizes. Does not open into anything.

f.source:
Birthday Box
Premium Shop
Mystery Boxes

quote: A wholesome little table equipped with all the birthday necessities!
overview:
The Birthday Table is a Collectible Decoration that was added in Sixth Anniversary Event.
This table has a party hat, 3 cupcakes, and 2 presents.

quote: It's Doge's Birthday, wish Doge a happy birthday. DO IT WISH DOGE A HAPPY BIRTHDAY!
overview: The Birthday Doge is a Collectible Decoration added in the Miner's Haven's 6th Anniversary Event in June 12, 2021.

f.source:
Birthday Box
Premium Shop
Mystery Boxes

quote: Well, the years start coming and they don't stop coming.
overview: All Star Conveyor is a Collectible Conveyor. It is obtainable during the Sixth Anniversary Event.

quote: A nice little table that create a pleasant atmosphere in any living room.
overview:
The Decorated Table is a Divine Decoration that was added in 6th Anniversary Event.
It is a table with 3 books, a coaster, a mug, and a flower vase.

quote: A cake so spectacular a single slice satisfies your hunger for a lifetime!
overview: The All Star Behemoth Cake is an Exotic furnace added in the Sixth Anniversary Event. It processes ores with a flat multiplier of 645x.

f.effects: Process ore at 645x its value.

quote: An ancient device, unfortunately there are no TV stations, but at least it shows some funny memes.
overview: The Historic Television is a Divine Decoration that was added in Sixth Anniversary Event.

quote: Legends say the Blueperry [sic] Pie came from a vessel such as this. Amazing how this could house up to 6 of them!
overview:
The Cherry Pie is an Exotic upgrader from the 6th Anniversary. It multiplies ores by x1.8, but if it has been upgraded by Blueberry Pie before it, multiplies by x3.6.
It has an upgrader counter of 0, so it can be used after an Ore Illuminator.
Uniquely, it shares an upgrade limit of 3 with the other cakes items from Cake Raffle Box.

f.effects:
• Multiplies ore value by x1.8
• Ore that have been upgraded by the Blueberry Pie will multiply ore value by 3.6x
• Changes ore color to red and ore material to pebble
f.upgrade_limit:
3 
(Shared with the other cakes within the same box) · resettable

quote: A cake bestowed upon you by Hades! No he didn't bake this, Billy did, but Hades likes having his name put on the tag anyway.
overview:
The Devil's Cake is an Exotic upgrader that comes from the Cake Raffle Box.
Base multiplier of the cake starts off at x7, but can be increased by having negative effects applied to ore:
Uniquely, it shares an upgrade limit of 3 with the other cakes items from Cake Raffle Box.

f.effects:
Multiplies ore by 7x
Multiplier increases depending on ore effects (refer to overview)

3

quote: A cake bestowed upon you by Zeus himself! You don't care about that? Fine the cake is vanilla.
overview:
Angel's Cake is an Exotic upgrader that is obtainable from Cake Raffle Box.
It have a base multiplier of x6, which can increase depending on how many status effect the ores has, maximum of x10. After being upgraded, it will removes all of the ore negative status effect.
Effects that can increase the multiplier are listed on this table below.
Uniquely, it shares an upgrade limit of 3 with the other cakes items from Cake Raffle Box.

• Base multiplier of x6
• Removes negative effects (Once)
• Multiplier increases based off of effect on ore (refer to overview)
----Maximum of x10

3

quote: Turns out the dragon fruits used for this cake was actually dragon eggs. This is actually a dragon cake, a living dragon cake.
overview:
The Dragon Cake is an Exotic upgrader that comes from the Cake Raffle Box released in the 6th Annual Miner's Haven Birthday Event.
It multiplies ore value by 8x and has a chance to set ores on fire and explode the ore. The explosion also flings ore, so it is recommended to use a Molten Forge and/or Obsidian Infusion Device before this so ores aren't flung as far, to avoid the ores dying.
Uniquely, it shares an upgrade limit of 3 with the other cakes items from Cake Raffle Box.

f.effects:
• Multiplies ore value by 8x.
• Has a chance to set ore on fire
• Has a chance to cause explosions
f.drawbacks: Fire destroys ores in 4 seconds

3
(Shared with the other cakes within the same box) · resettable

quote: An ice cream sundae that is impossible to melt. It is an eternal waffle cone of infinite ice cream flavors!
overview:
All Star Sundae is a Exotic upgrader that was added in the Miner's Haven's Sixth Anniversary Event in June 12, 2021.
All Star Sundae upgrades every 6th ore by x25 and all other ores by x15, which averages at x16.667. Sixth Anniversary Event

f.effects:
• Upgrades ore value by x15
• Every 6th ore receives a x25 upgrade

quote: A cake made by the most experienced bees. Be careful, this cake will sting back if antagonized.
overview:
The Honeycomb Cake is an Exotic Upgrader added on Miner's Haven's sixth anniversary in June 2021.
It has a base upgrade of 6x and can be increased up to 9x if the ore has already been upgraded by other bee-related items. On top of that, the cake also applies the Hydrophobic effect, meaning that ores cannot be affected by the Wet effect.
Uniquely, it shares an upgrade limit of 3 with the other cakes items from Cake Raffle Box.

Multiplies ore value by 6x
Applies Hydrophobic effect
Machine tags from bee items increase multiplier:
• ⟦Honeycomb Solace⟧: +1
• ⟦Deluxe Beehive⟧: +1
• ⟦The Beehive⟧: +1

quote: This upgrader goes finely with the Peanut Butter Cake. Well too bad you have no choice, you can only use one.
overview:
The Jelly Cake is an Exotic Upgrader that comes only from the Cake Raffle Box.
Jelly Cake upgrades ore values by a flat x8, sets ore transparency to 0.5, changes ore color to purple and increases ore elasticity.
Uniquely, it shares an upgrade limit of 3 with the other cakes items from Cake Raffle Box.

f.effects:
• Multiplies ore value by x8
• Paints ores purple
• Sets ore transparency to 0.5
• Increases ore elasticity

quote: Unfortunately this cake survived the sands of time. It is not recommended to eat this unless you like the taste of mold.
overview: The Belated 4th Birthday Cake is an Exotic furnace added in the Miner's Haven Sixth Anniversary Event on June 12, 2021. It processes ores at 100x their value. However, ores that have existed for longer than 60 seconds are destroyed.

f.effects: Processes ores at 100x their value.
f.drawbacks: Any ores that have been alive for more than 60 seconds are destroyed.

quote: A Donut that glazes your ore in a layer of chocolate!
overview: The Donut Refiner is an Collectible Upgrader which was added in the sixth anniversary event. It multiplies ore value by 1.75x with no known additional effects. It requires ores to be at a raised elevation to upgrade ore.

f.source:
Birthday Box
Premium Shop
Mystery Boxes
f.effects: Multiplies ore by 1.75x

quote: You either like this conveyor, or you don't. But more than likely, you do not like this conveyor. It radiates "Fargield"
overview: The Gielded Conveyor is a Collectible Conveyor. It was added in the Sixth Anniversary Event.

f.source:
Birthday Box
Premium Shop
Mystery Boxes

quote: The turtles were a distant enemy of the frogs. No one messed with the turtles, as they were born with the most powerful armor during the Anura era.
overview:
The Turtle Dignifier is a Decimal-Rarity Reborn raisedupgrader added in the Sixth Anniversary Event. It can be obtained by rebirthing above life 4000 with a rarity of 0.3.
The item multiplies ore value by x8. If the ore has a wet status effect when upgraded by it, it receives 1 shield that lasts for the remaining duration of the wet effect. However, the shield is not given if the ore has the Dog Water effect. Unlike the Illusions of Void, it gives a shield even if the ores already has a shield.

f.effects:
• Multiplies ore value by x8.
• Applies temporary shield to ore if it has wet effect for duration of the wet effect.
f.drawbacks: Temporary shield only works with regular wet effect, does not work with the permanent version given by ⟦Borker's Luxury Villa⟧.

quote: This skillet will leave a nice sear on your ore, assuming it hasn't been cooked yet. Don't worry, it'll remember to add salt and pepper.
overview:
The Ore Skillet is an Reborn upgrader, added in the Sixth Anniversary Event. It can be obtained by rebirthing above life 753.
It upgrades ore value by a base of 2x, the multiplier increasing by 1 for each ore dropped onto the frying pan, up to a multiplier of 10x. Each ore is fried for a total of 5 seconds before vanishing.

f.effects:
• Multiplies ore value by a base of 2x.
• Each ore dropped onto the frying pan increases the multiplier by 1 up to 10x.
f.drawbacks: Inner walls can make uncentered ore stuck.

quote: They say the Frigid Dystopia are the last functional remains of the D.U.C after it collapsed. If true, perhaps they are planning something, something that can't be good.
overview:
The Auroral Metropolis is an Advanced Evolution upgrader, and the successor to the Frigid Dystopia. It was added in the Sixth Anniversary Event in June 12, 2021.
Auroral Metropolis upgrades ores differently whether they are frozen or not. For ores that do not have the frozen effect, they receive a 10x upgrade. However, for the ores that have the frozen effect, they receive a 25x upgrade.

f.source: Evolve with 8 Frigid Dystopias at The Craftsman.
f.effects:
Multiplies value of non-frozen ore by 10x
Multiplies value of frozen ore by 25x.
f.drawbacks: Ore must be frozen in order to get the best multiplier.

quote: It is unknown as to why this mine exists, but it's believed to only exist solely to torment those who intend to use it.
overview:
The Grimstruct is an Advanced Reborn dropper that will be added in the Third Sacrifice Update.
Its ore will be worth $1, and unable to be replicated nor upgraded by stars. When placed, other mines will be unable to produce ore, and all ore it has dropped will be killed if it is withdrawn. Completing the Grimstruct challenge with it will reward the player with the Boötes Void and returning their Soulbound items in Third Sacrifice.

f.effects: Disables all other droppers while placed.
f.drawbacks:
• Ores are replicator-banned.
• Ores cannot be upgraded by stars.
• Withdrawing the mine instantly kills all of its ores.

submission.name: Spooky.
submission.description:
The Spook Lurker uses its tentacles to consume who were left alone and lost in the void.
unofficial description:
"Once in a while, after the Oblivion Lurkers killed enough people, they form into an abomination of a mine like this one. The mines are powered by both the souls of the unfortunate and the Oblivion Lurkers' souls."

quote: Allen St, Tombstone AZ. Does not produce event candy.
overview:
The Ghastly Saloon is an Exotic upgrader that was added in the 2022 Halloween Event.
It multiplies ores value by x10-x12 with no additional effect.

f.effects: Multiplies Ore Value by x10-12

quote: Increases the output of candy ores from Halloween mines. Stains regular ores with candycorn colors and increase their value when activated.
overview:
The Candy Core is a Collectible utility pulsar upgrader that was added in the 2022 Halloween Event.
It increases the drop rate of candy mines by 30% to 50%. Upon pressing the Pulse button, it upgrades all ores on your base by 3x. Unlike other Pulsars, the multiplier can be used again using a Resetter.

f.effects:
Boost the drop rate of candy mines by 30-50% when placed
Multiplies ore value by x3 when activated
f.drawbacks: Cooldown of 15 seconds

quote: Effortlessly fly through the skies on these spooky October nights!
overview:
The Witch's Broomstick is a Collectible utility that was added in the 2022 Halloween Event.
It grants you a gear that upon clicking, makes you fly around in a broomstick for 15 seconds. It has a 15 second cooldown before being able to use it again.

f.effects: Gives you a broomstick that lets you fly (15s fly, 15s cooldown)

quote: The perfect accoutrement to a haunted fairground. Does not produce candy.
overview:
The Frightful Cotton Candy is a Collectible upgrader that was added in the 2022 Halloween Event.
It upgrades ore value by x3 and increases ore size by 25%, it also increase your candy value by +1 Candy.

f.effects:
Multiplies ore value by x3 and increases ore size
+1 Candy candy value

quote: Where do you even get a bat-shaped cookie cutter this large?
overview:
The Hellish Bat Cookie is a Collectible upgrader that was added in the 2022 Halloween Event.
It adds 1 Candy to candy ore, and multiplies ore value based on its Red RGB value, starting from 3x to a maximum of 5x. To get the max multiplier, it is recommended to use an Ore Painter to change the RGB value to be as red as possible.

f.effects:
Base multiplier of x3, increases up to x5 based on the ore Red RGB value
Adds 1 Candy

quote: The original arcade game, earn points by whacking a Gield with a toy hammer!
overview:
The Whac-A-Gield is a Fabled decoration item added in the Winter Event 2022. It can be obtained by owning the Adorable Plushie Artifact.
It allows you to play a minigame based on the Whac-A-Mole arcade game. Instead of using moles, it uses Fargield instead. You get 30 seconds to play the minigame. Every time you whack a gield, you get 10 score. You can view your best, current, and server score behind the gields.

f.effects: Lets you play a game of Whac-A-Gield.

quote: Introduced in Japan as part of the Bemani series, Gield Gield Revolution is the pioneering series of the rhythm and dance genre in video games.
overview:
The Gield Gield Furevolution is a Fabled decoration item added in the Winter Event 2022. It can be obtained by owning the Adorable Plushie Artifact.
This item took on the appearance of a DDR Machine. It currently has no function and only acts as a decoration.

quote: A creature not of this world, one whose ascension had led it here. Its gaze familiarizes the ore of this world with that of its own.
overview:
The FRIGHT FOLLY is a limited-time Fabled portable upgrader added in the 2023 Halloween Event, obtainable by purchasing the Fright Folly Gamepass, available during Halloween.
It multiplies ore value by x6.66 once.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by x6.66

quote: This is a replica of the citadel where the final battle between Meralin and Morpheus took place. To this day, they say his wand still lies within, waiting for the inevitable return of its master. Hydraulic conveyors are required to reach this item.
overview:
The Esoteric Citadel is a Reborn Upgrader added on February 1st, 2024.
The multiplier starts at x1 for ores with 0 machine tags and increases by x1 for every machine tag up to a limit of x40 at 39 machine tags. It requires Hydraulic Conveyors or an Ore Cannon to reach the upgrader.

f.effects: Multiplies ore value by the number of Machine Tags the ore has +1, up to x40.
f.drawbacks: Requires Hydraulics or Ore Cannon to reach upgrader.

quote: This locomotive is much like those seen within Chaos Canyon. Feeding it coal ore will allow for it to explode its engine to launch ores forward.
overview:
The Combustion Engine is a Reborn Upgrader added on February 1st, 2024.
It has a base multiplier of x5. When a coal ore passes through the upgrader, it consumes it, its multiplier is boosted to x9 and it explodes any non-coal ores forward. This is purely visual and does not affect the player or other ores. The coal ore cannot be saved by any means, including shields.

f.effects:
Base Multiplier of x5.

It has an appearance of Fargield. It will ragdoll other players in your base.
On idle it plays the Ud'zal idle animation.

f.effects: Ragdoll intruders.

overview:
The Harbinger of Destruction is a Decimal-Rarity Evolved Reborn Guardian added on February 1st, 2024.
It resembles Fargield with a muscular build. It will ragdoll other players in your base with a chance to fling them. Each steps it takes would makes a "thud" sound, and when it ragdolls a player, it would make an explosion sound.
On idle it plays the Bodybuilder emote.

overview:
The Rose Palace is a Limited Reborn upgrader added on February 15, 2024.
The upgrader functions based on every pair of ores that pass through. It multiplies the first ore by x5. The following ore that passes is replaced by the previous upgraded ores, it will retains all effects the previous ore have. It acts like a Duplicator but does not net any new ores.
The second upgrade will still be considered an upgrade and must be resetted in order to be upgraded again.

x5
Second Ore:
Makes a copy of the previous ore, if there was one before it

It processes ores at a value based on your current Lucky Clovers, adding an additional x1,000 for every clover you own, with no lower nor higher cap. As such, having 0 clovers results in a x0 multiplier, and having 50 results in a x50,000 multiplier.

Base multiplier of x0.
+x1000 for every Lucky Clover (Lucky Clover) you have.

It drops ores with a value of $100k with golden properties.

It has an appearance of a Leprechaun. Despite its small size, it is surprisingly fast and can catch unsuspecting players who venture near its vicinity in your base.

It upgrades ores by x5. If the ore is Gold, it will upgrade it by x10. When anything touches the stick, it removes the touched part and closes the box. Any ores that comes into contact will get destroyed, however, if the ore has a Shield, it will used it up and survive.

It provides a x9 upgrade, but only if provided a constant supply of gold ores through its furnace. It also turns all ore upgraded by it into gold.

The Lepretron is a Limited Reborn Portable Upgrader added on 17 March, 2024.

Both upgrader parts can be used with each other without a Resetter.

quote: Those stupid yellow cats. Finally, their existence serves a purpose to you.
overview:
The Eternal Overseer is an Exotic upgrader added in the Epilogue of the Halloween Event 2020.
This upgrader works similarly to the The Cosmic Tower, except instead of multiplying an ore by 35x after it is created, it multiplies an ore by 15x almost immediately (~0.5 seconds) after its status changes for the first time. This can be replication, teleportation, a value change or even something like the Freon Sprayer. It requires Granite textured ores to power.
The Easiest Way to power this furnace if you're a low life is to utilize a Platinum Mine or other shop Mines. Additionally, Widow's Outpost is a great way of turning ore into a granite texture so you can use any mine.

f.effects: Upgrades all ore on base by x15
f.drawbacks: Requires Granite ore to activate.

• Multiplies ore value by x9

• Raised upgrade beam

quote: With the power of diamond-plated ores, this item will increase all dropped ore value by x20!
overview:
The Radio Tower is an Eggxotic upgrader added in Part II of the 2021 Easter Event.
As the description explains, this item is powered in a similar way to The Cosmic Tower. However, rather than using neon ores, it is powered by diamond-plate material ores. The easiest ways to obtain this ore effect are by using the Molten Forge or the Obsidian Infusion Device. Each diamond-plate ore processed gives the tower +1 charge. 1 charge powers the tower for nine seconds and can stack. When activated, the red lights on the antennae and the other parts of the top of the tower are turned on.

f.effects: Upgrades dropped ore by x20
f.drawbacks: Requires Diamond Plate ore to activate.

quote: Are you sick of infesting your base with zombies just to keep people out? Now there's Eggy Sentry Turret, with it's insanely accurate lasers!
overview: The Eggy Sentry Turret is a Eggxotic-Tier that was added in Part II of the 2021 Easter Event. It shoots at other players from afar with a laser if they trespass into the owner's base without building permissions. The lasers deal 20 damage, cannot go through other items, and suffer from limited range and a small degree of inaccuracy that allows constantly agile players to evade them.

f.effects: Shoots extremely accurate lasers that deal 20 damage.
f.drawbacks:
Can only shoot at enemies on your base.
Long range, can't shoot enemies that are close to it.

quote: A giant bar of soap, melted onto your conveyor to provide a clean and efficient way of cleaning your ore!

The Soapy Refiner is an Eggxotic Upgrader added in Part II of the 2021 Easter Event. It can be redeemed from The Craftsman after finding the Soapy Egg on Easter Island.
It multiplies ore value by x3, removes all negative status effects, and applies the wet effect to the upgraded ore for 5 seconds.

• Multiplies ore value by 3x

This upgrader multiplies ore value by 6-8x at random. It also makes ores more transparent if the item has given a larger multiplier to ore value, and can even make ores invisible.

It's both a teleporter sender and receiver built into one. It takes ores from the vacuum side and releases them from the other end.

quote: The producer of this item says it is more like a tank than a mine. We do not suggest seriously using this.
overview:
The Tankium Mine is an Eggxotic mine added in Part II of the 2021 Easter Event. It can be redeemed from The Craftsman after finding the Tank Egg on Easter Island.
By living up to its name, Tankium, this mine is not similar to other conventional mines. This is because it shoots ore worth $4M as if they were shells (projectiles). These ores then explode after 10s, killing any players within range of the explosion. These explosions can also kill other ores.

f.effects: Shoots explosive ore which can kill players

quote: A friendly reminder not to mess with the past as changing the past will drastically change the present.
overview:
The Time-Space Scrambler is an Eggxotic Upgrader that was added in Part II of the 2021 Easter Event. It can be redeemed from The Craftsman by collecting the Time Egg on Easter Island.
It randomly resizes your ore, ranging from sizes of 0.5^3 studs to 2.7^3 studs, and multiplies its value by 5x. The change in ore size may cause problems in your setup, as the ore may become stuck in upgraders, so using other size-changing upgraders such as the L.I.M.E and Ore Sawmill can remedy the issues this upgrader can cause.

f.effects:
Multiplies ore value by 5x
Changes size of ore
f.drawbacks: Ores may become too big for certain upgraders and might get clogged in the upgrader itself.

quote: Causes ores to spontaneously combust, with lingering explosive effects.

The Eggplosive Refiner is an Eggxotic upgrader added in Part II of the Easter 2021 Event. It can be redeemed from The Craftsman after finding the Bomb Egg on Easter Island.
It multiplies most ore's ore value by x4, but Boomite ore receive x10 to ore value. It also sets ores on fire, ultimately killing them if not extinguished within 5s. Extinguished ores will still explode, not killing the ore itself but knocking away nearby ores.

f.effects:
Multiplies ore value by x4
Multiplies Boomite Mine ore by x10
f.drawbacks:
Sets ore on fire
Ores explode after 5s

quote: A testament to the absolute rule that Loki has, proving himself to be the true being pulling the strings of the Horsemen's destruction. Be weary, as there is only pure chaos ahead for those who cross his path.
overview:
The SpookApocalypse-Ω is a Superstitious Mine added during the Part 2 of the 2025 Halloween Event.
The ore's value starts between $100Qn and $10sx. Ores dropped have a permanent Battle-Hardened tag and 10 seconds of Conqueror effect, which will effectively receive a roughly x4 upgrade and an upgrade counter of -10.
Ores will receive a +x7 multiplier to the Scales of Disparity's Rot calculation instead of the +x5.
Ores upgraded by Schrodingers-type items will have their multiplier doubled.
Its ore can also virtually power anything that needs fuel, with the exception of Crystal Shrine, Crystal Altar, and Gargantium Core. This makes it useful for powering Radio Tower, The Cosmic Tower, and The Eternal Overseer at the same time.

f.source: Using the ⟦Catalyst of Chaos⟧ and elements from Reborn-tier items with Draedon

quote: Ten years later, the dark knights of October still haunt the Haven, and with it comes a unified celebration from The Spook Family themselves! Halloween 2025 exclusive.
overview:
The DECADE HAVEN SPOOKMINE-5,256,000 is a Exotic Mine added during the 2025 Halloween Event.
It drops ores once every second and worth that depends on your number of lifes and mastery completion with a base value of $1B.
The formula for the value is 10⁹ × ((100 × M)²) × (min(L, 50000)), where M is mastery completion expressed as a number between 0 and 1 (e.g., 76.4% is 0.764, 100% is 1), and L is the user life. Notably, the formula caps when the user's life is 50,000.
It also can spawn ghost around the mine randomly, upgrading ores by x10 their value.

f.effects: Spawns ghosts around dropper that does x10

x.t:
Ore value = 10⁹ × (100 × M)² × min(L, 50,000)
M is your item mastery completion from 0 to 1 (76.4% = 0.764). L is your life, which stops counting at 50,000.

overview:

The multiplier is dependent on the player's life, mastery completion, and unique Gifts placed.
The formula for the multiplier is (100 × M × (L, 100000) + 1) × (1+(0.1 × min(P, 10))), where M is mastery completion expressed as a number between 0 and 1 (e.g., 76.4% is 0.764, 100% is 1), L is the user life, and P being unique Gifts placed. Notably, the formula caps when the user's life is 100,000 and at 10 Gifts placed.

x.t:
Upon consuming or stepped onto Dropped Sinister Potion's puddle, it will turn the affected player into an ore.
While in this form, the player is unable to move and has all of their tools removed from their inventory. The player is subjected to all movement from conveyors. They can also be launched from cannons or teleported using teleporters

While in this form, the player can be processed into a furnace at a whopping $0. This value cannot be changed. After processing, they will respawn normally. Resetting character will also respawn them normally.

quote: Celebrating 10 years of Miner's Haven, this cake symbolizes every achivement and cherised memory the game has brought to its community.
overview:
The DECADE HAVEN CAKE is an Exotic furnace added in the Tenth Anniversary Event.
The multiplier is dependent on the player's life, mastery completion and the amount of unique cake upgraders used.
The formula for the multiplier is (100 × M × (L, 100000) + 1) × (1+(0.1 × C)), where M is mastery completion expressed as a number between 0 and 1 (e.g., 76.4% is 0.764, 100% is 1), L is the user life, and C being unique cakes used. Notably, the formula caps when the user's life is 100,000.
It will also occasionally upgrade every ore on the server by x2. Upon processing, a confetti pop sound will be played.

1/100 chance of upgrading every ore in the server by x2.
